epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 父親去世後,Nathan和妹妹回到祖家準備出售房子。在此期間,Nathan發現這處房產是從兩名曾被指控濫用巫術的女子的祖先手中偷來的。隨著他深入調查,揭開了一個與父親死亡相關的神秘陰謀,而這個陰謀如今..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their fathers death, Nathan and his sister return to their family home to prepare it for sale. While there, Nathan discovers that the land was stolen from the ancestors of two women accused of witchcraft. As he delves deeper, he uncovers an occult conspiracy linked to their fathers death which now threatens them both.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一個沿海小鎮,Rico與Sisca發展了一段不可能的戀情,卻因他們相愛而引發惡靈的出現。隨著整個城鎮發生連串駭人聽聞的死亡事件,也揭露了隱藏多年的秘密,使到整個城鎮被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位渴望成名的作家為了挽救低迷的事業,決心創作一部暢銷小說。他重返童年故居,這裡亦是其身為知名作家的父親當年神秘身亡之地。當他意外發現父親留下的最後手稿時,才驚覺這部作品遠超自己的才華。於是,他決定將..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer retreats to his childhood home to finish a novel and save his career. There, he uncovers the final manuscript left behind by his father, a famous writer who died mysteriously years earlier. Realizing the work is beyond his own talent, he decides to plagiarize it, unleashing horrifying supernatural events.

epg.programme_title_tc: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2 (aka Offspring of the Devils Pact 2)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王懷卿賣畫,為要籌藥費救患重病的妻子,途中意外遇上雀妖的追擊,幸得狐妖小容相救。為躲避雀妖,王懷卿將小容帶回家中,三人隨即陷入一場情感困局,而一段淒美的人妖虐戀亦隨即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

epg.programme_title_tc: Hide  Seek (aka The Last Hide  Seek)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十三年前,廢棄大廈的一場爆炸奪走了童的好友諾安。十三年後,童與昔日的朋友們重返故地,此地如今已成為他們就讀的大學校園。當一名與諾安容貌相同的女孩出現,兒時的遊戲化為索命的詛咒。復仇的惡靈再度甦醒,逐一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirteen years after an explosion in an abandoned building killed their friend Noo Aon, Tong and his group return to the site—now their university campus. When a girl who looks exactly like Noo Aon appears, a childhood game turns into a lethal ritual. One by one, the friends are hunted by a vengeful spirit determined to settle a long-overdue score.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天臺舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幼女離奇失蹤後,悲痛的Drew與Helen在治療師安排下,前往偏遠林中小屋接受深度諮商。隨著孤立與壓抑逐漸侵蝕理智,療癒之旅化為噩夢。Helen飽受詭異幻象與異象困擾,逐漸分不清現實與幻覺,心智瀕臨崩..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their young daughter’s mysterious disappearance, Drew and Helen retreat to a secluded woodland cottage for therapy. As they struggle to salvage their marriage, isolation fractures their sanity. Haunted by visions and strange events, Helen can no longer tell what is real as her mind unravels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywoods famous Beach Party movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 俠女出生不久後,父母慘被四名悍匪所殺。長大後,她誓要為父母報仇雪恨。於是她苦練武功,並與劍客和一對夫婦合力將所有悍匪殺死。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A girl vows to take revenge for her parents who were murdered by four outlaws when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman and a couple to finally kill them all.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 劇情講述,知縣之子劉子和,垂涎葛小大之妻小白菜,用迷藥將其姦污。劉子和事後恐東窗事發,用砒霜毒死葛小大。葛死後,鎮內流言四起,知縣為救愛兒,設計嫁禍小白菜婚前戀人楊乃武。乃武被苦打成招,其姊楊淑英不忍見弟含冤而死,到刑部要求翻案……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she’s soon framed for her husband’s murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沙氏家族的賭術、千術已達出神入化的境界,在賭壇更是無人不知,無人不曉,而沙通更是青出于藍而勝于藍,在賭壇素有“賭王”之譽,甚少遇到對手。然而,沙通亦背負一段由賭而來的深仇,其師遭牌霸彭天石誣告販毒,被判刑十多年。沙通矢志為師報仇,欲以“老千千老千, 騙子騙騙子”的手段對付彭天石…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, its cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The doub

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青年醫生時振聲在醫院中發現很多奇難雜症,無法以醫學理論解釋,遂請好友齊中平夫婦共同研究。幾經追查,才發現那些病人均是中了降頭。原來施降者是精通邪術,以「愛情降頭」協助富商追求夢中情人,博取巨額報酬。中平不信妖邪之說,其妻子更不惜以身相試,更被施以「死降」,如果無法破解,二十四小時後便會身亡…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing’s wife and casts an evil love spell on

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雍正雄才大略,殘忍狠毒,特組「血滴子」特務集團,以作暗殺反清人士的工具。不料,馬騰不值雍正濫殺無辜,乃叛變潛逃出宮。雍正怕後患無窮,命御前侍衛剛振風及宣寶鷹,務必將馬緝拿到手。馬攜妻兒在昔日同僚追殺下,輾轉逃亡,匿於江南,開設打鐵館,並發明鐵傘以破血滴子...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a time of anti-Manchu sentiment, Emperor Yong Zheng employs his ruthless Blood Hound Corps to silence any dissenters. Only one man and his signature weapon, The Flying Guillotine, stand in their way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明末亂世,明將吳三桂賣國降清,引狼入室,大明江山終為滿清所吞併,天下有志之士無不悲憤。少林弟子紛紛下山,聯合各地英雄好漢抗清復明;清廷則招降納叛,廣納武當、峨嵋兩派敗類,勾結地方惡霸,對少林三大俗家弟子洪熙官、方世玉、胡惠乾趕盡殺絕。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,程小東因誤殺罪入獄,一死囚臨終前交予他半爿銅牌,囑他尋找另半爿銅牌,當會知其妙用。後程在獄中結識侯朝聲,一同逃獄;逃亡期間二人得悉銅牌牽涉到一段江湖恩怨,且始知彼此身上均有半爿銅牌,一湊合即出現「長白之巔,猛虎之嶺」八個字,另有山脈圖絞,二人憑線索去到長白山猛虎嶺找出「通臂拳」秘笈,遂苦練
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wei Chun is a cocky young man sentenced to jail for killing a man in a fight. One day, Wei Chun picks a fight with a seemingly defenseless old man who completely thrashes him! The old man turns out to be the master of monkey style kung fu and as they

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四大家族之一的金虎堡堡主在一次押鏢途中,被四名幪面和尚劫殺。葉青花被懷疑與案有關,遊俠雷迅助友洗脫嫌疑,竟捲入奇案,三闖少林。雷迅找出四名和尚,當眾伏法,以為真相大白;豈料,不久武林又傳出四名和尚到處行兇,雷迅才知道被人利用,引發連場打鬥。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served f

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1973年,香港股市暴漲人人熱衷炒賣股票,小市民因急於入住廉租屋而被不法之徒騙取金錢,及教育制度不健全引起民怨等均被改編成電影中的情節。故事諷刺寫實,反映了香港當時的真實面貌!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kongs social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嚴太師遇刺斃命,護衛范義追擊刺客至窮巷,見他踏鏢逾牆逸去,而鏢乃寇英之器,范遂遍城貼滿通緝寇的畫像。寇取得遇害縣官宋化龍身上的公文,得以入城,卻仍為范捉拿,幸得酒店店主的女兒雪娘,自認寇是其表哥,寇才倖免被捕;寇向雪道出自己的身份及真相。其後,范遭假扮成寇的寨主賀西雷襲擊,而救回他的竟是……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Governor Yan is killed and his guard Fan identifies Kou as the assassin by his signature weapon, a dart. Kou is listed as a wanted man when he enters the city, but managed to escape arrest with the help of the innkeeper’s daughter. At the same time,

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 富商之子平建人由於不願繼承父業,決定跟女朋友蘇詠蘭自開旅行社,招攬女教師董嫻芸和四個少女學生遊覽馬來西亞。詠蘭在旅途中眼看女學生李愛蓉癡戀建人,又誤會建人與嫻芸相戀,傷心失望離去。後來發現嫻芸早有情人梁茂夫,一場誤會始告冰釋。愛蓉得悉建人將與詠蘭結婚,精神失常,駕車撞山受傷昏迷……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fall

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李尋歡是一個風流多情的劍客,卻已退出江湖,十年來過著平淡的生活。因梅花盜重現江湖,他重回闊別十年之故園興雲莊。然而,當李尋歡回到興雲莊後,卻發現早已物是人非。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Li Xun Huan is a sentimental swordsman who has lived peacefully outside the martial arts world for the past ten years. He returns home after knowing that the Plum Blossom Bandit is back to his old tricks, only to find that everything has changed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廣西蛇山中有三條巨蛇──蛇王子、黑蛇將及黃蛇將;一夜三蛇化成人形與苗寨男女載歌載舞,蛇王子更因此愛上苗寨女子黑琴。後苗寨旱災,蛇王子答應率蛇作法,引水入寨,但條件是要娶黑琴為妻...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years.  All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sen

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 牛魔王與鐵扇公主夫婦為吃唐僧肉,命兒子紅孩兒對付孫悟空師徒。紅孩兒憑三昧真火屢挫悟空,後幸得觀音命龍女協助悟空救回唐僧等人,更將紅孩兒點化,收其為觀音身邊的善才童子。此片弘揚回頭是岸的大道理,發人深省。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The story is about the legendary Monkey King (Liu Chung-chun) teams up with Goddess of Mercy (Chao Li-chuan) and the Dragon Girl (Lung Nu) to battle the child god Hung Hai-erh (Ting Hua-chung),son of the Ox Demon (Hung Hai-erh) to rescue Tang Tseng,

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片為邵氏「西遊記」系列的第三部作品。唐僧落入了七位蜘蛛精的手中,希望食唐僧肉而得到永生。悟空、八戒和沙僧因此大鬧盤絲洞拯救唐僧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother’s Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him!  Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新加坡的黑鷹組織專與香港保險業作對。私家偵探張世傑從黑鷹領袖陳祖培女兒麗思入手。他倆認識後,不斷受到狙擊追殺,原來陳祖培於一年前已遭人殺害,胡媚用陳名義發號施令,為非作歹。張世傑與黑鷹集團展開連場激戰!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年廣州西關的陳家大屋,家道中落只剩下陳秀英及其入贅之丈夫楊振宇。秀英多病,而振宇又鬱鬱不得志,故常遭振宇辱打。直至自稱陳家僕人之女梁綺華的出現,聯同秀英反抗,竟錯手將振宇殺死!秀英自始活在驚恐之中,最終被振宇的鬼魂嚇死!原來這只是振宇在與綺華合谋殺害秀英,就在振宇以為可與綺華共築愛巢之際,秀英
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 結義兄弟妹三人同闖江湖情意深,龍兄加入了緝私隊,虎弟率直被人利用,小妹夾在中間做人難。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tiens gang is helping them; he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 翰林院大學士劉墉機智多謀,口才了得,常難倒乾隆。乾隆心中不忿,欲設計刁難他,但劉墉人急智生,妙語如珠,反令乾隆又再語塞。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils t

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莊主杜天道其子被人斬去雙臂,性格變得暴戾。無故地先後打傷四人致殘。四人成殘缺一族,走投無路,入深山找師父授以武功,立志報仇…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son’s arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片由著名文學家徐籲的小說《後門》改編,故事講述徐天鶴與太太結婚多年,膝下猶虛,對隔壁小女孩阿琳甚有好感。阿琳父母離婚,孤苦伶仃,徐太太提議收阿琳為繼女,琳父母喜不自勝。後來阿琳親母史小姐出現,要接回阿琳;徐太太不忍拆散母女骨肉,毅然將阿琳交回親母。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 群贼對梅家莊藏金垂涎,但屢劫不果,損失重大。梅逢春為救村滅?瑵撊胭寨探明路徑後通知官府。紅辣椒為寨主千金,遇梅後生好感。梅憑紅協助,將機密繪成地圖送走。惜梅身份敗露,幸官兵趕至…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The bandits of Hulu Valley slay the chief of the Mei Clan while searching for a treasure map. In retaliation, Chun from the Mei Clan infiltrates the bandits fortress to map a way in for the authorities, but ends up falling in love with the bandit le

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片根據中國經典同名名著改編。故事講述唐僧赴西天取經,中途在五指山收服馬騮精;在高家莊收服豬八戒;在流沙河收服沙悟淨的種種情節。。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang’s journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 浪跡江湖的汪禹,因被揭以木刀偽裝刀槍不入,而被村民群起而追。汪脫身回客棧後,發覺師傅江洋已被捕;數警察亦要抓汪,但汪已逃到另一村鎮;汪為抱打不平,又在眾人前顯露神打功夫,乘天將下雨,自謂是東海龍王化身,跳入河中隱身而去,未幾,果然大雨如注,眾人真以為有神靈出現。後汪遇恍如男孩的少女林珍奇,引為知己,
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the first kung fu comedies, this is a story about a con artist who uses kung fu to swindle villagers for money by pretending to be possessed by spirits. When they are threatened by bandits, he must use the same skills for good.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述三女意外獲得大筆財產,必須遠赴日本領取,途中遇上三位男人,也想分一杯羹。正當大家各懷鬼胎,彼此攻擊、賄賂甚至出賣對方,企圖獨佔鉅款時,殊不知更驚悚的遭遇正嚴陣以待。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is tak

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清兵火燒少林寺後,少林弟子洪熙官身受重傷,負傷逃亡。途經此地的方世玉誤以為洪熙官是窮凶極惡之徒,遂將他交給清兵。當方世玉得知自己錯捉洪熙官後,便千方百計設法營救,好讓二人聯手對抗清兵。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after a Qing army attack, but suffers serious injuries while fleeing. Mistaking Hong for a dangerous outlaw, Fang captures him and hands him over to the Qing soldiers. After learning the truth, Fa

epg.programme_title_en: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿牛拾得一袋珠寶,從此富貴。這時,周大叔假意叫他簽約迎娶一名女子,却原來是個陷阱,為的是要賣掉他的房子。最後,可憐的阿牛又回復一貧如洗…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白玉龍找尋失蹤的父親白震東,與丐幫幫主安樂天的義女魏金鳳日久生情,終於在金劍莊成婚。婚後不久,玉龍竟被「龍門宮」的人捉去。白父曾和其宮主龍仙子結婚,誕下玉龍,現龍七姑迫玉龍遵守宮規和月蘭結婚!玉龍逃回金劍莊,龍仙子至,母子相認,仙子召集門人,決意將宮規廢除!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by Dragon Gate Palace one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and  reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together,

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部音樂喜劇講述青年貝小芬與好友漢堡飽在廣告界內尋找真愛和成就的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 平時表現得不諳武術的酒鋪女子關寶珠,原來是武功了得且專門鋤強扶弱的黑蝴蝶。一次黑蝴蝶用從五魔山寨撂奪得來的金子濟貧,令她被黑白二道追捕。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Not a love triangle but a love rectangle, Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片由兩個單元故事組成。首個故事講述柳宣教策劃了一個破玉通禪師「色戒」之奇計,著美豔妓女紅蓮向玉通大施色誘攻勢。第二個故事講述少女馮玉華之母馮孫氏欠下九尾狐一筆錢無法償還,被逼做妓女還債。後馮孫氏因性病死去,遺下一筆債務以及殮葬費須玉華償還;玉華無奈,只好踏上母親所走過之路...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年青馬車伕鍾堅因救助少女而與惡霸結怨。馬車老闆恐惹禍上身,把他辭退。鍾堅決志除暴安良,隨少林蔡李佛名家習武,向惡勢力挑戰。最後,他將惡霸除掉,令地方歸於平靜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the “Tsai Li Fu” style of martial arts from a Shaolin m

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部武俠傳奇故事,集合瑰麗的畫面、詭秘懸疑、權力鬥爭及動作于一身,成功地將精彩的動作場面與緊湊的劇情結合。藉江湖兩大幫會內部叛變,從而刻劃出人性叵測及真善混淆的一面。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This intriguing wuxia saga is packed with conspiracies, power schemes and sword fights to produce a perfect blend of great action and gripping drama. The movie centres around the struggle for underworld supremacy between two clans, where the line bet

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鐵匠仇子玉,擅打利刀,且為武林高手,本已退隱江湖,但正氣未泯,應武林大豪屠一堃之邀,聯手對抗四大巨盜,奪回價值連城的飛龍璧物歸原主。誰知屠只是利用「鷸蚌相爭,漁人得利」的局面奪取該璧據為己有,事成後仇亦慘遭毒手。飛刀手雲翔知悉屠之卑鄙手段後,登時大發志士之憤,勇闖屠佈下之旗陣奪取飛龍璧,交回偵緝隊長

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影講述傅紅雪為了應付勢力龐大的陰謀家公子羽,除了力敵對方的爪牙,亦要智破對方的詭計。憑藉出色的武打設計、華麗的佈景、唯美的拍攝技巧及強勁的演員陣容,《天涯明月刀》在武俠電影的歷史上創下高鋒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,狄龍與姜大衛游車河時,遇富家女李菁的跑車拋錨,狄載她返家,一見鍾情。後李往姜之修車廠取車,再遇狄,狄約李去跳舞,夜總會中,碰見李兄陳鴻烈,陳不喜歡狄,故二人只好提早離去;歸家途中,目擊員警追捕逃犯,逃犯掉下之手槍,被狄檢到,從此改變他的命?..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen’s brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pis

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 神刀大俠臨終時,把神刀傳給了徒弟林振嘯,而且更識破了另一徒弟方世雄為奪神刀而混入門下的奸計。方世雄為了神刀,令林家破人亡和雙目失明。最後,林振嘯與方世雄大戰為家人報仇,並誓要重奪神刀…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一次醉酒後,武松赤手空拳打死一隻猛虎,因此被任命為都頭。武松兄長武大郎的妻子潘金蓮色誘武松,但遭他拒絕。後來,潘金蓮和富戶西門慶有染,及後姦情敗露,兩人繼而毒死了武大郎。武松知悉後,先殺潘金蓮再殺西門慶,為兄長報仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歐陽鋒得悉郭靖以九陰真經的功夫於選婿比武中獲勝,並娶得黃蓉為妻,於是把黃蓉挾走,要脅郭靖要默寫九陰真經才會釋放黃蓉。最終郭靖會否為救出黃蓉而就範?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong’s hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 軍閥割據時代,江湖人物及狡黠之徒所玩弄的傳統騙術層出不窮,「蛇神」、「李三腳」、「三隻手」等一群妖言惑眾的騙徒令人云亦云的愚民上釣,反映舊時代一切牛鬼蛇神眾生相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 滿清入主中原後,北少林為免遭剿滅,只好受命派出弟子到清軍府擔任教頭,誰知抵達後,始知府中已有南少林教頭;期間將軍挑動兩派人不和繼而公開比武互相殘殺,後南派因弟子傷亡而與北派交惡,展開一番互相殘殺...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An evil Qing general comes up with a plan to rid the Shaolin masters once and for all. He invites three Northern Shaolin experts to fight against three Southern Shaolin disciples. After the contest, the general secretly kills the Southerners and plac

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孫玉郎與劉慧娘,裴政與徐雅本是兩對情投意合的戀人,陰差陽錯間,孫玉郎男扮女裝代姊拜堂,劉慧娘則代兄娶妻。他們的婚約誤配,讓成誤會,終鬧上公堂,喬太守將錯就錯,乾脆來了一個亂點,結果正好有情人終成眷屬,皆大歡喜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister’s wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女俠風靈得悉六弦魔琴重現江湖,唯一能克制魔琴的只有火弦弓及火羽箭,唯袖手樵隱知其下落;風找得群雄一起找樵;期間,眾人發現逍遙隱士就是六指琴魔...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set ou

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沈昌生性沉鬱,與父親缺乏溝通,被人利用,誤入歧途。昌逃不過暴力的魔爪和色情的引誘,竟然出賣父親,讓父親慘死。昌悲悔交加,獨闖飛仔巢,逐一將之擊斃,自已也進入瘋狂狀態。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋末,大元初把天下統一,元帥將宋丞相文天祥打入天牢,意圖說服其歸元,亦希望借機將往救文之抗元義士一網打盡。義士之一白鴨兒在拯救途上,遇著「金掌」樂何如,忙邀共同救國,但樂自認跟蹤白為貪圖美色,救國非少數人所能為,拒絕後旋即逸去。及後,一眾義士為救文,紛紛藉故犯法,先後成功被關入天牢,白竟在天牢再遇樂
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Kil

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丁安安與雍晴兩個表姐妹自小就讀於同一所女校,因二人的母親一向口和心不和,從小就向自己女兒灌輸好勝思想,因此形成安安與晴從小鬥到大,三日一小吵,五日一大鬥。她們在校中認識了男同學米高及保羅,很快成為情侶,兩對小冤家後來因鬥氣竟然互調了男朋友…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness  innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocenc

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武松殺死潘金蓮及西門慶後,被判發配孟州牢營。武松元照例要接受一百下殺威棒,但得施恩求情,僥倖獲得豁免。武松為報答施恩,當知道她的「快活林」酒家被「蔣門神」蔣忠奪去,誓要不惜一切助她取回酒家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新加坡的黑鷹組織專與香港保險業作對。私家偵探張世傑從黑鷹領袖陳祖培女兒麗思入手。他倆認識後,不斷受到狙擊追殺,原來陳祖培於一年前已遭人殺害,胡媚用陳名義發號施令,為非作歹。張世傑與黑鷹集團展開連場激戰!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he d

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li’s new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her ac

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A dedicated chief constable nicknamed “The Invincible Fist” is chasing after a band of bandits near a village one day and encounters an innocent blind girl. He quickly falls in love with her, but finds out she is the daughter of a vicious bandit. Wil

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三個香港美少女何莉莉、陳依齡及淩雲,帶著愛情夢遠赴日本大阪,一心指望釣得如意郎君。豈料三人被誤會是富家千金,結果惹出趣事連篇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姜大衛飾演一個寧願自廢右臂退出江湖,也不願委屈求全的大俠,一直過著隱姓埋名的生活。直到至愛被綁架,好兄弟被殺害,他誓要重出江湖與惡勢力一戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「劍神」三少爺是武林中的一大高手,但他因疲于應付上門挑戰的劍客,決定假裝死亡,隱姓埋名,並過著寧靜平凡的生活。可惜江湖上的人仍千方百計要向三少爺挑戰,令他被逼再度出手,不得不重現江湖。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一次偶然機會下,富家子大用巧遇育幼院院長之外甥女連蓮。二人初次見面,雙方即發生誤會,大用更在匆忙間遺下皮包。當大用硬將連蓮假裝成爲自己的未婚妻好讓兩個傾慕他的女子死心時,又與連蓮發生了第二次誤會...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to ge

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sisters death, but is shocked to discover that her fiancé, Jin, is one of them.  At the same time, Jins mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng.  Can F

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn’s beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong’s concubine as he knows Dong’s adopted son Lu Bu is in love w

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主角小雜種由隱士撫養並授以武術;一天,隱士囑他下山訪尋父母。途中,他體驗到人情冷暖,先與女乞丐小乙惺惺相惜,建立「同是天涯淪落人」的友 誼,亦與邑紳之子顧英豪結怨。最後,他終於從妓院鴇母口中得知自己的身世,原來其生母本在顧家為婢,被老爺引誘成姦後,又遭虐待致死…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 林少游、石大勇及關飛,三者俱屬浪跡江湖之豪俠,表面上遊戲人間,實則滿懷壯志,誓以抗暴為己任。一次,機緣恰巧,林等三人助青年富戶楚鐵俠逃出險境,並結為生死之交。元朝異族王爺早有霸佔富戶財富的野心,後更借故追捕楚,林等遂出手相助,共谋抗暴大業...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu’s family fortune

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 羅素克洛在雷德利史考特的史詩巨制《羅賓漢》中飾演羅賓漢——在這段傳奇中,他奮起對抗腐敗,點燃反叛之火,讓一位卑微的亡命之徒化身為永恆的自由象徵。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Russell Crowe stars as Robin Hood in Ridley Scott’s epic reimagining—fighting corruption and sparking a rebellion that turns a humble outlaw into a timeless symbol of freedom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在充斥著貪腐、謀殺以及影星光環的繁華背後,三名警官誓死奮戰,只為揭開一起殘忍連環慘案背後的駭人真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amidst corruption, murder and the glamour of famous movie stars, three police officer fight to uncover the truth of a brutal mass murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當一對亡命鴛鴦那段光鮮亮麗卻時而致命的冒險,演變成充滿背叛、死裡逃生、虛假身分以及令人頭昏眼花的愛情糾葛迷宮時,他們才終於意識到,此時此刻唯一能指望的,就只有彼此了。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a fugitive couples glamorous and sometimes deadly adventure erupts into a maze of double-crosses, close escapes, false identities, and head-spinning romantic snafus, they come to realize that all they can count on is each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對從小失散的同卵雙胞胎——一位是居住在紐約的音樂家,另一位是生活在香港的技工——多年後因音樂家的演奏會行程來到香港,意外重逢,引發一連串錯綜有趣的事件。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Identical twins – a musician living in New York, and a mechanic living in Hong Kong – are separated in childhood but are unexpectedly reunited years later when the musician travels to Hong Kong for a concert.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1872年,一位英國發明家、一位中國小偷和一位法國藝術家出發,用80天完成環球航行。他們通過海陸空和滾軸溜冰,爭分奪秒回到起點。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is 1872, and a British inventor, a Chinese thief and a French artist set off to circumnavigate the globe in 80 days. They travel by land, air, sea, and in-line skates in order to beat the clock and finish where they started.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jamie Foxx leads an elite FBI team to hunt a terrorist in Saudi Arabia in The Kingdom—a tense clash of cultures and justice, directed by Peter Berg and produced by Michael Mann.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Miami Vice, undercover detectives played by Jamie Foxx and Colin Farrell navigate danger, crime, and seduction in a gritty, stylish update of the iconic TV series. Also stars Gong Li.

通過老班主丁百雄這個農村家庭提琴戲班一家人的生活、演出及情感經歷,描述了我縣民間藝人為保護、傳承、弘揚民間藝術崇陽提琴戲的坎坷人生及心路歷程。
十年不見妻子笑笑的秦奮在老範幫助下得到了一個智慧人笑笑。與假笑笑的相處中秦奮逐漸產生了模糊的感情,而這時候真笑笑回到了他的身邊,兩個笑笑對秦奮互不示弱的爭搶讓秦奮苦不堪言的同時鬧出了一連串的笑話。

Three years later, Zhang infiltrates a drug lab in an investigation, only to discover that it is operated by his former teammate Hu. When a drug gang raids the lab, Zhang is trapped in the fierce battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: General Pan Zhang of the Wus killed General Guan Yu and took away his Green Dragon Crescent Blade. Two years later, Emperor Liu Bei brings an army led by Guan Xing, the son of Guan Yu, to attack Wus waterfront defence. Guan Xing overcomes all challenges and fights against General Pan Zhang to avenge his fathers death, and reclaims the blade.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a town ravaged by the vampire virus, four Maoshan disciples including Yun Ling are tasked with finding the cure. However, they are entrapped by the schemes of the mastermind, which caused discord amongst them. When the town is besieged by a spider demon, the four disciples have to overcome their conflicts and unite to save the people.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Song era, a young master and staff at Fei Yun inn aid General Li Xian Zhong to recover the lost territory in a northern expedition. However, Deputy General Shaos jealousy and sabotage cause the mission to fail. Fueled by anger, the team vows to capture Shao while helping the civilians to evacuate.

As Yu gradually falls for Niu, her expelled senior returns and forces Yu to accept his duel challenge by threatening her with Nius safety. A deadly martial arts fight has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Exorcist Liu Yi Ze proposes marriage to his girlfriend, but discovers that her family is manipulated by the Fox Demon. During his fight with the Fox Demon who has possessed his masters body, Liu Yi Ze must defeat the Fox Demon without hurting his master. Can he vanquish the demon and safeguard everyone?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tang Bo Hu spends lavishly on a woman but is outbid by a mysterious man. Angered, Tang punches the man, who is actually the Emperor. He sneaks into the palace to evade arrest, but gets entangled in a revolt led by King Feng. As Tang discovers that the evidence of Fengs rebellion is hidden in a painting, he vows to uncover the plot.

They must team up to complete the adventures on the island and win the grand prize. Unknowingly though, they become the victims of a complicated and evil plan.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two decades ago, a meteorite carrying three crystals struck a village on Earth. Rumor has it that anyone entering the village forest will be haunted by a mountain ghost and trapped. After 20 years, the ghost reappears, causing a series of murders. As investigation begins, the hidden truth behind the mystery is gradually uncovered.

They also uncover the truth behind the rumoured monster, and protect the safety of the people of Changsha together.

Despite an anarchist attack, the team strives to overcome the fierce battle so that the supplies can be delivered to the villagers successfully.

Fueled by anger, the Cult leader unites with Shen Gong Pao to exterminate the Zhou army by setting up a thousand deities trap. Meanwhile, Jiang Zi Ya join forces with Yang Jian, Na Zha and other deities to fight the evil forces and rescue mankind.

Years later, the coffin reappears with a serpent and a Young Zhao vows to kill it. Meanwhile, the Chen family is cursed and it can only be broken by the floating coffin. This results in the two families teaming up in a dangerous adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Eastern Han Dynasty, young Zhao Zi Long and his comrade Xia Hou Lan accidentally get involved in the chaos, but they end up with different paths in life. Zhao Zi Long finally triumphs over the selfish Xia Hou Lan and fights against the dark forces, teaming up with Liu Bei and achieving victories for the Han dynasty in the end.

Unfortunately, a sudden headache hits Tie and he gets into an argument with the boss of the debt collection agency, putting more strain on the relationship of the two lovers.

Fueled by anger, the shark turns to attack four friends who are celebrating their graduation on a yacht. A life-and-death struggle between the four friends and the big white shark has just begun!

A police inspector assigns Hunter Lin Qi and his disciples to catch the crocodile, but they soon discover that there are more than one. Fighting with the crocodiles becomes a test of physical strength, and the good and evil of human nature.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,水派幻術師裴靜之為搶奪法寶大開殺戒,最終被火派幻術師空空封印,之後空空帶著一孤兒卓非凡離開。二十年後,裴解開封印想再次奪寶,將空空殺害。空空死前將自己撫養的卓託付給落霞飛學習火術。卓發誓要為..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Illusionist Pei of the Water Cult is trapped by Kong in a seal as he tries to kill to find the treasure. Kong leaves with an orphan Fang and 20 years later, Pei unseals himself to find the treasure again and kills Kong. As Fang learns the Fire skills from his master Kong, he vows to avenge his death but then discovers his ties to the Water Cult.

epg.programme_title_en: Seventeen and a Half Years Old
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張君佳是一名高中學生,為了接近校花黃巧姍,他想拍一部微電影,讓黃巧姍主演。藝術節快要到來,他決定組織同學們拍一部校園喪屍片,拍攝期間,眾人幾經波折,劇組更瀕臨於崩潰邊沿。然而友情、親情和愛情交織成的共..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhang Jun Jia directs a micro movie starring the school girl he likes. As Arts festival approaches, Zhang and his classmates decide to make a college zombie movie. They encounter many difficulties in the process and despite the production team falling into pieces, they manage to overcome the challenges with love amongst friends, family and lovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,陰陽鎮遭恐怖詛咒,傳說進去後誰也出不去,離開的人都會神秘死亡。尋寶人閻陽一和寶葫蘆誤入了陰陽鎮,雖然閻不相信傳說,但他在鎮上卻常常遇到可怕的事情。然而讓閻和寶更沒想到的是,在詛咒之下的詭異小..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yin Yang Town has been cursed during the Republican period and legend has it that anyone who leaves the town will be mysteriously killed. Two treasure hunters who do not believe the legend inadvertently enter the town and experience horrifying events. The real surprise lies in an astonishing secret in this cursed town...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安史之亂平定之後,安史餘孽成立了飛乙幫,秘密遊走於藩鎮之間,企圖重新挑起戰禍,計劃起兵於河北。為了清剿飛乙賊子,朝廷命劍聖裴旻公招募了一些江湖上的劍俠,成立了長水門。貞元十二年,飛乙幫和長水門各自在魏..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the An Shi Rebellion, the An Shi rebels unite as Fei Yi Gang to attack Hebei. Meanwhile, the court appoints swordsmen of the martial arts world to form Chang Shui Gang to eliminate the rebels. Both gangs set up traps in Wei Bo and a deadly battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退休運動員肖力在父親的激勵下,帶領村中的女童足球隊贏得了比賽,並且幫助學校擺脫了困境。這勵志的故事展現了人們為了美好生活奮鬥,在過程中增進及修補了家人、戀人、師生等人與人之間的相互關係,並表達了美好生..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘇家布行二房長子蘇文興,渴望繼承家業,卻在與堂妹蘇檀兒的較量中被擊敗。興偶然得知他在眾人眼中只是一個吉祥物,為了證明自己的能力,興決心往外闖一番事業,但卻遭受連連挫折。正當他絕望之際,一位舊日同窗高甜..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Su Wen Xing aspires to take over the familys textile shop, but loses the control to his cousin. To prove himself, he sets out on a journey to find his own success but faces repeated setbacks. In despair, he reconnects with an old classmate who collaborates with him on a business venture, resulting in a series of amusing and chaotic escapades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傅炎為了拯救瀕臨死亡的藍墨伊,毅然前往上古戰場神佑之地,尋找神炎來救藍。上古戰場分三層,他們剛從外層降服了守護獸赤墨玄蛟時,便遇到蒼岩宗宗主蒼石靈君。然而傅及石二人要爭奪對方的半張藏寶圖,在一番激戰後..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: u sets out to find the Godly Flame and save the dying Nan. On his way, he encounters Master Shi of Can Yan Sect when vanquishing a guardian beast. Fu and Shi battle for their respective halves of the treasure map but eventually reconciled after a fierce fight. Both decide to share the map and team up to search for the treasure and the Godly Flame.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事販賣機由四個獨立單元組成,包括《馴兔記》馴服小孩變成兔子的童話故事;《鬼打牆》男子來到酒店約會,卻誤入鬼打牆走不出去的懸疑故事;《官能許願》超能力男孩,以器官為代價,拯救意外慘死女友的愛情故事;及..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie consists of four short stories: a fairy tale about a kid turning into a rabbit, a suspense story about a man trapped in a haunted wall during a date, a love story about a lad with supernatural power sacrificing his organ for his lover, and a fantasy tale about magical pleasures after eating the chicken soup noodles sold in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在地球未來,人類大量排放廢氣製造垃圾,使到地球迎來沙化期。動植物變異產生地球新主人“沙蟲,而它們將人類逼到滅絕邊緣,倖存者只能尋找僅存的避難所“綠洲。一支由富商、科學家、保安隊長、機械師以及混混組..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In future earth, humans emit exhaust gas to produce waste, leading to earths desertification. Desert Bugs are mutated to cause human extinction and the last hope of the survivors is to find the oasis. A team made up of tycoons, scientists, security chiefs, engineers and gangsters embarks on a perilous journey in an armoured tank to find the oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 未來的地球資源匱乏,各國頂尖科學家將數種動植物的物種送往火星培養,希望改善火星的環境能夠適合人類居住。然而生物在實驗中開始發生變異攻擊人類,身在火星的專家們情況十分危險。中國派出太空人進行救援,他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Elite scientists worldwide plan to cultivate several plant and animal species on Jupiter to combat resource scarcity on Earth. However, the species mutate and attack the scientists. Chinese astronauts are sent to Jupiter on a rescue mission, and they fight fearlessly against the unknown species to save the scientists there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有妖怪殺手之稱的劉一刀為了給妹妹治病,不惜退隱江湖四處尋訪名醫。此時以蛇女和金蟾子為首的妖族,正密謀危害人間。後來劉陰差陽錯遇到錦鯉精小巒,得知她是黑龍轉世。妖族亦知道此事,也想爭奪小巒帶她去召喚..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon killer Liu Yi Dao retires from the martial arts world to find a doctor for his ailing sister. Meanwhile, the demon clan is plotting against the human world. Liu encounters Xiao Luan, a Koi Spirit recincarnated from the Black Dragon, who is also hunted by the demon clan. Can Liu save Xiao Luan and stop the battle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武林大會時,盟主霍長空與血魔羅決戰時輸了,血魔亦元氣大傷,危急關頭霍將功力注入劉晶體內,劉意外獲得內力。十四年後,劉在隅然機會下來到“霍家拳館,陰差陽錯遇到血魔羅重出江湖找霍家人報仇。有著霍長空功力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Defeated by Blood Demon in a martial arts tournament, Master Huo passes his skills to young Liu Jing. Fourteen years later, Liu chances upon Huos martial arts school and meets Blood Demon who returns for vengeance against Huos clan. Liu fights Blood Demon with Huos legendary skills, upholding justice and protecting Huos clan in a deadly battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年閻晃跟著身為撈屍人的師父老姜,在天水村遇到離奇事件,傳聞二十年前有水怪禍亂屠戮村莊,現在怨靈回魂伺機索命,流言四起。在調查期間,閻在林瑤及老姜等人的幫助下堅定立場,不被封建迷信所蒙蔽,努力探尋真相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rumour has it that a water monster destroyed the village 20 years ago, and now its vengeful spirit has returned. As Yan and his master encounter mysterious incidents in the village, Yan decides to find out the truth without being influenced by superstitions. In the process, Yan discovers his true identity and captures the real culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his country, Ge Zhen joins a killer squad assigned for secret government missions. It is when Ge Zhen investigates a case that he encounters Qiu Kui and they fall in love. At the same time, Wu Ma, the most powerful killer in the squad is mysteriously murdered. Can Ge Zhen and Qiu Kui be together, and can Ge Zhen rescue his country?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 茍勝、富貴等人突然在酒店遇到由食物引起的病毒爆發,感染者失去理智,瘋狂地撕咬其他人。茍勝帶領眾人逃離酒店,前往安全地方,在逃亡過程中與感染者發生了激烈搏鬥。隨後逃亡隊伍內部又突爆矛盾及衝突,互相猜忌。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gou and his friends encounter a food virus outbreak at the hotel, which causes infected people to bite others insanely. Gou tries to bring his friends out from the hotel but this results in a fierce battle with those being infected. As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the Tang dynasty, a fallen demon dragon causes the people of Qujiang City to mysteriously go bald overnight. Outraged, the Emperor assigns Magistrate Wang to investigate the case. Wang infiltrates the secret Long Wang Cult and exposes their plot to instigate a massacre, eventually saving the emperor and protecting the people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大荒城城主張塢為復活三千年前被皇帝打敗而封印於東海某處的赤睺,到處蠱惑人心,並指使各種妖怪在人間胡作非為。少年李靖學成下山後見此情景,堅信心中正義一路斬妖除魔,並與路途中遇到的薑子牙等人結為隊友,各顯..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Master of Da Huang City orchestrates demonic chaos on earth to revive Chi Hou, who was sealed by the Emperor three thousand years ago. After his martial arts training, Li Jing vows to vanquish the demons and uphold justice. Together with Jiang Zi Ya and team, he strives to save the people in a deadly battle against the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張騫奉漢武帝之命率領百餘人組成使團出使大月氏,中途卻遭匈奴截殺及俘虜。張及部份生還的使團成員淪為階下囚,被軟禁十年之久,原本要實行密謀多年的逃跑計畫也被突如其來的一場匈奴與大漢將軍的戰爭打破。儘管如此..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Appointed by the Emperor Han, Zhang leads a diplomatic mission to Greater Rouzhi, but they are either killed or captured by the Huns on the way. Zhang and the captives are imprisoned for 10 years and the battle between the Huns and Han destroyed their long-awaited escape plan. Zhang vows to overcome the trials and bring the captives back to Han.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A series of mysterious incidents happen when treasure is discovered in Long Yun Town, including killings of girls. As ill-intentioned martial artists arrive to uncover the treasure, Cop Lin, assigned by the mayor, teams up with a death row inmate to identify the murderer and uncover the truth, so as to safeguard the town and its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tong Song is a genius but unfortunately lost his limbs in a car accident. He sets up a security services company with a computer expert and a skilful fighter, and their first job is to protect a dog. The job seems quite simple, but it turns out to be a perilous task as they unravel a conspiracy behind the mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhang Sanye joins his junior He Lao Dao on a quest to a fabled tomb said to hold treasures and the secrets of immortality. However, as the tomb is about to open, warlord Luo Man Zi suddenly appears, and it turns out to be a plot set up by both Luo and He for Zhang. A thrilling journey into the tomb has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lanterns once illuminated Fu Feng City at night, but it is now shrouded in darkness as there is a rumor that people will get killed when their lights are on. When Wen Ning discovers anomalies in this situation, he joins forces with Nan Si Zhui to find the real culprit behind and finally restore peace and harmony to the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 風光旖旎的海島度假酒店遭遇突如其來的海嘯襲擊,與海嘯一起肆虐而來的是一條生猛的巨鯊。曾經作為潛水人員的王磊與朋友Lisa陷入絕境,與他們一同被困的還有與丈夫前來度蜜月的小琳以及蠻橫無理的富家少爺桑尼。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A beautiful island resort is devastated by an unexpected tsunami, and the attack of a fierce shark soon follows. A former diver, his friend Lisa, a newlywed couple and a rich young man are trapped on the island. A deadly fight between humans and the shark has just begun!

epg.programme_title_en: The Thousand Faces of Fei Jia

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young man Wang Xiao Xia resides in a small town with his blind father. His only desire is to cure his fathers eye disease. One day, he encounters Shen Nan Er by chance and gets embroiled in a conspiracy. In his quest to heal his fathers eyes, he goes to the Qi Yin Sect and finally unveils his hidden identity, which was concealed by his father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雷霆安保公司的幽靈小隊,由林森帶領隊友執行解救女科學家南茜的任務。眾人救南後在撤離時見到一名小孩被關在籠裡,趕去營救,卻聽到槍響,之後全軍覆沒。於偉剛寫下小說“幽靈狙擊的一段,跟著一聲槍響,被擊中頭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Shen leads the insurance company’s ghost team to save a scientist. During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. It is not until he wakes up that Yu Wei realises he has become his novel’s character!

epg.programme_title_tc: 大法醫宋慈系列之偷梁換柱
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋慈在建甯縣遇到知縣大人誤判吳蜚卿案,為了幫助吳洗脫冤屈找出真相,宋必須在兩天之內抓住真凶。根據紙扇上的神秘痕跡、消失不見的兇器、宋在面對種種疑點,終於找出了與兇手有關的蛛絲馬跡。此時,突然出現的一份..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tasked with absolving Wus wrongful conviction, Song Ci races against time to unveil the real culprit within two days. With the enigmatic clues on a paper fan and a missing weapon, Song Ci draws closer to finding the culprit. However, an indictment hiding a conspiracy suddenly appears, leaving Song Ci speechless...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 九門的陸尋與同僚大山受命保護兵部尚書鄭巖,但鄭突然離奇死亡。陸在調查中發現舞女封如月與其兄封空空可疑,但空空卻意外失蹤。陸循著線索,帶著大山、如月來到黑澤城,在執行公務的過程中無意被捲入驚天陰謀。陸在..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lu and Da are assigned to protect a military officer, but he dies suddenly. As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上古時期,因人類的貪念欲望所生成的魔王阿爾薩召集亡靈軍團征服了世界,而上古人類領袖以鮮血鑄成聖劍封印了阿爾薩。千百年後,阿爾薩破開封印,開始在東原大陸發起進攻。此時聖殿騎士團聯合東方巡夜山宮等武林門派..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In ancient times, Demon King Artha summons the dead spirit army to conquer the world, but is sealed by the holy sword. Thousand years later, Artha breaks the seal and launches an attack to the east. The holy chevaliers unite with the martial arts cults to find the holy sword, hoping to seal Artha again and save the people from his tyrannical reign.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young minibus driver Xu Tie falls for a rich girl Lisa. However, Lisas mother disapproves of Xu due to their social differences. Xu Tie goes astray in the hope of earning more money, but ends up harming his friends. With the support of family and friends, Xu Tie tries to make amends and begins to appreciate love and life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,自稱是捉鬼大師的豪哥和他的兩個徒弟雖然有點真功夫,卻多數靠小聰明以詐騙為生。直至鎮上真的發生了離奇事件,他們終能發揮所長,憑藉自身的聰明才智和高強武功,遂一破解小鎮殭屍作亂玄案,並一併剷除鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A self-declared ghost buster Hao, and his two disciples, possess good skills but resort to fraud ghost hunting skills to make money. When mysterious incidents happen in town, they can finally unleash their skills to solve the mystery of the vampire case and exterminate the evil sects by using their wits and martial arts skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙腿殘疾的童松是矛盾安保公司的創始人,團隊中還有擅長機械的安寧和身手了得的大牛,公司主要是保護客戶安全,俗稱“保鏢。這天,他們接到一個匿名委託,要保護的人正是安寧的妹妹安逸,之後逸便頻生意外。童發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Handicapped Tong is the founder of a security company. His team includes mechanical expert An Ning and martial arts expert Da Niu. One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Nings sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙腿殘疾的童松是矛盾安保公司的創始人,團隊中還有擅長機械的安寧和身手了得的大牛,公司主要是保護客戶安全,俗稱“保鏢。這天,他們接到一個匿名委託,要保護的人正是安寧的妹妹安逸,之後逸便頻生意外。童發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Handicapped Tong is the founder of a security company. His team includes mechanical expert An Ning and martial arts expert Da Niu. One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Nings sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝崇禎末年,正派與魔教勢不兩立互有爭鬥。白髮魔女練霓裳因此陷入一場江湖的腥風血雨當中,內裡更蘊含著重大陰謀。錦衣衛常安奉命暗中調查白髮魔女練霓裳,在追查的道路上,常安對練霓裳產生了莫名的情愫,要為練..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大清年間,偏遠的臨江縣有兩名縣令接連被大蟒蛇咬死,百姓人心惶惶。侍衛蘇乞兒和鐵橋三奉命前往臨江縣調查此案。兩人發現當地毒品極樂丸極為盛行,而在調查當中鐵橋三與蘇乞兒也因極樂丸陷入困境。在逆境面前他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Qing Dynasty, two magistrates died from a deadly snake bite, causing fear amongst the people. When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東南亞最大人口販賣組織頭目巴頌在自己的私人俱樂部設宴,邀請世界各地犯罪集團的頭目參加。雅美成功潛入俱樂部執行任務,為了掩護隊友撤退,美獨自引爆炸彈,與未婚夫方立一起裝死後隱居。三年後方立被綁架,迫雅美..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Asias biggest human trafficker Ba Song, invites the triad bosses to attend his private party. Ya Mei sneaks in and helps her teammates to escape by setting off a bomb, at the same time faking the death of herself and her fiancée. Three years later, Mei must resume duty to fight against Ba Song in order to save her kidnapped fiancée.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年後的未來世界,一群食客打算去一家違法經營的野味飯店享受一頓野味大餐,突然當中有一隻變種巨蜥衝破了鐵籠逃走,之後店員一個接一個地神秘失蹤。在此同時捕鼠專家阿發接到飯店的滅鼠委託,本來的滅鼠行動卻變..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2040s, a group of customers visits an illegal restaurant serving wild animal meat. Suddenly, a giant lizard mutant escapes from the cage and the restaurant staff disappears one by one. Meanwhile, a rat catcher is tasked by the restaurant to exterminate rats, but it turns out to be a terrifying battle against the lizard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在罪惡橫行的世界裡,有一個叫太平鎮的桃花源。這裡有私人英雄守護而未被黑幫入侵。吳正義為了成為私人英雄的一員,每天苦練功夫,在正義救星中心雄先生的幫助下成為私人英雄。隨後他發現該鎮被邪惡集團控制,最終與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a crime-ridden world, there remains a town safeguarded by the private heroes from the triads. Wu Zheng Yi practises kung fu everyday and finally becomes a private hero with the help from Xiong. When Wu discovers that the private heroes are controlled by the evil gang, he teams up with his master Xiong to vanquish the evil gang boss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,生物研究所得知在沙海有異變生物,於是派出探索小隊前往調查,但前去的隊員幾乎全部被滅,剩下劉夢西和夏萱帶著生物樣本逃離,過程非常危險,幸得獲沙丘鎮柳纓所救。原來沙漠出現異獸,居民被迫在地底生活..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Institute of Biology assigns a team to investigate the mutants in a desert, but the whole team is nearly wiped out. Luckily, two researchers escape with the mutants samples. As the residents in the desert are forced to live underground to avoid threats by the mutants, the team must beat the mutants for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 毒梟塚虎在十五年前派人追殺梅姨,當時林郎與林峰親眼目睹母親梅姨被殺害,為躲避殺手追殺,郎與峰分頭走散,但郎之後音訊全無,而峰成為緝毒員警。在中國邊境滇市的掃毒行動中,峰發現毒梟郎哥的母親也是被塚虎殺害..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Lang and Lin Feng witness their mothers murder by the drug dealer Tiger fifteen years ago. They separated in their escape and Feng becomes a narcotics police officer while Lang disappears. In an operation, Feng discovers that Tiger has also killed the mother of a drug boss, Lang. Is Lang his brother? Can Feng arrest the drug dealers?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漁民子豪生活在海邊小鎮歸港,以捕魚為生。有一天,他偶然遇到一位神秘的女孩小藝,兩人互生情愫,終於走在一起。但好景不長,突然有一個名叫老金的神秘中年人到來,揭開了小藝真實的身份竟然是人魚族!子豪能否接受..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fisherman Zi Hao lives in a small seaside town and earns a living on the water. One day, he finds himself enchanted by a mysterious woman Xiao Yi, and they fall in love.  However, a strange man appears and uncovers the true identity of Xiao Yi as a mermaid one day.  Can Zi Hao face the truth and can Xiao Yi keep the secret of the mermaid tribe?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 初任上海警察隊長的陳虎接到一樁命案,軍政部部長之子何滿君離奇死亡。何是聖馬丁高中的一名學生,為了獲得破案信息,陳喬裝學生混入學校。他一邊查案,一邊與各方勢力展開較量,而何之死迷霧重重,一個又一個嫌疑人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The son of a minister is mysteriously killed. The newly appointed police inspector Chen Fu, goes undercover as a secondary student to investigate the case. As he carries on investigation in the school, Chen encounters different potential suspects, making the case more mysterious. What is the cause of the murder and who is the killer?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 韓渺是八仙之一韓湘子的化身,在一個缺水猶如沙漠的世界一路向東歷練。而正在執掌東海的龍女因失去記憶,化成了一條魚精,意外遇到和自己有宿世因緣的韓渺。二人走在一起,在東遊途中受到高人指點去尋找 “龍門 ..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Han Miao is one of the eight immortals living in a desert. Dragon Maiden, who helms the East Ocean, loses her memory and becomes a fish demon. When she encounters her destined lover, Han Miao, they quickly fall in love. With help from a guru, they set out for Dragon Gate where Dragon Maiden can resume her identity and locate the water source.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金傲為保護中華傲決與無敵大戰,在生命垂危的時候將中華傲決傳授給華英雄。然而擁有“天煞孤星命格的華英雄失去了父母及妻子,離開了兒女,潛心修煉二十年卻始終無法參悟中華傲決。最終,華為了所有中國人要與無敵..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jin Ao battles with Wu Di to preserve the Pride martial arts skill, which he passes to Hero Hua before he dies. Hua, who is born under the curse of the Star of Loneliness, leaves his family to practise the martial arts skill for 20 years, but still fails to master it. Can Hua finally master the skill and defeats Wu Di to save his people?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊境小鎮妖魔遺禍,吳靖子發出請柬,請各位降妖高手前來支援。市井遊民阿拾,意外被孟珠救下後竟愛上孟珠,要拜她為師,一路跟著孟珠及其他降妖高手前往小鎮去消滅在雲棧洞內的千年豬妖。最後阿拾以自己的性命為代價..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Jing Zi seeks help from demon hunters to cast away the evil spirits in town. Saved by demon hunter Meng Zhu, Ah Shi falls in love with her and becomes her disciple. They journey to Yu Zhan Cave to kill the Pig Demon with other hunters. In the end, Ah Shi sacrifices himself to let the hunters fight their way out, but the result is unexpected...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長安大理寺捕快郝龍霄神功蓋世,卻為救被妖獸傷害的妹妹,被幻獸妖魔之王鬼車所利用,得奪取各樣法器來助鬼車開啟陣法。原來鬼車的目的是吸聚百姓精血,顛覆人類,以幻獸來控制世界。幸而郝識破鬼車的陰謀,在危急關..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his sister, top martial artist Constable Xie is forced by the Monster King to find all magical weapons for a tactical plot. The Monster Kings real purpose is to suck peoples blood and control the world through eudemon. Knowing his evil plan, Constable Xie decides to unlock his hidden power and begins a fierce battle with Monster King.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國際刑警鐵嘉文痛失愛人後隱姓埋名成為了健身房老闆娘。她帶領著男神教練孟京、瑜伽教練喜喜和拳擊教練東妮,本想安然度日,然而舊日仇怨和黑勢力仍不放過鐵。一場針對鐵和其姐妹的狩獵遊戲正悄然展開,鐵決意替姐妹..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Interpol officer Tie Jia Wen mourns the loss of her lover, and lives incognito as a gym owner with her coaches, Meng Jing, Xi Xi and Dong Ni. However, Tie is troubled by her past when vengeful triad gangs come after her and her coaches. Vowing to uphold justice, Tie decides to fight against the evil gangsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔刀門女弟子雅青初次下山,不慎捲入唐門“蛇人風波,在逃避追殺的途中結識了啞女伏風和江若晨。正當他們陷入絕境時,幸得隱居高人梁玄卿指點知道“蛇人之謎背後隱藏著一個大陰謀。為了尋找真相,三個人齊心協力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Magic Blade Sects disciple Ya Qing gets implicated in a snakeman trouble and meets two girls during her escape from a killer. The three girls are told by a master about the conspiracy behind the snakeman. To uncover the truth, they team up to defeat the mastermind of the conspiracy and unveil the grudges in the elder generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 高尚是一名普通的救護車司機,從小就懷抱著賽車夢想。他誤打誤撞捲入一場飆車糾紛中,結識了一流賽車機械師鮑佳音,令他有機會開啓賽車手之路。在他猶疑不知應該選擇安穩生活還是賽車夢想之際,好友的萌萌激勵讓他領..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gao, an ambulance driver, aspires to be a car racer. He meets top race car engineer Bao during a car racing dispute, which sets him on a path towards his dream. Gao faces the dilemma of leading a stable life or pursuing his passion, but finally decides to embrace his dream and live life to the fullest with the support of his close friend.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 高尚是一名普通的救護車司機,從小就懷抱著賽車夢想。他誤打誤撞捲入一場飆車糾紛中,結識了一流賽車機械師鮑佳音,令他有機會開啓賽車手之路。在他猶疑不知應該選擇安穩生活還是賽車夢想之際,好友的萌萌激勵讓他領..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gao, an ambulance driver, aspires to be a car racer. He meets top race car engineer Bao during a car racing dispute, which sets him on a path towards his dream. Gao faces the dilemma of leading a stable life or pursuing his passion, but finally decides to embrace his dream and live life to the fullest with the support of his close friend.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漫畫展上,宅男漫畫家郝萍穹意外與殺手肖白菜交換了身體。穹由廢柴變成擁有豐滿身材和超能力的少女,但他卻不斷被壞人追殺。白菜不用擔心受敵人襲擊,但她卻每天過著被追稿的生活。這換位人生讓他們更了解自己的能力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bottom-ranking cartoonist Hao and killer Xiao accidentally swapped identities at a comic fair. Hao becomes a powerful girl but is pursued by villains, while Xiao is free from pursuit but must work on deadlines everyday. After knowing their capabilites and responsibilities, they resume their identities and team up to fight the villains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盛世大唐氣象萬千,各色人物皆在江湖中行走,身懷絕技的盲眼“捉刀人成瞎子,遇上慘遭滅門和淩辱的酒家女倪燕。原本不與人有過多交情的成瞎子卻意外與她產生關聯,亦逐漸被捲入一場勢力龐大的暗黑紛爭中。成瞎子開..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Talents are found everywhere in the Tang dynasty, including Blind man Cheng. He meets a barmaid Ni Yan, who has lost her family and gotten abused, and they become friends. This entangles Cheng into a big triad conflict, and as he starts his journey of revenge, his true identity is also revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江城傳奇神槍手“鬼手,被保護江城安寧的羲和堂以叛徒之名追捕。小混混陸瀾意外得知哥哥被鬼手所殺,為了復仇加入羲和堂,在女殺手冷楓的培養下成長為一名頂尖槍手。陸決意殺掉鬼手為兄報仇,在生死槍戰之際卻發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Legendary sniper Ghost Hand is hunted by the Yi He gang that is responsible for safeguarding the city. Lu Lan joins the gang to take revenge on Ghost Hand who has killed his brother. After training to become a top sniper, Lu Lan uncovers the true identity of Ghost Hand during a shootout and uncovers the conspiracy of Yi He gang.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東漢末年亂世紛爭,少年趙子龍與同鄉夏侯蘭因為一場意外而捲入到這個亂世中來,但他們二人卻選擇了不同的人生道路。最終趙子龍戰勝了為一己之私而背叛初衷的夏侯蘭。趙持長劍於亂世行走,踏破黑暗掀起波瀾,最終選擇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Eastern Han Dynasty, young Zhao Zi Long and his comrade Xia Hou Lan accidentally get involved in the chaos, but they end up with different paths in life. Zhao Zi Long finally triumphs over the selfish Xia Hou Lan and fights against the dark forces, teaming up with Liu Bei and achieving victories for the Han dynasty in the end.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十年前,身為救援隊隊長的張一凡帶著家人去度假,不料突發遇到颱風,張的兒子也意外在山崩中喪生。兒子的死讓他變得神經質,妻子也提出離婚。張本想挽回家庭,不料又一場颱風來襲,妻子被颱風所困,女兒又被人綁架。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 10 years ago, rescue team leader Zhang suffered the loss of his son in a landslide during a typhoon. His anguish leads to his wifes request for divorce. While Zhang tries to reconcile with his family, another typhoon strikes. His wife is trapped and their daughter is kidnapped. Facing such difficulties, Zhang must save his wife and daughter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國員警王之章的兒子因鴉片而亡。他痛恨舊社會犯罪橫行,封建思想荼毒百姓,因此偽裝成道士潛入當地商人陳老爺家調查鴉片走私案件,期間卻遇到連環殺人事件。身為員警的王之章為了職責及為兒子報仇,誓要抓住兇手,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Policeman Wang hates crime in the city and the feudalism that lead to his sons death by opium. Disguised as a Taoist priest, he investigates opium smuggling in a merchants home and uncovers a series of murders. Driven by duty and revenge, Wang vows to find the murderer, destroy the stored opium and restore peace in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人族和妖族長年爭鬥,人族首領黃帝得奇門遁甲的力量終於平定世界,之後成立霧隱門來保護百姓。羅剎鎮捕頭周同因為被死對頭追殺,逃難途中隅遇生命垂危的霧隱門天老。關鍵時刻天老將體內武功傳給了周同,及後在霧..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the battle between human and demons, human race leader, Huang Di, restores peace by magical astronomy and establishes the Wu Yin Sect. During an  escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐時期垂拱元年,武則天率領百官坐龍船夜巡運河,各人奔向龍門只為一睹天后聖容,沒想到卻在運河之中遭遇龍形異獸衝撞龍船,引起了百姓的議論,認為是不祥之兆。武則天對此事件勃然大怒,召見狄仁傑前去調查運河龍王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Empress Wu and her officials patrol the Grand Canal one night. As the crowd rushes to see her in person, a dragon monster appears and hits on the vessel. This is believed to be an ominous sign. Empress Wu is angry and asks Detective Di to investigate the case. Detective Di uses his investigative mind to unravel the truth and find the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期上海,怪物獵人宇文預測到上豪大飯店有怪獸出現,而當怪獸現身襲擊表演的花旦顧青時,宇文英雄救美,打斷富少警探天明的公開表白。之後三人被捲入了一系列的奇怪案件,在調查過程中,所有線索都指向一個塵封..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican time in Shanghai, monster hunter Yu saves an actress in a play from a monsters attack, at the same time interrupting a cops love confession for her. As the trio gets involved in a series of mysterious cases, they find out that the cases are related to a legend about a giant monster who will soon be returning to the world...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正邪之首,龍門及異門在昆侖之巔決戰,異門被滅,龍門首領朗炎建立龍都城,並設立龍雀衛組織。轉眼十二年後,突然朗遭蜘蛛人襲擊中毒,龍雀衛首領方圓及聖女姬心在調查襲擊事件的過程中,發現異門後人利用噬魂蜘蛛企..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leaders of Long Sect and Yi Sect battled and the Yi Sect was defeated. 12 years later, Lang Yan, Long Sects leader, is poisoned by the spider demon. As Longs guard and Ji Xin investigate the case, they uncover a plot by Yis descendants to unleash spider demons onto Long to create chaos. The battle between good and evil will soon begin....

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大陳天啟年間,發生了西域舞姬控物懸浮事件,負責靈異怪事的部門“夜行司派出陳淩前往無相城調查。城內叛徒木道人假意幫陳,其實想奪走城內的異能植物日輪花,讓大陳百姓感染花毒癲狂噬人,以報服大陳和無相城..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Chen Dynasty, Chen Ling is assigned to investigate a supernatural case in Wu Xiang City. There, a man who pretends to help Chen Ling wants to steal a supernatural plant whose poison will cause people to bite each other, so as to take revenge on Chen and the master who killed his tribe. A fierce battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 河北省的秋風縣在半個月前寡婦何秀琴在城外被匪徒殺害後,縣城一座名叫赤橋的橋上開始出現「女鬼」。縣太爺陳之章命令捕快郭幻率領眾人限期捉鬼,當郭抓住了裝鬼大漢夏蟲,得知夏裝鬼的理由,才發現原來背後竟藏著一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female ghost is sighted at a bridge following the murder of a widow two weeks ago in Qiu Feng County. Inspector Guo is assigned to hunt down the ghost promptly. Upon investigation, Guo discovers a man named Xia Chong disguising himself as the female ghost, leading to the revelation of a peculiar murder case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靈蛇山白蛇與青蛇姊妹潛心修煉,某日白蛇遇險,幸得上山尋藥的許仙搭救,兩人之後一心相戀。然而人妖殊途,許仙被迫離開白蛇。陰司大妖王下令追捕白蛇。白蛇生命垂危卻將千年修行給了許仙,許仙自取心臟救回白蛇後自..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: White Snake and Green Snake devote themselves to attain immortality in a mountain. Xu Xian save White Snake one day and they fall in love. With demons and the underworld against them, both lovers sacrifice themselves to save the other. A hundred years later, White Snake give up on becoming an immortal and returned to the mortal world to find Xu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝嘉靖年間,倭寇入侵、海賊橫行,沿海地區的百姓苦不堪言。青年時期的俞大猷識破倭寇與海賊的詭計,保衛了民眾和大明疆土。而年少時的俞只想做一名大俠,其後在與倭寇及海賊的鬥爭中,他逐漸明白要成為真正的英雄..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Ming Dynasty, people living at the coastal area suffer under the Japanese pirates and bandits, and the young Yu uncovers their plots, thereby saving his country and the people. While young Yu aspires to be a warrior, he eventually learns that he must use his sword to protect the people and the country to become a true hero.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 率領神魔眾生征戰天道的上古戰神辰南,經歷沈睡萬年後從雪山之巔的墓群中蘇醒過來,但神力和記憶都被封閉。其後他在與守墓人的激鬥跌入斷崖後,無意間誤入楚國地界。最終辰南在解封自身神力及找回記憶的過程中,更一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ancient God of War Chen Nan, awakens after sleeping in the Snow Mountain for ten thousand years but has lost all his super power and memory. He falls from a cliff in a fight and accidentally enters the Chu State. As Chen Nan gradually restores his strength and memory,  he embarks on a journey to protect the world against evil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天真無邪的少女清澄,為了給家人報仇,被訓練成冷血殺手。數度殺人後,她決定放下怨念,在安樂寨度過平靜的餘生,也在那裡結識了樂於助人的阿邦,與他結了婚。正當清澄隱藏武功平淡過活時,江湖風雲無奈又起。為了維..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young and innocent Qing Cheng is trained to become a ruthless killer to seek vengeance for her family. After killing many, she decides to let go of her resentment and seeks refuge in a remote village, where she meets Bang and marries him. As social upheaval erupts, Qing has to step up again to protect the village and restore peace.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以阿古力為首的狼衛軍攻打硫勒城,企圖得到竊天氏的龍脈寶藏和天下第一美人將軍史天驕。守城將軍史萬夫寡不敵眾,與好友肖不平密謀,利用《竊天書》設計反攻狼衛軍。史為了擊退狼衛軍,拯救自己的女兒和全城百姓,竟..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Wolf Guard Army invades the city to seize the treasure of Qie Tian Clan and to capture a beautiful female general. Though largely outnumbered, General Shi and his friend Shao plot to counterattack the Wolf Guard Army. To rescue his daughter and the people, Shi decapitates himself continues to battle the enemies as a headless general.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年前,大巫祭率領暗黑一族侵襲人族,戰神張赤炎不惜犧牲自己喚醒戰神劍,才得以擊退暗黑族。如今黑暗力量再次蘇醒,蠢蠢欲動,戰神之子張珂與及雲柃、福喜再次踏上喚醒戰神劍的旅程,而張珂也在戰鬥中成長為新戰..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 20 years ago, God of War Zhang Chi Yan sacrificed himself to restore the power of his sword so as to defeat the Tribe of Darkness. As the tribe becomes active again, Zhangs son, Ke, and his friends set out to restore the swords power. Zhang Ke is now the new God of War with the sword, leading his people to fight a deadly battle with the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年前,大巫祭率領暗黑一族侵襲人族,戰神張赤炎不惜犧牲自己喚醒戰神劍,才得以擊退暗黑族。如今黑暗力量再次蘇醒,蠢蠢欲動,戰神之子張珂與及雲柃、福喜再次踏上喚醒戰神劍的旅程,而張珂也在戰鬥中成長為新戰..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 20 years ago, God of War Zhang Chi Yan sacrificed himself to restore the power of his sword so as to defeat the Tribe of Darkness. As the tribe becomes active again, Zhangs son, Ke, and his friends set out to restore the swords power. Zhang Ke is now the new God of War with the sword, leading his people to fight a deadly battle with the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次打擊邊境犯罪的行動中,特種兵王周揚、肖克二人參與了邊境黑勢力清剿活動,卻遭遇戰友慘死,此後兩人陷入深深的不安和自責中。及後在一次面對黑勢力的逆襲時,兩人決定再度聯手,共同對抗敵人。一場正義與邪惡..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During a mission to extinguish the cross border gangs, Zhou Yang and Xiao Ke of the special task force witness the tragic death of their comrades and feel greatly disturbed and guilty. However, in a counterattack by the gangs, Zhou and Xiao team up again to fight against the gangs.  A final battle between the good and evil has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李道師聽從師傅之命下山歷練,本以為妖邪都是殘忍惡毒,卻在路上經歷了三件事,讓他悟出一些道理。當他看到黑魚精為救她無情的丈夫犧牲自己;一對相愛的戀人為了在一起而放棄生命,共同融入畫中;刺蝟精捨身為報答乾..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Master Li believes all demons to be evil until he encounters three events - a fish demon who sacrifices herself for her heartless husband, a pair of lovers who commit suicide for love, and a hedgehog monster who sacrifices himself for his godfather. These encounters make Master Li question who is more evil, humans or demons?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上陽郡主王萱在與寒族將軍蕭霽新婚之夜,為遵守與愛人三皇子子珩的約定,甘願飲毒酒假死,豈料這一切只是皇權氏族的陰謀算計。王萱傷透了心,為了報仇化身為吸食人血的修羅女,連子珩對她也非常懼怕。然而蕭霽卻對王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Princess Wang fakes death on her wedding day with General Xiao to fulfil her vow with her secret lover. After realizing it was a set up by the Emperor, Wang is devastated and turns into a blood demon to take revenge. However, General Xiao still stands by her side and helps her to uncover the truth behind an even bigger conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀七十年代,香港在英國殖民統治下貪腐嚴重,黑惡勢力橫行,毒梟坤哥及豪哥大賺不義之財。廉政公署人員白玫瑰奉命潛伏到黑幫大佬豪哥身邊收集罪證。玫瑰與豪哥日漸熟識,兩人互生情愫。面對一面是將毒梟繩之以法..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Drug lords Kun and Hao prosper amidst a corrupt landscape in the 1970s Hong Kong. ICAC officer Rose embarks on a mission to infiltrate Haos gang to gather evidence. However, as Rose and Hao fall in love, she faces a heart-wrenching dilemma — choosing between her duty to bring him down and the irresistible pull of their intensifying romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年青鐵匠呂三思偶遇自己崇拜的大俠百里無憂。他幫助大俠押送西廠走狗何清纓,但何卻對他說了另一個版本的故事,說她是被西廠迫害,而百里才是出賣義士的走狗!事情越來越可疑,何不一定是走狗,而百里也可能不是大俠..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young blacksmith Lui encounters his idol, Swordsman Bai Li, and helps Bai deport He Qing Ying, a lackey of the emperors secret agency. However, He claims that she is innocent while Bai Li is the one who has betrayed the patriots. Things become suspicious and Lui is unsure of whom to trust. Who will he trust in the end?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 科學狂人私下研發了一種具有交感神經、高度發達的人形機器人。偶然地,機器人獲得了獨立意識,更通過黑科技手段換取了貌美女子蘇辛的皮膚及軀殼,接近蘇的男友王升。另外,不斷有離奇殺人案發生,引起了警員李洞賓的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A science maniac creates an advanced humanlike robot, which accidentally develops its own thinking. It takes on the appearance of Susan by evil technology, and approaches her boyfriend. Meanwhile, police officer Li investigates a series of mysterious murder cases. A battle between humans and robots is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群年輕的大學生策劃了一場特殊的畢業旅行,然而卻陰差陽錯闖入了一座巨獸棲息的禁忌之島。因為人類的失誤,這個島成為了怪獸樂園,學生們要戰勝巨獸才能逃出生天。而隨著深入探索,他們發現這次畢業旅行背後,似乎..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of university students embarks on a graduation trip, but accidentally trespass into an forbidden island, which is the home of a giant monster. Due to humans fault, the island is now a monster paradise. The students must defeat the monster to escape and as they explore further, they uncover a hidden conspiracy behind the trip.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊防部隊正在追蹤國內最大毒梟組織旭東商會的一批價值數百萬美元的毒品,卻被劉老三團夥搶走。警方找到在監獄服刑劉的兄弟大飛,說服他幫忙找回毒品。組織老大黃旭東知道貨被搶,便找了國際僱傭軍準備捉人搶貨。邊防..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Border troops are after a multi-million dollar drug deal from the biggest drug dealer but Lius gang snatches the drug away. As the police seeks help from the prisoner Da Fei, who is Lius friend, the drug lord also hires mercenaries to get the drugs back. A battle between the border troops, the triad and the mercenaries has just started!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,北海市發生連續殺人案,幻術師羅賓協助警員龍聰調查。兩人發現死者大多是隱姓埋名的幻術師,羅賓推測兇手殺人的目的是為了寶藏,卻發現真兇美智子利用暗黑幻術殺人。最後美智子用幻術召喚出玄冰白虎,而羅..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Illusionist Robin assists a police officer to investigate a serial murder. While they discover that most victims are incognito illusionists, Robin thinks that the murderer kills for a treasure, and later identifies Mei as the culprit who uses dark illusions to kill. Mei summons White Tiger to fight against the Fire Dragon commanded by Robin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蘅王統治下民不聊生,有志之士誓要推翻蘅王,立下衣帶詔。蘅王請魏侯爺找出衣帶詔,並要派殺手殺死名單上所有人。白山水和謝柔均在名單上,而謝柔的弟弟謝長勝對白心生愛慕,與其他殺手一路追蹤白到客棧。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the oppressive rule of Emperor Heng, some volunteers sign on the Belt Oath to overthrow the government. The Emperor sends killers to eliminate them, including Bai Shan Sui and Xie Rou. Xies brother falls for Bai, so he follows the killers to the inn, but ends up causing a series of hilarious events due to misunderstandings.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔族在雲盛皇朝興風作浪,皇帝突死於怪病,在臨終前將盛寧公主下嫁伏龍大將軍白奕。公主向太后請求悔婚遭拒絕,漸漸兩人相處後關係緩和,公主發現自已對白奕已芳心暗許。及後公主被魔族尾火虎挾持,白奕在混戰中救出..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon cult prevails in the Yun Sheng dynasty. The Emperor arranges the princess to marry General Bai Yi before he dies, but the princess wants to end her engagement. When the princess eventually falls for Bai, she is kidnapped by the demon cult and Bai is killed in a fight while trying to save her. Will the couple be separated forever?
