epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,津沽城命案接連發生,警局束手無策。一向以風水破案的段宇豪和祁威被要求調查此案以戴罪立功,免除之前的懲罰,但在找線索的同時,二人卻被一步步地推向多年前發生的羅剎鳥連環殺人案。段宇豪與祁..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In crime-ridden Jin Gu City, the police are unable to solve the murder cases. Duan Yu Hao and Qi Wei are assigned to investigate the cases through fortune-telling. In the process, a murder case that happened years ago is brought to their attention, and they vow to uncover the truth and find the murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在幫派紛爭中銷聲匿跡的龍頭阿暿向來獨來獨往,武功了得,更是霍氏醉拳的高手。阿暿隱姓埋名化身為懲治惡勢力的俠客。而行事殘暴的軍閥霄霸天與黑虎山山匪勾結,成立壓榨當地貧民的茶廠 來幫他們種植鴉片。阿暿..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cult leader Ah Xi is a top martial artist who is also a skilled Huo Drunken Fist fighter. However, she chooses to become an incognito swordswoman who fights against evil. Warlord Xiao Ba Tin colludes with some bandits and force the poor to plant opium. Ah Xi steps up to fight against them and finally exterminate the evil gang.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白澤和淩風自幼一起在崑崙派長大,二人因誤入秘境,得到了昊天鏡及絕世魔功。後因淩風修煉魔功之事曝光,兩人被逐出師門,來到白馬鎮,在這裡找到心愛之人。不料崑崙派突然來追殺他們,使淩風愛人慘死,令他墜入魔道..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bai and Ling are expelled from Kunlun Sect after acquiring a mystical mirror and a forbidden martial arts skill. They both found love along the way, but when the Kunlun sect members hunt them down and kill Lings lover, Ling is devastated and decides to turn evil. To uphold justice, Bai subdues Ling and found the Shushan Sect.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國女學生林家英親眼目睹姐姐被軍閥馬世傑迫害致死而卻無能為力,並在隨後趕到的何美梓口中得知姐姐原來是秘密特工隊“魅影的一員。為替姐姐報仇,英加入魅影特工隊,接受訓練成為一名美豔特工。在一次執行任務中..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young student Ying helplessly witness her sister being persecuted to death by a warlord. When she realizes her sister is a member of the secret agency Phantom, Ying vows to avenge her death and joins Phantom. She eventually becomes a pretty secret agent but soon unveils the secret behind Phantom during a mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明德市郊外發生了一宗拋屍命案,公安局副局長楊棟帶領整個警隊展開深入調查。他們逐步揭開了以企業家林峰為首的頂峰集團涉嫌殺人、放高利貸、及開設賭場等罪行。隨著對掃除黑勢力專案的持續進行,那些無惡不作的犯罪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A police deputy chief leads an investigation about a body discovered in Ming De Town, and gradually unveils a series of crimes, including murder, loan sharking and casino activities by a company owned by entrepreneur Lin Feng. The police go all out to fight vigorously against the criminals as anti-triad operations continue...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 首屈一指的馴鳥師茅山豪,在鳳凰島遭遇變異物種襲擊,並不斷有人離奇失蹤,人心惶惶。為了探尋真相,豪與治安隊隊長孟前冰釋前嫌,並通力合作調查此失蹤案。可怕的是,線索竟指向與僵屍有關!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Phoenix Island is attacked by a mutated object, causing people to mysteriously disappear and inducing panic. Top bird trainer Mao Shan Hao teams up with a  security team leader to investigate the case. The search intensifies as they uncover clues linking the missing victims to zombies, adding a thrilling twist to the case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 未來的地球資源匱乏,各國頂尖科學家將數種動植物的物種送往火星培養,希望改善火星的環境能夠適合人類居住。然而生物在實驗中開始發生變異攻擊人類,身在火星的專家們情況十分危險。中國派出太空人進行救援,他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Elite scientists worldwide plan to cultivate several plant and animal species on Jupiter to combat resource scarcity on Earth. However, the species mutate and attack the scientists. Chinese astronauts are sent to Jupiter on a rescue mission, and they fight fearlessly against the unknown species to save the scientists there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗倭寇志士追馬流落到邊境沙漠之地,選擇在這裡開一家客棧來度過餘生。一天,仇人之女白鹿攜寶箱逃命到客棧,追馬本可有機會把她除掉,然而白鹿要將寶箱中可以對抗倭寇的機密平安送出。追馬為了民族大義,最終放棄仇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seeking a tranquil existence, anti-Japanese patriot Zhui operates an inn on the outskirts of town. The daughter of his foe flees to his inn one day with a treasure box containing the secret to fight the Japanese bandits. Though Zhui can easily kill her, he sets aside his hatred aside to help Bai fight back and deliver the secret box safely.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東南亞某國打拼的華人姜芃在妻子離世後,和女兒姜小湖相依為命。姜幫大資本家察沃工作,運送傳說是一條巨鱷古斯塔夫的關鍵貨物。一場突如其來的海嘯將他們困在了唐人街,鱷魚古斯塔夫破籠而出,瘋狂撕咬眾人。姜芃父..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jiang Peng lives with his daughter after his wifes death. When he is tasked with delivering a giant crocodile, a tsunami strikes and trapped him and his daughter in Chinatown. As the crocodile escapes and assaults people, Jiang and the others survive luckily but find out that the episode is not an accident but a set up...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇門派和五毒派為江湖兩大門派,而這兩大派為了“皇家龍種花落誰家而各施各法,奇門派誤打誤撞中揭穿了皇叔試圖阻止皇帝有子嗣的陰謀。皇叔派五毒派弟子秀明試圖毒害皇太子,而奇門則派出多美。多美為人善良,且鍾..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qimen and Wudu Cults both get involved in the imperial succession plan. Qimen Cult accidentally uncovers the conspiracy of the Emperors uncle, who enlists a Wudu disciple to poison the Crown prince. Meanwhile, Qimens Duo Mei falls for a royal guard and joins forces with him to uncover the evil plot of the emperors uncle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緝毒精英的閆鵬在追捕毒販赤那時,同事兼好友阿古拉犧牲於毒販手中。之後鵬來到阿古拉家照顧他的家人,卻不料碰上真正的赤那到來,要阿古拉父親帶路,幫他逃離邊境。鵬隨後才知道,先前被他消滅的毒販竟然是赤那的孿..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agula, a friend and coworker of Narcotic agent Yan, is killed by the drug dealer Chi Na. While Yan takes care of Agulas family, he encounters Chi Na who wants to flee the country with the help of Agulas father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 某朝年間,齊王殺兄長靈宗奪位,天下動盪。此時忠威鏢局負責護送一張神秘藏寶圖到杭州府,用以資助鎮南將軍起兵復辟,及幫助靈宗的舊太子“花月明重掌江山社稷。而崑崙派掌門高照受命於齊王,負責剿滅餘黨及安排奪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Qi kills his brother and seizes the throne, causing chaos in the country. When a convoy escorts the treasure map to help the former prince regain his position, Emperor Qi assigns Kun Lun Cult master to eliminate the rebels and seize the map, causing great danger to the convoy and martial artists along the way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事圍繞著用生命來維護世間陰陽平衡的陽冥司端木熙,與遭遇車禍意外死去的漫畫屋老闆楊敬華。楊陰差陽錯被迫與端簽訂終身契約,成為端的影靈,二人互相看不慣對方,卻被契約緊緊捆綁在一起。之後連續發生詭異的死亡..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a story about a ghost hunter, Duan, who is dedicated to maintaining the yin-yang balance and a comic store owner, Yang, who dies in a car accident. Yang becomes a spirit attached to Duan through a lifetime contract.  Initially at odds, they unite to entangle the mysteries of recurring bizzare deaths and restore peace and harmony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在地球未來,人類大量排放廢氣製造垃圾,使到地球迎來沙化期。動植物變異產生地球新主人“沙蟲,而它們將人類逼到滅絕邊緣,倖存者只能尋找僅存的避難所“綠洲。一支由富商、科學家、保安隊長、機械師以及混混組..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In future earth, humans emit exhaust gas to produce waste, leading to earths desertification. Desert Bugs are mutated to cause human extinction and the last hope of the survivors is to find the oasis. A team made up of tycoons, scientists, security chiefs, engineers and gangsters embarks on a perilous journey in an armoured tank to find the oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海上救難隊員阿傑為了生計及克服之前同伴遇難的陰影,再次乘坐漁船出海謀生,卻再次遭遇巨大的危機。在船上的人不僅要面對惡劣的暴雨天氣,還有海底未知生物正對著他們虎視眈眈。在茫茫大海中,猙獰相對的眾人更必須..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navy officer Ah Jie returns to the fleet to earn a living and tries to recover from the trauma of his comrades death. The fleet encounters severe rainstorm and has to face an unknown sea creature. In the face of adversity, everyone on board must overcome the challenges to trust and support each other in order to escape from danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 重案組臥底警員山哥向高級督察唯Sir發送線報,说大毒梟金先生將會親自主持一宗涉及金額達二千萬美元的毒品交易。其實這是個為了找出誰是臥底而設計的陷阱,山哥身份暴露後被黑幫追殺,而其臥底身份也突然被警方刪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Undercover cop Shan tips Inspector Wai on a USD20 million drug trade that will be dealt directly by drug boss Jin. However, this is a trap set by Jin to find the undercover. When Shans identity is revealed, he is hunted by the drug gang while his police identity has also been deleted. To prove himself a cop, Shan must uncover Jins conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀70年代的舊香港,處於英國殖民統治下的黑暗時代,警方與黑社會勾結,窮人深受其害。在貧民區的“鐵記飯店老闆娘鐵姐,帶領手下員工對抗惡勢力,保護被欺壓的老百姓。他們聯合正義的公民合力打擊黑幫,並與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the 1970s, Hong Kong was in a dark age under British colonization. The police collude with the triads and make the poor suffer. A restauranteur leads her staff to fight against the triads and protect the weak. They team up with the residents to combat the triads and fight against the corrupted police, finally restoring peace and harmony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天后武則天壽宴之際,房州城發生“赤目怪物傷人事件。狄仁傑奉命與不良人沈青青及徒弟陳江橋結成探案分隊前往調查,而所有證據似乎都表明幕後主謀正是被廢太子李顯,但狄卻敏銳地發現真相絕非如此簡單,背後蘊藏著..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Red-Eye Monster attacks Fang Zhou City on Empress Wus birthday. Detective Dee is assigned to investigate the case. While all clues apparently point to the deposed prince, Detective Dee realizes that there is a conspiracy behind. Together with another investigation team, Detective Dee finally unravels the truth of the mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 墨家機關術嫡系傳人沈拓接受無極監獄典獄長的邀請,與六名隊友進入機關城最底部,尋找墨家磁石,打開監獄機關。但墨家機關在城內佈局千變萬化,傳言至今從未有人能夠活著出來。沈拓為了救出妻子姜刃,及讓監獄里的人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shen Tuo, a descendant of Mohist Mechanism, is invited by the prison chief to find a magnet in the prison basement with a team of six. However, there is a rumour that no one can leave the basement alive. Determined to save his wife and free the prisoners, Shen embarks on a dangerous journey through the citys labyrinth of mechanism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天爺是江城最大的毒梟,行事謹慎,從不親自參與交易。平江市公安局禁毒大隊的大隊長陳昌榮為了抓住天爺,自願成為臥底進入天爺的販毒團夥,終極對決一觸即發。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Master Tien, the most powerful drug dealer in Jiang City, is always on the alert and never gets involved in any drug trafficking personally. To arrest Master Tien, the captain of the narcotics team at Ping Jiang City volunteers to be an undercover in Master Tiens drug gang, resulting in a fierce combat.

epg.programme_title_en: Sword Dynasty: The Treasure of Sword
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 巴山劍場被滅門後僥倖逃過一劫的夜策冷,迫於無奈假意歸順蘅王留在他身邊,伺機殺掉他為師傅報仇。江湖傳聞孤山劍藏在雲來鎮,蘅王派陳玄及夜策冷前往調查,而鎮上突然傳有血妖出沒。在調查途中,夜意外救了假扮捉妖..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sole survivor from a massacre, Ye pretends to be subservient to Emperor Heng and awaits a chance to avenge his masters death. Ye and Chen are assigned to investigate a case of a blood demon. In the process, Ye accidentally rescues Ji Zhen who poses as a monster hunter. With the help of Ji Zhen, Ye unravels the truth about the blood demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武周時期,禦史中丞胡顯德一家被殺,武則天派狄仁傑前往調查。狄調查發現,原本老實本分的胡離奇般參與了一場大案,此案可能是一宗案中案。在查案過程中,狄不斷遇見各種詭異事件,更有陰兵索命的傳言,案件一籌莫展..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Di Ren Jie is assigned by Empress Wu to investigate the massacre of Minister Hus family. In the process, he uncovers Hus involvement in a criminal case and encounters spooky incidents, as well as rumours of vengeful killing by hell guards. Di delves into the heart of the perplexing mystery, unravelling the truth behind it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武周時期,禦史中丞胡顯德一家被殺,武則天派狄仁傑前往調查。狄調查發現,原本老實本分的胡離奇般參與了一場大案,此案可能是一宗案中案。在查案過程中,狄不斷遇見各種詭異事件,更有陰兵索命的傳言,案件一籌莫展..

In the process, he uncovers Hus involvement in a criminal case and encounters spooky incidents, as well as rumours of vengeful killing by hell guards. Di delves into the heart of the perplexing mystery, unravelling the truth behind it.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie consists of four short stories: a fairy tale about a kid turning into a rabbit, a suspense story about a man trapped in a haunted wall during a date, a love story about a lad with supernatural power sacrificing his organ for his lover, and a fantasy tale about magical pleasures after eating the chicken soup noodles sold in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 火鍋店在香港深受街坊歡迎,店少東從父親手中接棒經營後卻遇上特殊時期,生意受挫,但少東仍然咬緊牙關,不肯辭退員工,期望生活早日重歸正常。一天,匪徒把火鍋店變成挾持人質的犯罪現場,而員工,顧客及未婚妻生命..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While hotpot restaurants thrive in Hong Kong, a young man taking over his fathers hotpot business faces tough times ahead. He remains resilient and insists on keeping all his staffs, hoping for a turnaround. When gangsters hold his staffs, customers and fiancée hostage in the restaurant one day, he vows to fight back and bring them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 九門的陸尋與同僚大山受命保護兵部尚書鄭巖,但鄭突然離奇死亡。陸在調查中發現舞女封如月與其兄封空空可疑,但空空卻意外失蹤。陸循著線索,帶著大山、如月來到黑澤城,在執行公務的過程中無意被捲入驚天陰謀。陸在..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lu and Da are assigned to protect a military officer, but he dies suddenly. As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

epg.programme_title_en: The Thousand Faces of Fei Jia
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 王小俠本是一個胸無大志,在市井街頭討生活的小鎮青年,與父親老瞎子生活在十隱鎮,唯一的願望就是能治好父親的眼疾。一次偶然令王小俠邂逅了沈藍兒,並意外地捲入了一場陰謀之中。而王小俠為了找能治好父親的眼疾方..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young man Wang Xiao Xia resides in a small town with his blind father. His only desire is to cure his fathers eye disease. One day, he encounters Shen Nan Er by chance and gets embroiled in a conspiracy. In his quest to heal his fathers eyes, he goes to the Qi Yin Sect and finally unveils his hidden identity, which was concealed by his father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝崇禎末年,正派與魔教勢不兩立互有爭鬥。白髮魔女練霓裳因此陷入一場江湖的腥風血雨當中,內裡更蘊含著重大陰謀。錦衣衛常安奉命暗中調查白髮魔女練霓裳,在追查的道路上,常安對練霓裳產生了莫名的情愫,要為練..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

Meanwhile, the snake clans descendant and two animal protection experts venture to the island to confirm the existence of the legendary Titan Snake, resulting in a fierce battle with the ruthless gang to preserve the islands ecology.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上古時期,因人類的貪念欲望所生成的魔王阿爾薩召集亡靈軍團征服了世界,而上古人類領袖以鮮血鑄成聖劍封印了阿爾薩。千百年後,阿爾薩破開封印,開始在東原大陸發起進攻。此時聖殿騎士團聯合東方巡夜山宮等武林門派..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In ancient times, Demon King Artha summons the dead spirit army to conquer the world, but is sealed by the holy sword. Thousand years later, Artha breaks the seal and launches an attack to the east. The holy chevaliers unite with the martial arts cults to find the holy sword, hoping to seal Artha again and save the people from his tyrannical reign.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雷霆安保公司的幽靈小隊,由林森帶領隊友執行解救女科學家南茜的任務。眾人救南後在撤離時見到一名小孩被關在籠裡,趕去營救,卻聽到槍響,之後全軍覆沒。於偉剛寫下小說“幽靈狙擊的一段,跟著一聲槍響,被擊中頭..

During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. It is not until he wakes up that Yu Wei realises he has become his novel’s character!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大荒城城主張塢為復活三千年前被皇帝打敗而封印於東海某處的赤睺,到處蠱惑人心,並指使各種妖怪在人間胡作非為。少年李靖學成下山後見此情景,堅信心中正義一路斬妖除魔,並與路途中遇到的薑子牙等人結為隊友,各顯..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Master of Da Huang City orchestrates demonic chaos on earth to revive Chi Hou, who was sealed by the Emperor three thousand years ago. After his martial arts training, Li Jing vows to vanquish the demons and uphold justice. Together with Jiang Zi Ya and team, he strives to save the people in a deadly battle against the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武林大會時,盟主霍長空與血魔羅決戰時輸了,血魔亦元氣大傷,危急關頭霍將功力注入劉晶體內,劉意外獲得內力。十四年後,劉在隅然機會下來到“霍家拳館,陰差陽錯遇到血魔羅重出江湖找霍家人報仇。有著霍長空功力..

Fourteen years later, Liu chances upon Huos martial arts school and meets Blood Demon who returns for vengeance against Huos clan. Liu fights Blood Demon with Huos legendary skills, upholding justice and protecting Huos clan in a deadly battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葛振為了拯救車遲國,加入了殺手組織都司府,成為十二暗軍的預備役,專門執行朝廷的秘密任務。葛振在師傅那裡學到白門五甲絕技,在查案時邂逅秋葵,兩人互生情愫。與此同時十二暗軍中最強的午馬被神秘人殺死,最終葛..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his country, Ge Zhen joins a killer squad assigned for secret government missions. It is when Ge Zhen investigates a case that he encounters Qiu Kui and they fall in love. At the same time, Wu Ma, the most powerful killer in the squad is mysteriously murdered. Can Ge Zhen and Qiu Kui be together, and can Ge Zhen rescue his country?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 弟弟杜家豪在上水鎮被水猴子殘殺,民國女法醫清伶為了探尋真相便前往上水鎮探尋原因。在這詭異的村莊,關於水猴子復仇的“詛咒接二連三發生。清伶携槍勇闖水怪禁地黑木林,而她力憑科學文明剷除水猴子的封建迷信,..

Armed with a gun, Qing ventures to the forbidden land of Water Monster and debunks superstitions with scientific facts, ultimately leading the villagers to fight against the evil forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A series of mysterious incidents happen when treasure is discovered in Long Yun Town, including killings of girls. As ill-intentioned martial artists arrive to uncover the treasure, Cop Lin, assigned by the mayor, teams up with a death row inmate to identify the murderer and uncover the truth, so as to safeguard the town and its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1925年,平靜的小鎮北海城突然闖入一條巨鱷,不斷有居民被廝殺吞噬。警察隊長鬍彪請了獵戶林七和他的徒弟來抓捕猛獸,林抓住巨鱷後還未鬆口氣卻發現傷人的巨鱷不止一條!在人鱷搏殺,命懸一線之間考驗的不僅是武..

A police inspector assigns Hunter Lin Qi and his disciples to catch the crocodile, but they soon discover that there are more than one. Fighting with the crocodiles becomes a test of physical strength, and the good and evil of human nature.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清河聶氏處理其祖傳藏刀古墓的危機時,兄長聶明玦帶領弟弟聶懷桑倆人攜手共渡難關,合力將古墓復原,確保聶氏族人平安。在過程中二人雖然有矛盾,但在經歷危難後,聶懷桑從膽小怕事的世家子弟變得成熟穩重,而聶明玦..

Despite conflicts between the siblings, Sang becomes more mature and responsible after overcoming the difficulties. As Jue gets to know his younger brother, he helps prepare him to become the future clan leader.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金傲為保護中華傲決與無敵大戰,在生命垂危的時候將中華傲決傳授給華英雄。然而擁有“天煞孤星命格的華英雄失去了父母及妻子,離開了兒女,潛心修煉二十年卻始終無法參悟中華傲決。最終,華為了所有中國人要與無敵..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jin Ao battles with Wu Di to preserve the Pride martial arts skill, which he passes to Hero Hua before he dies. Hua, who is born under the curse of the Star of Loneliness, leaves his family to practise the martial arts skill for 20 years, but still fails to master it. Can Hua finally master the skill and defeats Wu Di to save his people?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商朝末年,紂王暴虐殘害百姓。與此同時,通天教的仙人們接二連三地因為出手阻撓薑子牙帶領的周軍而喪命。通天教主因此動怒,憤然與申公豹聯手,利用萬仙殺陣企圖一舉清除周軍。薑子牙也結集楊戩、哪吒等眾仙一起對抗..

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 救世主靈明石猴曾賜予絕望女孩生存的希望,並許下守護終生的承諾。不料多年後,他與傲慢的三眼戰神展開一場毀天滅地的大戰,最終慘遭擊敗,金身碎裂墮入凡塵。失去神力的石猴,究竟能否重燃鬥志,打破命運枷鎖,再度..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 真人秀節目The Ultimate BROcation,跟隨四位不同國家的藝人玩轉男人遊樂之旅 - 香港,盡情狂歡並展開瘋狂野性的冒險,為觀眾們帶來充滿男性狂野魅力的視聽享受!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A hilarious reality show about four famous male celebrities from different countries on an all-expenses-paid fantasy vacation in Hong Kong, tailor-made for the “bros”!

Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 和卡昆比族群一起返回巢穴,這個族群正在哀悼兩隻失去的幼崽.偶遇一個鬣狗窩和一頭獅子試圖放倒一頭水牛的場面,然後跟上曼齊族群的步伐,目睹牠們與一隻豹子和一群憤怒大象的對峙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head back to the den with the Kakumbi, who are mourning the loss of two pups. Chance upon a hyena den and a lion pride trying to take down a buffalo, then catch up with the Manzi, who are in a standoff with a leopard and a herd of angry elephants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哈德遜灣低窪地是北美最大濕地的一部分. 超過300,000平方公里的厚苔沼,一處巨大的沼澤地,放眼望去可以看到以水浸泡的泥煤,苔蘚和矮木的特色生態.曾被視為荒地,但現在人們都知道這些沼澤對地球上的生命尤關重要.在全球的濕地中存在的二氧化碳跟大氣中一樣多,泥煤地生態系統是地球上最有效的碳吸儲庫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hudson Bay lowlands are part of North Americas largest wetland. Over 300,000 square kilometers of muskeg, a vast bogland as far as the eye can see characterized by water soaked peat, mosses and stunted trees. Once thought of as barren wastela...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的龍山是其中一處擁有大陸上最壯麗美景的地方.它的氣候和生態梯度急劇變化,亦影響著陸空生物和天上猛禽的生活環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: South Africas Drakensberg is one of the continents most impressive landscapes. It is home to sharp climatic and ecological gradients as physical conditions change for both land-based creatures and the Raptors that swirl in the skies above.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在坦桑尼亞北部,高聳的山脈形成一個巨大的山谷.它被古老的火山所滋養,坡道為生命提供了多元化的棲息地,而它巨大的重心地帶即使在最乾燥的時期也能保存水源.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In north Tanzania, towering mountains line a dramatic valley. Enriched by ancient volcanoes, its slopes provide a variety of habitats for life to thrive and its great centerpiece holds water through even the driest of times.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 埃塞俄比亞的塞米恩國家公園住著地球上一些最稀有的生物.窺探非洲最高峰的生活,那是在草原遊走毛茸茸的獅尾狒,神出鬼沒的塞米恩狼和有角的瓦利亞野山羊的最後堡壘.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Simien Mountains National Park in Ethiopia is home to some of the rarest creatures on earth. Take a glimpse into life on some of the highest peaks in Africa, in the last stronghold of shaggy, grass-grazing Geladas, elusive Simien wolves and horned...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 進入南部旱地是一趟非洲南部最遠端,最乾旱和極端環境的旅程.我們到訪了幾乎不降雨,既壯觀又危險的地方,為了尋找適應力極強的動物,並了解牠們生存的秘密.從最大的哺乳類到最敏捷的昆蟲,甚至是世上僅有幽靈般的魚類,南部旱地擁有非凡的居民,生活在世上其中一處最荒涼的棲息地接受日常挑戰,牠們都站在同一陣線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Southern Drylands is a journey into the most arid and extreme environments in the furthest reaches of southern Africa. We go to spectacular but treacherous places where almost no rain falls, to find incredibly resilient creatures and learn the...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現已乾涸的埃托沙曾是一個大湖,現在只有夏季降雨期間才能季節性地補充水分.但當埃托沙充滿水時,無數的水鳥就會聚集在淺湖中繁殖,最常見的是大小紅鸛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Etosha was once a great lake that dried up and now only fills with water seasonally during the summer rains. Once the Etosha pan is full of water, a myriad of water birds congregate in the shallow lake to breed, most notably Greater and lesser fla...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著南非的奧蘭治河,從它的源頭到大西洋出海處.我們在沿途能遇到各樣的棲息地和當中的生物,從理察斯維德的旱地到奧赫拉比斯的美景; 這是一個線形綠洲的故事.我們將揭示生物如何適應其河道,並發現豐富的動植物世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the course of South Africas Orange river from its origins to where it spills out into the Atlantic Ocean. Along the way we encounter a diverse range of habitats and the creatures they support, from the dry lands of the Richtersveld to the ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 旱季即將結束,孟巴肯高獅群面臨前所未有的艱難時刻.牠們的女族長和最強獵人蘇拉比被一頭水牛所傷,讓她命懸一線.同時,彌敦找到了獅群中最年輕的成員之一,孤身走失的小獅斑點.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The all-female Hollywood pride have been in exile after being attacked by the four Nomad brothers. But their leader, Ava, decides to lead her family south to the heart of their territory for a showdown with the Nomads.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個澳洲家庭在南非的一個古老狩獵牧場進行修復.他們的目標是重建過度生長的棲息地,建立生態旅游牧場,並允許包括獵食者在內的自然野生動植物搬回家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An Australian family go on an adventure to restore an old hunting ranch in South Africa. Their goal is to rebuild the overgrown habitat, create an eco-tourism ranch, and allow the natural wildlife, including predators, to move back in.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社區經營的瑞特提大象庇護所,在這裡,人類的代理媽媽們透過玩耍教導小象如何在野外生存,並細心地照顧與陪伴牠們成長.與那隻失去象鼻的小象隆烏洛建立情感連結,同時了解為什麼六歲的小象凱勒勒那場神祕的疾病,可能會讓牠的重返野外之路被迫延遲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Longuro and see why six-year-old Keleles mysterious illness could delay his release.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在道別的傷痛與對未來的希望之間尋求平衡,因為這一代被救援的大象,終於迎來了重返自由的時刻.歡迎瑞特提大家庭的新成員:一頭從水坑中被救出的象寶寶,以及一匹名叫奇希瑪的斑馬,牠曾因創傷而驚恐不安.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象:克雷格,帕斯卡與以掃.深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言,複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the worlds largest land mammal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往科克群島旅遊,這是3000只座頭鯨準備交配和撫養幼崽的首選目的地.見證巨蚌和綠海龜在島嶼巨大的珊瑚礁中繁衍生息,並一瞥我們的進化歷史.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to the Cook Islands, the destination of choice for 3,000 humpback whales ready to mate and raise their young. Witness giant clams and green turtles thriving in the islands massive coral reef and get a glimpse into our evolutionary past.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然中最古老,最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界.和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證鬥士們如何在非洲大草原的旱季中爭奪水源和其他珍貴資源.親眼目擊獅子和大象為爭奪地盤的激烈爭鬥,螞蟻襲擊白蟻丘,以及蜜獾與毒蛇聯袂上演的危險探戈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. See a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound, and a honey badgers risky dance with a deadly snake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜訪澳洲最狡猾的鬥士和他們驚人的武器庫.從袋鼠的致命拳擊和紅背蜘蛛精密設計的陷阱,暸解他們如何運用這些必殺技擊退敵人,同時應對氣候變化的侵害.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against Australias wiliest gladiators and their impressive arsenals. Learn if these weapons, such as the kangaroos deadly boxing moves and the redback spiders precision-engineered traps, can help them survive the ravages of climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喀爾巴阡山脈橫跨七個歐洲國家;它有著廣闊的原始森林,陡峭的峽谷和孤立的山峰,為這片大陸最具魅力的生物提供了寶貴的避難所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join a mother brown bear as she struggles to find food for her two young cubs while teaching them essential skills for the harsh winter ahead. Then visit a pair of tiny lynx kittens as they begin to venture away from the safety of their den.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現代動物始祖演化出的第一個感官是化學感官:牠們能夠檢測環境中的化學物質.這有助動物始祖尋找獵物和配偶,並從遠處感知逐漸靠近的捕食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The first sense to evolve in the first animals was chemoreception: being able to detect chemicals in the animals environment. This helps animals find prey and mates, and to sense predators from a distance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 育空地區是一片真正的荒野,是世上最後的荒野之一.這片遼闊土地的名字來自它最長的河流,該地區的土著居民骨池人稱之為「預官也」,或稱「大河」.育空河是北美第三長的河流,流經寬闊的山谷和狹窄的河道,向西北延展超過3000公里至狂風暴雨的白令海.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Yukon is a true wilderness, one of the last on Earth. The vast land got its name from its longest river, which the Gwichin, one of the indigenous people of the region, call Yu-kun- ah, or, the great river. The third longest waterway in No...

epg.programme_title_tc: 美國野生邊界:北部揭祕 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著美加之間最長的邊境,野生動物猶如同時活在兩個世界.動物在障礙和矛盾的規則間如履薄冰,一念天堂一念地獄.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trail Atlantic puffins, Prairie rattlesnakes, Alaskan caribou and other animals as they travel across the international boundary between the U.S. and Canada. See how they can move from safety to target by crossing a line they had no say in creating.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在馬達加斯加偏遠的伯倫蒂保育區,兩個環尾狐猴派別因正面臨旱季日益嚴峻的挑戰而拉起戰幔.這些魅力非凡的狐猴僅在馬達加斯加島上被發現,黑白相間的尾巴十分突出,牠們活在女權體制中,每個幫派都有嚴格的等級制度,並擁有各自嚴守的領土.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the dry season approaches, tensions rise on Lemur Island, both between rival gangs and within their own ranks. Get a view from the battlefield as the female leaders fiercely defend their turf, while their newborn infants cling to them for safety.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在馬達加斯加偏遠的貝倫地保育區,旱季正對當地的環尾狐猴造成巨大的損耗.隨著覓食的難度增加,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹之間的關係越發緊張.隨著食物和水源日益稀缺,入侵者亦出現在附近.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As food and water become scarce, Crystal, the fierce leader of the Ruins gang, sets her sights on rival Katis territory and its neighboring fruit trees. Watch as Crystals move and a raid by outside invaders lead to dire consequences for one troop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在長期乾旱過後,第一場雨的降臨大大地紓緩了馬達加斯加貝倫地保育區的環尾狐猴幫.森林裡的食物十分充足,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹率領族群離開領土大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The drought is finally over, but traversing the forest for food is still a gamble. See some leaders take the risk, leaving home territories undefended to feast on a cicada boom. When they return, trespassers are ready for a fight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狐?島上的幫派奮力保持族群的健康和領土的完整.隨著嬰兒們成長,牠們的階級架構開始出現裂縫,權力備受考驗.由學習食甚麼,交友,結盟到在族群中找到一席之地,狐?島上嬰兒的生活跟成年狐?一樣艱辛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the babies grow, new power struggles break out in each troop. Watch as every member, from fierce Queen Crystal to low-ranking Erica, jockeys for position. Meanwhile, the babies start to understand how allies and enemies will shape their future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 貝倫地保育區的環尾狐猴過得動盪不安,族群急忙利用早前降雨後的短暫大餐,因為隨之而來又是乾燥日子.隨著牠們的幼崽長大,覓食的壓力變得比之前更大.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The pressure to find food reaches new heights and throws the reserve into turmoil. Witness fractures emerge within the ranks, dividing the gangs and leading Crystal, the indomitable leader of the Ruins gang, to face a challenge like none before.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 超聰明的杜利亞和沙利巴在帕拉斯島失蹤,要趕在牠們惹事前找到牠們.另外,流感病毒肆虐明猩學園,令園內人人自危.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The race is on to find Tulia and Zalipa, who are missing from Palas Island. And after months of convalescence, Beni returns to forest school but faces another setback at the milk bucket. Meanwhile, the vets keep a close eye on pregnant Dilla.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 工作人員正計劃下一輪釋放行動,而學園內的幾名準畢業生前途未卜.經過九個月,迪娜分娩的時刻到了,但卻出了亂子,新家庭的未來變得不確定.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fate of several graduates awaits the next round of wild releases. Meanwhile, runaway Zalipa is found, but her partner in crime, Tulia, is still missing. And Baby Clarita has a complete meltdown as the vets perform surgery on her mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 團隊作最終嘗試,讓抗拒的母親迪娜與她的新生兒迪利娜重聚,每個人都十分緊張.伽嬅和伽麗塔正在去往自由的最後旅程,但一場危險的洪水阻礙牠們的行程,並威脅到每個人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trouble brews when the team makes the final attempt to reunite reluctant mother Dilla with her new baby Delilah. And Alba, the worlds only known albino orangutan, amazes her friends with her unique approach to termite foraging.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春回大地,農場裡生機處處.雙胞胎羔羊拿利和科嬅,以及其他新生兒在草地上歡騰.小牛孤兒莫莉努力生活,而母豬姬絲則有一位情人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its spring, and the farm is bursting with new life. Watch a ewe give birth to twins, an orphaned Hereford calf struggle to find a surrogate mother, and the top hen nestle down in her maternity coop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季意味著動物可以在空曠的草地上漫遊,也導致了海福特牛群的不和,還有黃牛間的戰鬥.赫布里底羊進行逃脫,倒霉的牧羊犬謝茜有了第一次驅攏的機會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience life on the farm as things heat up for summer. Watch animals swelter in a rare heatwave, try to stay cool in the nearby freshwater stream, and stash supplies for fall.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證棲身於西海岸的不同物種,如何忍受嚴冬並迎接初春的來臨.親眼目睹在強風下的紅鹿激戰,在風聲呼嘯的暴風雨中歡迎海豹寶寶來臨,以及象鯊群的回歸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Endure winter and early spring on the west coast, where animals eke out a chilly existence. Watch red deer battle on windswept Inishvickillane, welcome seal pups amid howling storms on the Inishkea islands, and view the return of the basking sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪世界著名的斯凱利群島,穿梭令人眼花繚亂的峭壁,並探索一座有1500年歷史的修道院.拜訪棲身曼島的薙鳥和座頭鯨,然後在克萊爾追逐矮小的鼩鼱.最後來到阿蘭群島,一睹秋季的壯觀景象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore a 1,500-year-old monastery among the dizzying crags of the world-famous Skellig Islands. Spy Manx shearwaters and humpback whales, then chase after pygmy shrews on Clare before heading to the Aran Islands for a peek at an autumn spectacle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探全球昆蟲數量銳減對地球可能造成的衝擊,揭露我們千百年來對這些微小伙伴的依賴,以及牠們在生態系統中所扮演的關鍵角色.了解人類與昆蟲之間的微妙關係如何面臨危機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at what a global insect decline could do to our planet. Uncover our historical dependence on these tiny animals, the vital roles they play in our ecosystems, and the reasons why our fragile relationship to them is in danger worldwide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解蜜蜂,蝴蝶與飛蛾如何讓田野和樹林充滿生機.想像如果這些勤勞的蟲蟲消失,世界會如何變樣.見證神祕的蝴蝶遷徙之旅,以及飛蛾如何巧妙地躲避飢餓的蝙蝠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how bees, butterflies, moths, and other pollinators keep our fields and forests fruitful, and weigh what life would be like if these busy bugs vanished. Witness a mysterious butterfly pilgrimage and a moths clever way of escaping hungry bats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 迎戰專為殺戮而生的掠食性昆蟲,了解具有武術家身手的螳螂如何令人畏懼,然後跟隨大開殺戒的蜻蜓在半空中狩獵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against predatory insects that are tailor-made for killing. See why the terrifying praying mantis has the agility of a martial artist and an appetite for everything from flies to hummingbirds, then go hunting in mid-air with deadly dragonflies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然的清潔專家學習環境衛生課.了解甲蟲如何利用尖牙與毒液等生物武器,巧妙維持生態平衡,並認識超過六千種的糞金龜──這些無名英雄才是維護地球健康的關鍵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get a sanitation lesson from natures original cleanup crew. Learn how beetles keep ecosystems in balance with clever biological weapons like tusks and toxic sprays, then see why the 6,000-plus species of dung beetles are the worlds unsung heroes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蜂巢內,成千上萬的小動物朝著一個共同目標努力:群體的生存.但是個別蜜蜂的生活又如何?秘「蜜」日記講述這個故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bees Diary tells that story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證棲身於西海岸的不同物種,如何忍受嚴冬並迎接初春的來臨.親眼目睹在強風下的紅鹿激戰,在風聲呼嘯的暴風雨中歡迎海豹寶寶來臨,以及象鯊群的回歸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Endure winter and early spring on the west coast, where animals eke out a chilly existence. Watch red deer battle on windswept Inishvickillane, welcome seal pups amid howling storms on the Inishkea islands, and view the return of the basking sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪世界著名的斯凱利群島,穿梭令人眼花繚亂的峭壁,並探索一座有1500年歷史的修道院.拜訪棲身曼島的薙鳥和座頭鯨,然後在克萊爾追逐矮小的鼩鼱.最後來到阿蘭群島,一睹秋季的壯觀景象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore a 1,500-year-old monastery among the dizzying crags of the world-famous Skellig Islands. Spy Manx shearwaters and humpback whales, then chase after pygmy shrews on Clare before heading to the Aran Islands for a peek at an autumn spectacle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探全球昆蟲數量銳減對地球可能造成的衝擊,揭露我們千百年來對這些微小伙伴的依賴,以及牠們在生態系統中所扮演的關鍵角色.了解人類與昆蟲之間的微妙關係如何面臨危機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at what a global insect decline could do to our planet. Uncover our historical dependence on these tiny animals, the vital roles they play in our ecosystems, and the reasons why our fragile relationship to them is in danger worldwide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解蜜蜂,蝴蝶與飛蛾如何讓田野和樹林充滿生機.想像如果這些勤勞的蟲蟲消失,世界會如何變樣.見證神祕的蝴蝶遷徙之旅,以及飛蛾如何巧妙地躲避飢餓的蝙蝠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how bees, butterflies, moths, and other pollinators keep our fields and forests fruitful, and weigh what life would be like if these busy bugs vanished. Witness a mysterious butterfly pilgrimage and a moths clever way of escaping hungry bats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 迎戰專為殺戮而生的掠食性昆蟲,了解具有武術家身手的螳螂如何令人畏懼,然後跟隨大開殺戒的蜻蜓在半空中狩獵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against predatory insects that are tailor-made for killing. See why the terrifying praying mantis has the agility of a martial artist and an appetite for everything from flies to hummingbirds, then go hunting in mid-air with deadly dragonflies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然的清潔專家學習環境衛生課.了解甲蟲如何利用尖牙與毒液等生物武器,巧妙維持生態平衡,並認識超過六千種的糞金龜──這些無名英雄才是維護地球健康的關鍵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get a sanitation lesson from natures original cleanup crew. Learn how beetles keep ecosystems in balance with clever biological weapons like tusks and toxic sprays, then see why the 6,000-plus species of dung beetles are the worlds unsung heroes.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bees Diary tells that story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 觸覺能讓物種感知各種物理力量所帶的感覺,包括得知咬傷,感受溫度變化和不同質地.一些動物對非常微弱的振動特別敏感,牠們能從中獲得大量關於環境的訊息.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sense of touch is useful to feel physical forces such as bites, changes in temperature and texture. Some animals have become extra sensitive to very faint vibrations, which gives them a lot of information about their environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界.和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來認識小雌豹奇帕祖亞的魅力,她受到母親的悉心照顧,因此從未需要自己捕獵.這是她生命中第一次獨自生活,她能否絕地求生,培養出所需的狩獵技能?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 野狗群的世界正在面對一場巨變,他們豐富的狩獵地正受到斑點鬣狗群的威脅.脆弱的狗寶寶已開始挨餓,因為無情的獵食者對手偷走了他們的食物,最終還突擊他們的棲身地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Enter the world of a wild dog pack whose bountiful hunting grounds are threatened when a clan of spotted hyenas moves in nearby. The vulnerable pups start to go hungry as the scavenging rivals steal their food and eventually raid their den.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與非洲森林象一同穿越納米比亞沙漠,窺探牠們如何在缺乏食物與遮蔽的環境中保持涼爽.了解這頭巨獸如何挑選特定植物充飢,挖掘水井,並翻越無盡的沙丘尋找珍貴水源.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across the Namibian desert with the bush elephant and learn how it keeps its cool in a place with little food or shade. Discover how this giant consumes specific plants, digs wells, and hikes endless dunes in a quest to find precious water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著葉子的變化,農場裡的動物露出野性.公羊羅傑和哈米殊就像擁有大角般對決,爭奪霸主地位.母雞莎莉飛過雞舍,在季末遊覽農場.母豬舒娜生下小豬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch life on the farm adjust as the leaves start to turn, from the sheep whose woolly coats keep them warm during the first frost to the bees that feed on the last bit of nectar before hibernation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 視覺是最令人驚嘆的感官,為物種帶來無窮的適應能力.不同動物的眼睛賦予牠們截然不同的視覺,在某些情況下甚至讓人「眼界大開」.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seeing the world is one of the most amazing animal adaptations. Different types of eyes give animals different types of vision, and in some cases they can be extraordinary.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​帶你發現那座位於波濤之下,眾城之中最奇幻壯麗的城市,那裡是愛情滋長與通勤旅者聚集之地,珊瑚礁主幹道宛如繁忙街道,浪漫與遷徙生命在其中交錯如潮.跟隨一隻懷抱愛意的綠蠵龜,展開牠的尋愛旅程;坐下來,陪伴一位鶴鴕爸爸細心守護他那剛孵化的小寶寶們.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the most fantastic city of them all lying beneath the waves, where romance and migratory commuters flood the coral reefs main highways. Follow a green sea turtle looking for love and sit in with a cassowary dad tending his newborn chicks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​感受盛夏降臨時的灼熱氣息,體型龐大的海蝸牛試圖抵禦一群貪吃珊瑚的海星幫派入侵.與礁鯊一同巡遊黑夜,尋找宵夜佳餚;驚嘆鸚哥魚如何巧妙變身,以滑溜偽裝度過危機四伏的漫漫長夜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat of summers arrival as supersize sea snails try to fend off an invading gang of coral-hungry starfish. Accompany reef sharks as they prowl for a midnight meal and marvel at the slippery disguise a parrotfish uses to survive the night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪婆羅洲的紅樹林,與灣鱷一同航行,並見證牠們在盤根錯節的水生植物之間穿梭自如.了解牠們如何利用環境調節體溫,以及如何憑藉驚人的耐性一躍成為頂尖獵手.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate a mangrove forest in Borneo with the saltwater crocodile, which is perfectly suited to life among the watery roots. Discover how this reptile uses the environment to regulate its temperature and why its epic patience makes it a super hunter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 農場裡的動物為一年中最短的日子專心準備.為免冬天太沉悶,牛群享受假日美食和演唱會.母豬舒娜忙著照料九隻貪玩的小豬,而公羊哈米殊被大眾情人邦妮嫌棄.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is coming, and the animals take advantage of autumns final bounty before the cold, barren months ahead. Watch some creatures search for respite indoors, while others arrive from far northern climates to settle in the ploughed fields.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來認識小雌豹奇帕祖亞的魅力,她受到母親的悉心照顧,因此從未需要自己捕獵.這是她生命中第一次獨自生活,她能否絕地求生,培養出所需的狩獵技能?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 野狗群的世界正在面對一場巨變,他們豐富的狩獵地正受到斑點鬣狗群的威脅.脆弱的狗寶寶已開始挨餓,因為無情的獵食者對手偷走了他們的食物,最終還突擊他們的棲身地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Enter the world of a wild dog pack whose bountiful hunting grounds are threatened when a clan of spotted hyenas moves in nearby. The vulnerable pups start to go hungry as the scavenging rivals steal their food and eventually raid their den.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解蜜蜂,蝴蝶與飛蛾如何讓田野和樹林充滿生機.想像如果這些勤勞的蟲蟲消失,世界會如何變樣.見證神祕的蝴蝶遷徙之旅,以及飛蛾如何巧妙地躲避飢餓的蝙蝠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how bees, butterflies, moths, and other pollinators keep our fields and forests fruitful, and weigh what life would be like if these busy bugs vanished. Witness a mysterious butterfly pilgrimage and a moths clever way of escaping hungry bats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 所有的運動都會產生聲波;有些物種成功演化出器官來檢測空氣或水中的聲波,以感知環境中的運動.齊來暸解這些動物的敏銳聽覺.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sound waves are produced by movement. Animals have evolved organs to detect those sound waves in the air or water to perceive movements in their environment. These are some of the animals that have mastered the sense of hearing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​帶你發現那座位於波濤之下,眾城之中最奇幻壯麗的城市,那裡是愛情滋長與通勤旅者聚集之地,珊瑚礁主幹道宛如繁忙街道,浪漫與遷徙生命在其中交錯如潮.跟隨一隻懷抱愛意的綠蠵龜,展開牠的尋愛旅程;坐下來,陪伴一位鶴鴕爸爸細心守護他那剛孵化的小寶寶們.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat of summers arrival as supersize sea snails try to fend off an invading gang of coral-hungry starfish. Accompany reef sharks as they prowl for a midnight meal and marvel at the slippery disguise a parrotfish uses to survive the night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證鬥士們如何在非洲大草原的旱季中爭奪水源和其他珍貴資源.親眼目擊獅子和大象為爭奪地盤的激烈爭鬥,螞蟻襲擊白蟻丘,以及蜜獾與毒蛇聯袂上演的危險探戈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. See a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound, and a honey badgers risky dance with a deadly snake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的秋天帶來機會.非洲毛皮海獅,白喉猴,變色龍和黑斑羚等對秋季有所反應.秋天引發了許多動物的生活變化.稀有生物露面,獵食者聚集起來製造優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As fall sweeps across America and trees are set ablaze with color, animals are faced with make-or-break decisions. Find out how bald eagles, beavers, and other creatures prepare for the colder, darker, and leaner months ahead.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的冬天帶來乾旱,冰雪和風暴.在此生活的動物必須與天氣,土地和彼此競爭.獵豹,海豹,禿鷹和狐獴.雨水終於結束旱季,並引發了生命的爆發性發展.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is the ultimate challenge for wildlife across America. Will they escape to milder southern climates or stay put and tough out the season? See how different creatures respond to the brutal cold and blizzards that blanket the North.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅毛猩猩是叢林中的建築大師.跟隨麥克斯來到婆羅洲的雨林,一起探索這種獨居靈長類動物的築巢藝術.然後見證麥克斯如何嘗試逃離滿佈昆蟲的地面,並從紅毛猩猩身上學習自然界工程技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungles master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primates natural engineering prowess.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭南島的西南角被巨大的山脈和蠻荒的太平洋所封閉.稀有的企鵝每天都被逼與巨型胡氏海獅進行貓捉老鼠的遊戲.而海獅也生活在一個動蕩的世界,幼獅必須對抗大自然才能生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience unbelievable acts of courage and loyalty by creatures trying to survive in the remote wilderness of New Zealands South Island. Face forest penguins feast and famine cycles, and explore the tumultuous world of newborn sea lions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 迎戰專為殺戮而生的掠食性昆蟲,了解具有武術家身手的螳螂如何令人畏懼,然後跟隨大開殺戒的蜻蜓在半空中狩獵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against predatory insects that are tailor-made for killing. See why the terrifying praying mantis has the agility of a martial artist and an appetite for everything from flies to hummingbirds, then go hunting in mid-air with deadly dragonflies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的冬天帶來乾旱,冰雪和風暴.在此生活的動物必須與天氣,土地和彼此競爭.獵豹,海豹,禿鷹和狐獴.雨水終於結束旱季,並引發了生命的爆發性發展.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is the ultimate challenge for wildlife across America. Will they escape to milder southern climates or stay put and tough out the season? See how different creatures respond to the brutal cold and blizzards that blanket the North.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅毛猩猩是叢林中的建築大師.跟隨麥克斯來到婆羅洲的雨林,一起探索這種獨居靈長類動物的築巢藝術.然後見證麥克斯如何嘗試逃離滿佈昆蟲的地面,並從紅毛猩猩身上學習自然界工程技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungles master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primates natural engineering prowess.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭南島的西南角被巨大的山脈和蠻荒的太平洋所封閉.稀有的企鵝每天都被逼與巨型胡氏海獅進行貓捉老鼠的遊戲.而海獅也生活在一個動蕩的世界,幼獅必須對抗大自然才能生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience unbelievable acts of courage and loyalty by creatures trying to survive in the remote wilderness of New Zealands South Island. Face forest penguins feast and famine cycles, and explore the tumultuous world of newborn sea lions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​帶你發現那座位於波濤之下,眾城之中最奇幻壯麗的城市,那裡是愛情滋長與通勤旅者聚集之地,珊瑚礁主幹道宛如繁忙街道,浪漫與遷徙生命在其中交錯如潮.跟隨一隻懷抱愛意的綠蠵龜,展開牠的尋愛旅程;坐下來,陪伴一位鶴鴕爸爸細心守護他那剛孵化的小寶寶們.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the most fantastic city of them all lying beneath the waves, where romance and migratory commuters flood the coral reefs main highways. Follow a green sea turtle looking for love and sit in with a cassowary dad tending his newborn chicks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​感受盛夏降臨時的灼熱氣息,體型龐大的海蝸牛試圖抵禦一群貪吃珊瑚的海星幫派入侵.與礁鯊一同巡遊黑夜,尋找宵夜佳餚;驚嘆鸚哥魚如何巧妙變身,以滑溜偽裝度過危機四伏的漫漫長夜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat of summers arrival as supersize sea snails try to fend off an invading gang of coral-hungry starfish. Accompany reef sharks as they prowl for a midnight meal and marvel at the slippery disguise a parrotfish uses to survive the night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證鬥士們如何在非洲大草原的旱季中爭奪水源和其他珍貴資源.親眼目擊獅子和大象為爭奪地盤的激烈爭鬥,螞蟻襲擊白蟻丘,以及蜜獾與毒蛇聯袂上演的危險探戈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. See a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound, and a honey badgers risky dance with a deadly snake.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against predatory insects that are tailor-made for killing. See why the terrifying praying mantis has the agility of a martial artist and an appetite for everything from flies to hummingbirds, then go hunting in mid-air with deadly dragonflies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 某些動物擁有人類難以想像的感官,牠們能憑藉這些超能力來完全很多奇妙的事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some animals have senses that humans cant even conceive. With those powers they can do marvelous things.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的秋天帶來機會.非洲毛皮海獅,白喉猴,變色龍和黑斑羚等對秋季有所反應.秋天引發了許多動物的生活變化.稀有生物露面,獵食者聚集起來製造優勢.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is the ultimate challenge for wildlife across America. Will they escape to milder southern climates or stay put and tough out the season? See how different creatures respond to the brutal cold and blizzards that blanket the North.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜訪澳洲最狡猾的鬥士和他們驚人的武器庫.從袋鼠的致命拳擊和紅背蜘蛛精密設計的陷阱,暸解他們如何運用這些必殺技擊退敵人,同時應對氣候變化的侵害.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against Australias wiliest gladiators and their impressive arsenals. Learn if these weapons, such as the kangaroos deadly boxing moves and the redback spiders precision-engineered traps, can help them survive the ravages of climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨溫斯頓和姐妹花搬進新建的居所,並努力學習野外生存技能.目睹雅思敏和雅拉在幼兒園中的權力鬥爭,然後關注不安分的幼熊維克多;因為牠突然跛腳,野放的日子要一再延後.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bone up on outdoor skills as Winston and the X girls move into their new fresh-air enclosure, and witness Yasmine and Yaras kindergarten power struggle. Then look over restless yearling Victor, whose sudden limp pushes back his release date.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與雅思敏和雅拉一起在雨中嬉戲和享受攀爬的樂趣,並跟隨溫斯頓在新水池中的暢泳.與羅傑和史蒂夫一起尋找掉落的無線電項圈,並見證兩群夏季幼熊的首次相遇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the joys of rain and climbing with Yasmine and Yara, and watch Winston take a dip in his new pool. Go hunting for dropped radio collars with Roger and Steve, then see what happens when the two groups of summer cubs come face-to-face.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麥克斯來到盧安達的森林追蹤黑猩猩,他試圖說服這些強壯的猴子相信他是朋友而非敵人.一起學習在叢林覓食的關鍵技巧,並見證黑猩猩複雜的家庭動態,包括梳理毛髮和社交活動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track chimpanzees through the Rwandan forest with Max, who tries to convince these powerful monkeys that hes a friend, not a foe. Pick up some key tips on jungle dining and witness complex family dynamics, including grooming and socializing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新西蘭西南部,深邃的峽灣和潮汐形成的潟湖被綠色的雨林覆蓋.生活在黑暗峽灣港的生物通常棲息在深海.隨著冬季將至,寬吻海豚必須逃離牠們冰冷的峽灣,而在山河中,新西蘭長鰭鰻細聽大海的呼喚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how winters arrival triggers animal survival instincts in southwestern New Zealand. Track dolphins as they move to warmer waters to give their calves a fighting chance, and join longfin eels on an epic migration to their spawning grounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然的清潔專家學習環境衛生課.了解甲蟲如何利用尖牙與毒液等生物武器,巧妙維持生態平衡,並認識超過六千種的糞金龜──這些無名英雄才是維護地球健康的關鍵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get a sanitation lesson from natures original cleanup crew. Learn how beetles keep ecosystems in balance with clever biological weapons like tusks and toxic sprays, then see why the 6,000-plus species of dung beetles are the worlds unsung heroes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的冬天帶來乾旱,冰雪和風暴.在此生活的動物必須與天氣,土地和彼此競爭.獵豹,海豹,禿鷹和狐獴.雨水終於結束旱季,並引發了生命的爆發性發展.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is the ultimate challenge for wildlife across America. Will they escape to milder southern climates or stay put and tough out the season? See how different creatures respond to the brutal cold and blizzards that blanket the North.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然的清潔專家學習環境衛生課.了解甲蟲如何利用尖牙與毒液等生物武器,巧妙維持生態平衡,並認識超過六千種的糞金龜──這些無名英雄才是維護地球健康的關鍵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get a sanitation lesson from natures original cleanup crew. Learn how beetles keep ecosystems in balance with clever biological weapons like tusks and toxic sprays, then see why the 6,000-plus species of dung beetles are the worlds unsung heroes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨溫斯頓和姐妹花搬進新建的居所,並努力學習野外生存技能.目睹雅思敏和雅拉在幼兒園中的權力鬥爭,然後關注不安分的幼熊維克多;因為牠突然跛腳,野放的日子要一再延後.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bone up on outdoor skills as Winston and the X girls move into their new fresh-air enclosure, and witness Yasmine and Yaras kindergarten power struggle. Then look over restless yearling Victor, whose sudden limp pushes back his release date.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與雅思敏和雅拉一起在雨中嬉戲和享受攀爬的樂趣,並跟隨溫斯頓在新水池中的暢泳.與羅傑和史蒂夫一起尋找掉落的無線電項圈,並見證兩群夏季幼熊的首次相遇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the joys of rain and climbing with Yasmine and Yara, and watch Winston take a dip in his new pool. Go hunting for dropped radio collars with Roger and Steve, then see what happens when the two groups of summer cubs come face-to-face.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人類擁有敏銳的感官,亦是我們能探索環境的關鍵.不同感官向我們提供生存所需的重要訊息.然而,部份物種也能掌握這些感官,並透過演化轉化成生物工程的奇蹟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Humans have sharp senses, which we use to explore our environment. They give us the information we need to survive. But some animals have taken those senses and, through evolution, turned them into marvels of biological engineering.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨溫斯頓和姐妹花搬進新建的居所,並努力學習野外生存技能.目睹雅思敏和雅拉在幼兒園中的權力鬥爭,然後關注不安分的幼熊維克多;因為牠突然跛腳,野放的日子要一再延後.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the joys of rain and climbing with Yasmine and Yara, and watch Winston take a dip in his new pool. Go hunting for dropped radio collars with Roger and Steve, then see what happens when the two groups of summer cubs come face-to-face.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喀爾巴阡山脈橫跨七個歐洲國家;它有著廣闊的原始森林,陡峭的峽谷和孤立的山峰,為這片大陸最具魅力的生物提供了寶貴的避難所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join a mother brown bear as she struggles to find food for her two young cubs while teaching them essential skills for the harsh winter ahead. Then visit a pair of tiny lynx kittens as they begin to venture away from the safety of their den.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麥可斯探索斯里蘭卡,窺探懶熊常被誤解的神秘世界.見證這種看似人畜無害,毛髮蓬亂的動物,如何無畏地擊退豹子,並觀察牠們如何努力獲取所需的營養.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peek inside the secret world of the fearless, often misunderstood sloth bear. Travel to Sri Lanka with Max and discover how this fierce, shaggy animal fights off leopards and other deadly rivals, all while trying to secure enough protein to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭東南岸是世上最富饒的漁場之一,也是海洋動物嬰孩從新丁長大成人之地.年輕的鯨魚,海豚和海豹學習捕獵;學習社會規則,甚至開始自己的冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world – the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of s...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bees Diary tells that story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 您曾否想過為何山魈的臉如此七彩,禿鷹為何禿頭,甚至雙髻鯊為何有雙髻?發掘動物如何通過脖子以上的進化來生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Have you ever wondered why mandrills have such colorful faces, why vultures are bald, or even why hammerheads have, well, hammer-shaped heads? Discover how animals managed to survive by evolving from the neck up.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塔特南角的11月,冬天將至哈德遜灣的下西部海岸線,但原本應該在哈德遜灣出現的冰卻不見蹤影.2016年是有紀錄以來最溫暖的一年,11月下旬時,仍然比平均溫度高出10度.氣候變化肆虐北方,大海不能在接近冰點結冰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its November at Cape Tatnam. Winter is coming to the lower Western shore of Hudson Bay. But the ice - which should be forming on Hudson Bay by now - is nowhere to be seen. 2016 has been the warmest year on record. In late November, the temperatur...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亞拉國家公園中陰暗的森林,對行縱隱密的豹來說是完美的藏身之所;而年輕的䧳豹阿莎亦準備好獨自闖蕩.一起見證她爭奪自己的領地,尋找伴侶,到成為母親的歷程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The shadowy forests of Yala National Park are the perfect hideout for secretive leopards. Its time for one young female, Asha, to strike out alone. Join her as she fights for her own territory, finds a mate, and becomes a mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亞洲最大的象群每年都會齊集於米內瑞亞國家公園舉行盛會;而在本年的周年大會上,於這片神聖的地方,小象洛卡誕生了!一起見證他在大象的混戰中學習進食,游泳和使用他的象鼻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every year, the biggest elephant congregation in Asia occurs in Minneriya National Park. Here in this sacred place, baby Loka is born. Watch as he learns to suckle, swim and handle his trunk among the mêlée of giants that make up his family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 斯里蘭卡的低地遍布著數千個看似平靜的湖泊,但「湖」不可貌相,湖水中盡是沼澤鱷的天下.沼澤鱷生來就是獵人,一起來看看這些頂尖獵食者在炙熱的環境中如何互相競爭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sri Lankas lowlands are dotted with thousands of seemingly peaceful lakes, but dont be fooled, this is the realm of the mugger crocodile. Muggers are hunters from day one. Watch as these supreme predators compete with each other in the fierce heat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於明尼亞瑞亞國家公園的一座人造湖,養育了亞洲最大的象群.跟隨一頭年輕公象,他正在經歷成長的轉折點.走訪熱帶雨林,探索棲居於叢林中各種奇異的昆蟲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A manmade lake in Minneriya National Park supports the largest concentration of elephants in Asia. Follow a young male who has reached a turning point toward adulthood. In the rainforest, jungles teem with a variety of bizarre species of insects.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 季候風暴席捲斯里蘭卡的熱帶島嶼,帶著旋風的薄霧和水流襲擊了山區的心臟地帶,開展島上森林許多不斷變化的面貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Monsoon storms sweep over the tropical island of Sri Lanka, and water carried in with swirling mists hits the mountainous heartland, beginning a journey through the many changing faces of the islands forests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雅拉國家公園是一個鳥類伊甸園,是215種鳥類的家.這個天堂為能度過不斷變化氣候的父母提供了許多可能性. 在旱季結束和季侯風風暴開始前,每個物種都必須在這裡飼養後代或找到新家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yala National Park is an avian Eden, home to 215 species of bird. This paradise offers many possibilities for parents who can weather the ever-changing climate. Every species must either raise their offspring here or find a new home before the dry...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與非洲森林象一同穿越納米比亞沙漠,窺探牠們如何在缺乏食物與遮蔽的環境中保持涼爽.了解這頭巨獸如何挑選特定植物充飢,挖掘水井,並翻越無盡的沙丘尋找珍貴水源.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across the Namibian desert with the bush elephant and learn how it keeps its cool in a place with little food or shade. Discover how this giant consumes specific plants, digs wells, and hikes endless dunes in a quest to find precious water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪婆羅洲的紅樹林,與灣鱷一同航行,並見證牠們在盤根錯節的水生植物之間穿梭自如.了解牠們如何利用環境調節體溫,以及如何憑藉驚人的耐性一躍成為頂尖獵手.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate a mangrove forest in Borneo with the saltwater crocodile, which is perfectly suited to life among the watery roots. Discover how this reptile uses the environment to regulate its temperature and why its epic patience makes it a super hunter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅毛猩猩是叢林中的建築大師.跟隨麥克斯來到婆羅洲的雨林,一起探索這種獨居靈長類動物的築巢藝術.然後見證麥克斯如何嘗試逃離滿佈昆蟲的地面,並從紅毛猩猩身上學習自然界工程技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungles master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primates natural engineering prowess.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麥克斯來到盧安達的森林追蹤黑猩猩,他試圖說服這些強壯的猴子相信他是朋友而非敵人.一起學習在叢林覓食的關鍵技巧,並見證黑猩猩複雜的家庭動態,包括梳理毛髮和社交活動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track chimpanzees through the Rwandan forest with Max, who tries to convince these powerful monkeys that hes a friend, not a foe. Pick up some key tips on jungle dining and witness complex family dynamics, including grooming and socializing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麥可斯探索斯里蘭卡,窺探懶熊常被誤解的神秘世界.見證這種看似人畜無害,毛髮蓬亂的動物,如何無畏地擊退豹子,並觀察牠們如何努力獲取所需的營養.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peek inside the secret world of the fearless, often misunderstood sloth bear. Travel to Sri Lanka with Max and discover how this fierce, shaggy animal fights off leopards and other deadly rivals, all while trying to secure enough protein to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然中最古老,最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界.和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與地球上最快的動物運動員一起加速.觀看死亡加德蛇在瞬間出擊,與遊隼一起進行空中暗殺,與變色龍一起捕捉快速的食物,並面對在海雀俯衝獵物時的驚人G力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 齊來為年輕的格鬥士們鼓掌,並親眼見證他們在美洲茂密的熱帶森林中奮力拼搏!然後退後一步,觀察一隻毒箭蛙發動絕活攻勢,還有美洲豹和凱門鱷爭奪地盤,以及見證一隻飢餓的長鼻狸與猛蜘蛛的邂逅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cheer as young gladiators earn their stripes in the dense tropical forests of the Americas. Stand back as a poison dart frog launches a toxic barrage, observe a jaguar-caiman turf war, and see a hungry coati cross paths with a defensive tarantula.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往美國極北地帶,拜訪沿著水道生活的終極格鬥士.春回大地,看到融雪就知道格鬥隨時上演:鷹與鷺的對決,熊族對陣,以及蜻蜓蛹與大型水蟲之間的決鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head to Americas far north for a peek at the ultimate fighters that live along its waterways. See a spring thaw kick off the competition, pitting eagles against herons, bears against bears, and dragonfly nymphs against venomous giant water bugs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在歐洲,喀爾巴阡山脈的偏遠荒野是由古老森林和陡峭峽谷組成的一片戲劇性土地.神秘生物在這處仍漫步野外,崎嶇的景觀是一種捕食者的家園,牠在整個歷史中刻下敬畏和恐懼:歐亞狼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the remote wilderness of the Carpathian Mountains lives an elusive predator that has inspired awe and fear throughout history: the Eurasian wolf. Discover the vital role that these once-misunderstood hunters play in protecting their ecosystem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然中最古老,最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 和卡昆比族群一起返回巢穴,這個族群正在哀悼兩隻失去的幼崽.偶遇一個鬣狗窩和一頭獅子試圖放倒一頭水牛的場面,然後跟上曼齊族群的步伐,目睹牠們與一隻豹子和一群憤怒大象的對峙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head back to the den with the Kakumbi, who are mourning the loss of two pups. Chance upon a hyena den and a lion pride trying to take down a buffalo, then catch up with the Manzi, who are in a standoff with a leopard and a herd of angry elephants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哈德遜灣低窪地是北美最大濕地的一部分. 超過300,000平方公里的厚苔沼,一處巨大的沼澤地,放眼望去可以看到以水浸泡的泥煤,苔蘚和矮木的特色生態.曾被視為荒地,但現在人們都知道這些沼澤對地球上的生命尤關重要.在全球的濕地中存在的二氧化碳跟大氣中一樣多,泥煤地生態系統是地球上最有效的碳吸儲庫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hudson Bay lowlands are part of North Americas largest wetland. Over 300,000 square kilometers of muskeg, a vast bogland as far as the eye can see characterized by water soaked peat, mosses and stunted trees. Once thought of as barren wastela...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的龍山是其中一處擁有大陸上最壯麗美景的地方.它的氣候和生態梯度急劇變化,亦影響著陸空生物和天上猛禽的生活環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: South Africas Drakensberg is one of the continents most impressive landscapes. It is home to sharp climatic and ecological gradients as physical conditions change for both land-based creatures and the Raptors that swirl in the skies above.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在坦桑尼亞北部,高聳的山脈形成一個巨大的山谷.它被古老的火山所滋養,坡道為生命提供了多元化的棲息地,而它巨大的重心地帶即使在最乾燥的時期也能保存水源.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In north Tanzania, towering mountains line a dramatic valley. Enriched by ancient volcanoes, its slopes provide a variety of habitats for life to thrive and its great centerpiece holds water through even the driest of times.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 埃塞俄比亞的塞米恩國家公園住著地球上一些最稀有的生物.窺探非洲最高峰的生活,那是在草原遊走毛茸茸的獅尾狒,神出鬼沒的塞米恩狼和有角的瓦利亞野山羊的最後堡壘.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Simien Mountains National Park in Ethiopia is home to some of the rarest creatures on earth. Take a glimpse into life on some of the highest peaks in Africa, in the last stronghold of shaggy, grass-grazing Geladas, elusive Simien wolves and horned...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 進入南部旱地是一趟非洲南部最遠端,最乾旱和極端環境的旅程.我們到訪了幾乎不降雨,既壯觀又危險的地方,為了尋找適應力極強的動物,並了解牠們生存的秘密.從最大的哺乳類到最敏捷的昆蟲,甚至是世上僅有幽靈般的魚類,南部旱地擁有非凡的居民,生活在世上其中一處最荒涼的棲息地接受日常挑戰,牠們都站在同一陣線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Southern Drylands is a journey into the most arid and extreme environments in the furthest reaches of southern Africa. We go to spectacular but treacherous places where almost no rain falls, to find incredibly resilient creatures and learn the...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現已乾涸的埃托沙曾是一個大湖,現在只有夏季降雨期間才能季節性地補充水分.但當埃托沙充滿水時,無數的水鳥就會聚集在淺湖中繁殖,最常見的是大小紅鸛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Etosha was once a great lake that dried up and now only fills with water seasonally during the summer rains. Once the Etosha pan is full of water, a myriad of water birds congregate in the shallow lake to breed, most notably Greater and lesser fla...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著南非的奧蘭治河,從它的源頭到大西洋出海處.我們在沿途能遇到各樣的棲息地和當中的生物,從理察斯維德的旱地到奧赫拉比斯的美景; 這是一個線形綠洲的故事.我們將揭示生物如何適應其河道,並發現豐富的動植物世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the course of South Africas Orange river from its origins to where it spills out into the Atlantic Ocean. Along the way we encounter a diverse range of habitats and the creatures they support, from the dry lands of the Richtersveld to the ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 旱季即將結束,孟巴肯高獅群面臨前所未有的艱難時刻.牠們的女族長和最強獵人蘇拉比被一頭水牛所傷,讓她命懸一線.同時,彌敦找到了獅群中最年輕的成員之一,孤身走失的小獅斑點.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The all-female Hollywood pride have been in exile after being attacked by the four Nomad brothers. But their leader, Ava, decides to lead her family south to the heart of their territory for a showdown with the Nomads.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個澳洲家庭在南非的一個古老狩獵牧場進行修復.他們的目標是重建過度生長的棲息地,建立生態旅游牧場,並允許包括獵食者在內的自然野生動植物搬回家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An Australian family go on an adventure to restore an old hunting ranch in South Africa. Their goal is to rebuild the overgrown habitat, create an eco-tourism ranch, and allow the natural wildlife, including predators, to move back in.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社區經營的瑞特提大象庇護所,在這裡,人類的代理媽媽們透過玩耍教導小象如何在野外生存,並細心地照顧與陪伴牠們成長.與那隻失去象鼻的小象隆烏洛建立情感連結,同時了解為什麼六歲的小象凱勒勒那場神祕的疾病,可能會讓牠的重返野外之路被迫延遲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Longuro and see why six-year-old Keleles mysterious illness could delay his release.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在道別的傷痛與對未來的希望之間尋求平衡,因為這一代被救援的大象,終於迎來了重返自由的時刻.歡迎瑞特提大家庭的新成員:一頭從水坑中被救出的象寶寶,以及一匹名叫奇希瑪的斑馬,牠曾因創傷而驚恐不安.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象:克雷格,帕斯卡與以掃.深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言,複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the worlds largest land mammal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往科克群島旅遊,這是3000只座頭鯨準備交配和撫養幼崽的首選目的地.見證巨蚌和綠海龜在島嶼巨大的珊瑚礁中繁衍生息,並一瞥我們的進化歷史.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to the Cook Islands, the destination of choice for 3,000 humpback whales ready to mate and raise their young. Witness giant clams and green turtles thriving in the islands massive coral reef and get a glimpse into our evolutionary past.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然中最古老,最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界.和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證鬥士們如何在非洲大草原的旱季中爭奪水源和其他珍貴資源.親眼目擊獅子和大象為爭奪地盤的激烈爭鬥,螞蟻襲擊白蟻丘,以及蜜獾與毒蛇聯袂上演的危險探戈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. See a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound, and a honey badgers risky dance with a deadly snake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜訪澳洲最狡猾的鬥士和他們驚人的武器庫.從袋鼠的致命拳擊和紅背蜘蛛精密設計的陷阱,暸解他們如何運用這些必殺技擊退敵人,同時應對氣候變化的侵害.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against Australias wiliest gladiators and their impressive arsenals. Learn if these weapons, such as the kangaroos deadly boxing moves and the redback spiders precision-engineered traps, can help them survive the ravages of climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喀爾巴阡山脈橫跨七個歐洲國家;它有著廣闊的原始森林,陡峭的峽谷和孤立的山峰,為這片大陸最具魅力的生物提供了寶貴的避難所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join a mother brown bear as she struggles to find food for her two young cubs while teaching them essential skills for the harsh winter ahead. Then visit a pair of tiny lynx kittens as they begin to venture away from the safety of their den.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往科克群島旅遊,這是3000只座頭鯨準備交配和撫養幼崽的首選目的地.見證巨蚌和綠海龜在島嶼巨大的珊瑚礁中繁衍生息,並一瞥我們的進化歷史.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to the Cook Islands, the destination of choice for 3,000 humpback whales ready to mate and raise their young. Witness giant clams and green turtles thriving in the islands massive coral reef and get a glimpse into our evolutionary past.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然中最古老,最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現代動物始祖演化出的第一個感官是化學感官:牠們能夠檢測環境中的化學物質.這有助動物始祖尋找獵物和配偶,並從遠處感知逐漸靠近的捕食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The first sense to evolve in the first animals was chemoreception: being able to detect chemicals in the animals environment. This helps animals find prey and mates, and to sense predators from a distance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 育空地區是一片真正的荒野,是世上最後的荒野之一.這片遼闊土地的名字來自它最長的河流,該地區的土著居民骨池人稱之為「預官也」,或稱「大河」.育空河是北美第三長的河流,流經寬闊的山谷和狹窄的河道,向西北延展超過3000公里至狂風暴雨的白令海.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Yukon is a true wilderness, one of the last on Earth. The vast land got its name from its longest river, which the Gwichin, one of the indigenous people of the region, call Yu-kun- ah, or, the great river. The third longest waterway in No...

epg.programme_title_tc: 美國野生邊界:北部揭祕 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著美加之間最長的邊境,野生動物猶如同時活在兩個世界.動物在障礙和矛盾的規則間如履薄冰,一念天堂一念地獄.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trail Atlantic puffins, Prairie rattlesnakes, Alaskan caribou and other animals as they travel across the international boundary between the U.S. and Canada. See how they can move from safety to target by crossing a line they had no say in creating.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在馬達加斯加偏遠的伯倫蒂保育區,兩個環尾狐猴派別因正面臨旱季日益嚴峻的挑戰而拉起戰幔.這些魅力非凡的狐猴僅在馬達加斯加島上被發現,黑白相間的尾巴十分突出,牠們活在女權體制中,每個幫派都有嚴格的等級制度,並擁有各自嚴守的領土.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the dry season approaches, tensions rise on Lemur Island, both between rival gangs and within their own ranks. Get a view from the battlefield as the female leaders fiercely defend their turf, while their newborn infants cling to them for safety.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在馬達加斯加偏遠的貝倫地保育區,旱季正對當地的環尾狐猴造成巨大的損耗.隨著覓食的難度增加,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹之間的關係越發緊張.隨著食物和水源日益稀缺,入侵者亦出現在附近.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As food and water become scarce, Crystal, the fierce leader of the Ruins gang, sets her sights on rival Katis territory and its neighboring fruit trees. Watch as Crystals move and a raid by outside invaders lead to dire consequences for one troop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在長期乾旱過後,第一場雨的降臨大大地紓緩了馬達加斯加貝倫地保育區的環尾狐猴幫.森林裡的食物十分充足,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹率領族群離開領土大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The drought is finally over, but traversing the forest for food is still a gamble. See some leaders take the risk, leaving home territories undefended to feast on a cicada boom. When they return, trespassers are ready for a fight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狐?島上的幫派奮力保持族群的健康和領土的完整.隨著嬰兒們成長,牠們的階級架構開始出現裂縫,權力備受考驗.由學習食甚麼,交友,結盟到在族群中找到一席之地,狐?島上嬰兒的生活跟成年狐?一樣艱辛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the babies grow, new power struggles break out in each troop. Watch as every member, from fierce Queen Crystal to low-ranking Erica, jockeys for position. Meanwhile, the babies start to understand how allies and enemies will shape their future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 貝倫地保育區的環尾狐猴過得動盪不安,族群急忙利用早前降雨後的短暫大餐,因為隨之而來又是乾燥日子.隨著牠們的幼崽長大,覓食的壓力變得比之前更大.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The pressure to find food reaches new heights and throws the reserve into turmoil. Witness fractures emerge within the ranks, dividing the gangs and leading Crystal, the indomitable leader of the Ruins gang, to face a challenge like none before.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 超聰明的杜利亞和沙利巴在帕拉斯島失蹤,要趕在牠們惹事前找到牠們.另外,流感病毒肆虐明猩學園,令園內人人自危.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The race is on to find Tulia and Zalipa, who are missing from Palas Island. And after months of convalescence, Beni returns to forest school but faces another setback at the milk bucket. Meanwhile, the vets keep a close eye on pregnant Dilla.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 工作人員正計劃下一輪釋放行動,而學園內的幾名準畢業生前途未卜.經過九個月,迪娜分娩的時刻到了,但卻出了亂子,新家庭的未來變得不確定.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fate of several graduates awaits the next round of wild releases. Meanwhile, runaway Zalipa is found, but her partner in crime, Tulia, is still missing. And Baby Clarita has a complete meltdown as the vets perform surgery on her mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 團隊作最終嘗試,讓抗拒的母親迪娜與她的新生兒迪利娜重聚,每個人都十分緊張.伽嬅和伽麗塔正在去往自由的最後旅程,但一場危險的洪水阻礙牠們的行程,並威脅到每個人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trouble brews when the team makes the final attempt to reunite reluctant mother Dilla with her new baby Delilah. And Alba, the worlds only known albino orangutan, amazes her friends with her unique approach to termite foraging.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春回大地,農場裡生機處處.雙胞胎羔羊拿利和科嬅,以及其他新生兒在草地上歡騰.小牛孤兒莫莉努力生活,而母豬姬絲則有一位情人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its spring, and the farm is bursting with new life. Watch a ewe give birth to twins, an orphaned Hereford calf struggle to find a surrogate mother, and the top hen nestle down in her maternity coop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季意味著動物可以在空曠的草地上漫遊,也導致了海福特牛群的不和,還有黃牛間的戰鬥.赫布里底羊進行逃脫,倒霉的牧羊犬謝茜有了第一次驅攏的機會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience life on the farm as things heat up for summer. Watch animals swelter in a rare heatwave, try to stay cool in the nearby freshwater stream, and stash supplies for fall.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證棲身於西海岸的不同物種,如何忍受嚴冬並迎接初春的來臨.親眼目睹在強風下的紅鹿激戰,在風聲呼嘯的暴風雨中歡迎海豹寶寶來臨,以及象鯊群的回歸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Endure winter and early spring on the west coast, where animals eke out a chilly existence. Watch red deer battle on windswept Inishvickillane, welcome seal pups amid howling storms on the Inishkea islands, and view the return of the basking sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪世界著名的斯凱利群島,穿梭令人眼花繚亂的峭壁,並探索一座有1500年歷史的修道院.拜訪棲身曼島的薙鳥和座頭鯨,然後在克萊爾追逐矮小的鼩鼱.最後來到阿蘭群島,一睹秋季的壯觀景象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore a 1,500-year-old monastery among the dizzying crags of the world-famous Skellig Islands. Spy Manx shearwaters and humpback whales, then chase after pygmy shrews on Clare before heading to the Aran Islands for a peek at an autumn spectacle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探全球昆蟲數量銳減對地球可能造成的衝擊,揭露我們千百年來對這些微小伙伴的依賴,以及牠們在生態系統中所扮演的關鍵角色.了解人類與昆蟲之間的微妙關係如何面臨危機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at what a global insect decline could do to our planet. Uncover our historical dependence on these tiny animals, the vital roles they play in our ecosystems, and the reasons why our fragile relationship to them is in danger worldwide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解蜜蜂,蝴蝶與飛蛾如何讓田野和樹林充滿生機.想像如果這些勤勞的蟲蟲消失,世界會如何變樣.見證神祕的蝴蝶遷徙之旅,以及飛蛾如何巧妙地躲避飢餓的蝙蝠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how bees, butterflies, moths, and other pollinators keep our fields and forests fruitful, and weigh what life would be like if these busy bugs vanished. Witness a mysterious butterfly pilgrimage and a moths clever way of escaping hungry bats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 迎戰專為殺戮而生的掠食性昆蟲,了解具有武術家身手的螳螂如何令人畏懼,然後跟隨大開殺戒的蜻蜓在半空中狩獵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against predatory insects that are tailor-made for killing. See why the terrifying praying mantis has the agility of a martial artist and an appetite for everything from flies to hummingbirds, then go hunting in mid-air with deadly dragonflies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然的清潔專家學習環境衛生課.了解甲蟲如何利用尖牙與毒液等生物武器,巧妙維持生態平衡,並認識超過六千種的糞金龜──這些無名英雄才是維護地球健康的關鍵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get a sanitation lesson from natures original cleanup crew. Learn how beetles keep ecosystems in balance with clever biological weapons like tusks and toxic sprays, then see why the 6,000-plus species of dung beetles are the worlds unsung heroes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蜂巢內,成千上萬的小動物朝著一個共同目標努力:群體的生存.但是個別蜜蜂的生活又如何?秘「蜜」日記講述這個故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bees Diary tells that story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證棲身於西海岸的不同物種,如何忍受嚴冬並迎接初春的來臨.親眼目睹在強風下的紅鹿激戰,在風聲呼嘯的暴風雨中歡迎海豹寶寶來臨,以及象鯊群的回歸.
