epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 觸覺能讓物種感知各種物理力量所帶的感覺,包括得知咬傷,感受溫度變化和不同質地.一些動物對非常微弱的振動特別敏感,牠們能從中獲得大量關於環境的訊息.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sense of touch is useful to feel physical forces such as bites, changes in temperature and texture. Some animals have become extra sensitive to very faint vibrations, which gives them a lot of information about their environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界.和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來認識小雌豹奇帕祖亞的魅力,她受到母親的悉心照顧,因此從未需要自己捕獵.這是她生命中第一次獨自生活,她能否絕地求生,培養出所需的狩獵技能?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 野狗群的世界正在面對一場巨變,他們豐富的狩獵地正受到斑點鬣狗群的威脅.脆弱的狗寶寶已開始挨餓,因為無情的獵食者對手偷走了他們的食物,最終還突擊他們的棲身地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Enter the world of a wild dog pack whose bountiful hunting grounds are threatened when a clan of spotted hyenas moves in nearby. The vulnerable pups start to go hungry as the scavenging rivals steal their food and eventually raid their den.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與非洲森林象一同穿越納米比亞沙漠,窺探牠們如何在缺乏食物與遮蔽的環境中保持涼爽.了解這頭巨獸如何挑選特定植物充飢,挖掘水井,並翻越無盡的沙丘尋找珍貴水源.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across the Namibian desert with the bush elephant and learn how it keeps its cool in a place with little food or shade. Discover how this giant consumes specific plants, digs wells, and hikes endless dunes in a quest to find precious water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著葉子的變化,農場裡的動物露出野性.公羊羅傑和哈米殊就像擁有大角般對決,爭奪霸主地位.母雞莎莉飛過雞舍,在季末遊覽農場.母豬舒娜生下小豬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch life on the farm adjust as the leaves start to turn, from the sheep whose woolly coats keep them warm during the first frost to the bees that feed on the last bit of nectar before hibernation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探全球昆蟲數量銳減對地球可能造成的衝擊,揭露我們千百年來對這些微小伙伴的依賴,以及牠們在生態系統中所扮演的關鍵角色.了解人類與昆蟲之間的微妙關係如何面臨危機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at what a global insect decline could do to our planet. Uncover our historical dependence on these tiny animals, the vital roles they play in our ecosystems, and the reasons why our fragile relationship to them is in danger worldwide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 視覺是最令人驚嘆的感官,為物種帶來無窮的適應能力.不同動物的眼睛賦予牠們截然不同的視覺,在某些情況下甚至讓人「眼界大開」.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seeing the world is one of the most amazing animal adaptations. Different types of eyes give animals different types of vision, and in some cases they can be extraordinary.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來認識小雌豹奇帕祖亞的魅力,她受到母親的悉心照顧,因此從未需要自己捕獵.這是她生命中第一次獨自生活,她能否絕地求生,培養出所需的狩獵技能?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Enter the world of a wild dog pack whose bountiful hunting grounds are threatened when a clan of spotted hyenas moves in nearby. The vulnerable pups start to go hungry as the scavenging rivals steal their food and eventually raid their den.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​帶你發現那座位於波濤之下,眾城之中最奇幻壯麗的城市,那裡是愛情滋長與通勤旅者聚集之地,珊瑚礁主幹道宛如繁忙街道,浪漫與遷徙生命在其中交錯如潮.跟隨一隻懷抱愛意的綠蠵龜,展開牠的尋愛旅程;坐下來,陪伴一位鶴鴕爸爸細心守護他那剛孵化的小寶寶們.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the most fantastic city of them all lying beneath the waves, where romance and migratory commuters flood the coral reefs main highways. Follow a green sea turtle looking for love and sit in with a cassowary dad tending his newborn chicks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​感受盛夏降臨時的灼熱氣息,體型龐大的海蝸牛試圖抵禦一群貪吃珊瑚的海星幫派入侵.與礁鯊一同巡遊黑夜,尋找宵夜佳餚;驚嘆鸚哥魚如何巧妙變身,以滑溜偽裝度過危機四伏的漫漫長夜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat of summers arrival as supersize sea snails try to fend off an invading gang of coral-hungry starfish. Accompany reef sharks as they prowl for a midnight meal and marvel at the slippery disguise a parrotfish uses to survive the night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪婆羅洲的紅樹林,與灣鱷一同航行,並見證牠們在盤根錯節的水生植物之間穿梭自如.了解牠們如何利用環境調節體溫,以及如何憑藉驚人的耐性一躍成為頂尖獵手.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate a mangrove forest in Borneo with the saltwater crocodile, which is perfectly suited to life among the watery roots. Discover how this reptile uses the environment to regulate its temperature and why its epic patience makes it a super hunter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 農場裡的動物為一年中最短的日子專心準備.為免冬天太沉悶,牛群享受假日美食和演唱會.母豬舒娜忙著照料九隻貪玩的小豬,而公羊哈米殊被大眾情人邦妮嫌棄.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is coming, and the animals take advantage of autumns final bounty before the cold, barren months ahead. Watch some creatures search for respite indoors, while others arrive from far northern climates to settle in the ploughed fields.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Enter the world of a wild dog pack whose bountiful hunting grounds are threatened when a clan of spotted hyenas moves in nearby. The vulnerable pups start to go hungry as the scavenging rivals steal their food and eventually raid their den.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解蜜蜂,蝴蝶與飛蛾如何讓田野和樹林充滿生機.想像如果這些勤勞的蟲蟲消失,世界會如何變樣.見證神祕的蝴蝶遷徙之旅,以及飛蛾如何巧妙地躲避飢餓的蝙蝠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how bees, butterflies, moths, and other pollinators keep our fields and forests fruitful, and weigh what life would be like if these busy bugs vanished. Witness a mysterious butterfly pilgrimage and a moths clever way of escaping hungry bats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​帶你發現那座位於波濤之下,眾城之中最奇幻壯麗的城市,那裡是愛情滋長與通勤旅者聚集之地,珊瑚礁主幹道宛如繁忙街道,浪漫與遷徙生命在其中交錯如潮.跟隨一隻懷抱愛意的綠蠵龜,展開牠的尋愛旅程;坐下來,陪伴一位鶴鴕爸爸細心守護他那剛孵化的小寶寶們.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the most fantastic city of them all lying beneath the waves, where romance and migratory commuters flood the coral reefs main highways. Follow a green sea turtle looking for love and sit in with a cassowary dad tending his newborn chicks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​感受盛夏降臨時的灼熱氣息,體型龐大的海蝸牛試圖抵禦一群貪吃珊瑚的海星幫派入侵.與礁鯊一同巡遊黑夜,尋找宵夜佳餚;驚嘆鸚哥魚如何巧妙變身,以滑溜偽裝度過危機四伏的漫漫長夜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat of summers arrival as supersize sea snails try to fend off an invading gang of coral-hungry starfish. Accompany reef sharks as they prowl for a midnight meal and marvel at the slippery disguise a parrotfish uses to survive the night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪婆羅洲的紅樹林,與灣鱷一同航行,並見證牠們在盤根錯節的水生植物之間穿梭自如.了解牠們如何利用環境調節體溫,以及如何憑藉驚人的耐性一躍成為頂尖獵手.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate a mangrove forest in Borneo with the saltwater crocodile, which is perfectly suited to life among the watery roots. Discover how this reptile uses the environment to regulate its temperature and why its epic patience makes it a super hunter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 農場裡的動物為一年中最短的日子專心準備.為免冬天太沉悶,牛群享受假日美食和演唱會.母豬舒娜忙著照料九隻貪玩的小豬,而公羊哈米殊被大眾情人邦妮嫌棄.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is coming, and the animals take advantage of autumns final bounty before the cold, barren months ahead. Watch some creatures search for respite indoors, while others arrive from far northern climates to settle in the ploughed fields.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來認識小雌豹奇帕祖亞的魅力,她受到母親的悉心照顧,因此從未需要自己捕獵.這是她生命中第一次獨自生活,她能否絕地求生,培養出所需的狩獵技能?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 野狗群的世界正在面對一場巨變,他們豐富的狩獵地正受到斑點鬣狗群的威脅.脆弱的狗寶寶已開始挨餓,因為無情的獵食者對手偷走了他們的食物,最終還突擊他們的棲身地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Enter the world of a wild dog pack whose bountiful hunting grounds are threatened when a clan of spotted hyenas moves in nearby. The vulnerable pups start to go hungry as the scavenging rivals steal their food and eventually raid their den.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 所有的運動都會產生聲波;有些物種成功演化出器官來檢測空氣或水中的聲波,以感知環境中的運動.齊來暸解這些動物的敏銳聽覺.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sound waves are produced by movement. Animals have evolved organs to detect those sound waves in the air or water to perceive movements in their environment. These are some of the animals that have mastered the sense of hearing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​帶你發現那座位於波濤之下,眾城之中最奇幻壯麗的城市,那裡是愛情滋長與通勤旅者聚集之地,珊瑚礁主幹道宛如繁忙街道,浪漫與遷徙生命在其中交錯如潮.跟隨一隻懷抱愛意的綠蠵龜,展開牠的尋愛旅程;坐下來,陪伴一位鶴鴕爸爸細心守護他那剛孵化的小寶寶們.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the most fantastic city of them all lying beneath the waves, where romance and migratory commuters flood the coral reefs main highways. Follow a green sea turtle looking for love and sit in with a cassowary dad tending his newborn chicks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​感受盛夏降臨時的灼熱氣息,體型龐大的海蝸牛試圖抵禦一群貪吃珊瑚的海星幫派入侵.與礁鯊一同巡遊黑夜,尋找宵夜佳餚;驚嘆鸚哥魚如何巧妙變身,以滑溜偽裝度過危機四伏的漫漫長夜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat of summers arrival as supersize sea snails try to fend off an invading gang of coral-hungry starfish. Accompany reef sharks as they prowl for a midnight meal and marvel at the slippery disguise a parrotfish uses to survive the night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證鬥士們如何在非洲大草原的旱季中爭奪水源和其他珍貴資源.親眼目擊獅子和大象為爭奪地盤的激烈爭鬥,螞蟻襲擊白蟻丘,以及蜜獾與毒蛇聯袂上演的危險探戈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. See a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound, and a honey badgers risky dance with a deadly snake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的秋天帶來機會.非洲毛皮海獅,白喉猴,變色龍和黑斑羚等對秋季有所反應.秋天引發了許多動物的生活變化.稀有生物露面,獵食者聚集起來製造優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As fall sweeps across America and trees are set ablaze with color, animals are faced with make-or-break decisions. Find out how bald eagles, beavers, and other creatures prepare for the colder, darker, and leaner months ahead.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的冬天帶來乾旱,冰雪和風暴.在此生活的動物必須與天氣,土地和彼此競爭.獵豹,海豹,禿鷹和狐獴.雨水終於結束旱季,並引發了生命的爆發性發展.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is the ultimate challenge for wildlife across America. Will they escape to milder southern climates or stay put and tough out the season? See how different creatures respond to the brutal cold and blizzards that blanket the North.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅毛猩猩是叢林中的建築大師.跟隨麥克斯來到婆羅洲的雨林,一起探索這種獨居靈長類動物的築巢藝術.然後見證麥克斯如何嘗試逃離滿佈昆蟲的地面,並從紅毛猩猩身上學習自然界工程技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungles master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primates natural engineering prowess.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭南島的西南角被巨大的山脈和蠻荒的太平洋所封閉.稀有的企鵝每天都被逼與巨型胡氏海獅進行貓捉老鼠的遊戲.而海獅也生活在一個動蕩的世界,幼獅必須對抗大自然才能生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience unbelievable acts of courage and loyalty by creatures trying to survive in the remote wilderness of New Zealands South Island. Face forest penguins feast and famine cycles, and explore the tumultuous world of newborn sea lions.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against predatory insects that are tailor-made for killing. See why the terrifying praying mantis has the agility of a martial artist and an appetite for everything from flies to hummingbirds, then go hunting in mid-air with deadly dragonflies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅毛猩猩是叢林中的建築大師.跟隨麥克斯來到婆羅洲的雨林,一起探索這種獨居靈長類動物的築巢藝術.然後見證麥克斯如何嘗試逃離滿佈昆蟲的地面,並從紅毛猩猩身上學習自然界工程技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungles master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primates natural engineering prowess.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭南島的西南角被巨大的山脈和蠻荒的太平洋所封閉.稀有的企鵝每天都被逼與巨型胡氏海獅進行貓捉老鼠的遊戲.而海獅也生活在一個動蕩的世界,幼獅必須對抗大自然才能生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience unbelievable acts of courage and loyalty by creatures trying to survive in the remote wilderness of New Zealands South Island. Face forest penguins feast and famine cycles, and explore the tumultuous world of newborn sea lions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​帶你發現那座位於波濤之下,眾城之中最奇幻壯麗的城市,那裡是愛情滋長與通勤旅者聚集之地,珊瑚礁主幹道宛如繁忙街道,浪漫與遷徙生命在其中交錯如潮.跟隨一隻懷抱愛意的綠蠵龜,展開牠的尋愛旅程;坐下來,陪伴一位鶴鴕爸爸細心守護他那剛孵化的小寶寶們.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the most fantastic city of them all lying beneath the waves, where romance and migratory commuters flood the coral reefs main highways. Follow a green sea turtle looking for love and sit in with a cassowary dad tending his newborn chicks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​感受盛夏降臨時的灼熱氣息,體型龐大的海蝸牛試圖抵禦一群貪吃珊瑚的海星幫派入侵.與礁鯊一同巡遊黑夜,尋找宵夜佳餚;驚嘆鸚哥魚如何巧妙變身,以滑溜偽裝度過危機四伏的漫漫長夜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat of summers arrival as supersize sea snails try to fend off an invading gang of coral-hungry starfish. Accompany reef sharks as they prowl for a midnight meal and marvel at the slippery disguise a parrotfish uses to survive the night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 迎戰專為殺戮而生的掠食性昆蟲,了解具有武術家身手的螳螂如何令人畏懼,然後跟隨大開殺戒的蜻蜓在半空中狩獵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against predatory insects that are tailor-made for killing. See why the terrifying praying mantis has the agility of a martial artist and an appetite for everything from flies to hummingbirds, then go hunting in mid-air with deadly dragonflies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的秋天帶來機會.非洲毛皮海獅,白喉猴,變色龍和黑斑羚等對秋季有所反應.秋天引發了許多動物的生活變化.稀有生物露面,獵食者聚集起來製造優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As fall sweeps across America and trees are set ablaze with color, animals are faced with make-or-break decisions. Find out how bald eagles, beavers, and other creatures prepare for the colder, darker, and leaner months ahead.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的冬天帶來乾旱,冰雪和風暴.在此生活的動物必須與天氣,土地和彼此競爭.獵豹,海豹,禿鷹和狐獴.雨水終於結束旱季,並引發了生命的爆發性發展.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is the ultimate challenge for wildlife across America. Will they escape to milder southern climates or stay put and tough out the season? See how different creatures respond to the brutal cold and blizzards that blanket the North.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 某些動物擁有人類難以想像的感官,牠們能憑藉這些超能力來完全很多奇妙的事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some animals have senses that humans cant even conceive. With those powers they can do marvelous things.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的秋天帶來機會.非洲毛皮海獅,白喉猴,變色龍和黑斑羚等對秋季有所反應.秋天引發了許多動物的生活變化.稀有生物露面,獵食者聚集起來製造優勢.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is the ultimate challenge for wildlife across America. Will they escape to milder southern climates or stay put and tough out the season? See how different creatures respond to the brutal cold and blizzards that blanket the North.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜訪澳洲最狡猾的鬥士和他們驚人的武器庫.從袋鼠的致命拳擊和紅背蜘蛛精密設計的陷阱,暸解他們如何運用這些必殺技擊退敵人,同時應對氣候變化的侵害.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against Australias wiliest gladiators and their impressive arsenals. Learn if these weapons, such as the kangaroos deadly boxing moves and the redback spiders precision-engineered traps, can help them survive the ravages of climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨溫斯頓和姐妹花搬進新建的居所,並努力學習野外生存技能.目睹雅思敏和雅拉在幼兒園中的權力鬥爭,然後關注不安分的幼熊維克多;因為牠突然跛腳,野放的日子要一再延後.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bone up on outdoor skills as Winston and the X girls move into their new fresh-air enclosure, and witness Yasmine and Yaras kindergarten power struggle. Then look over restless yearling Victor, whose sudden limp pushes back his release date.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與雅思敏和雅拉一起在雨中嬉戲和享受攀爬的樂趣,並跟隨溫斯頓在新水池中的暢泳.與羅傑和史蒂夫一起尋找掉落的無線電項圈,並見證兩群夏季幼熊的首次相遇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the joys of rain and climbing with Yasmine and Yara, and watch Winston take a dip in his new pool. Go hunting for dropped radio collars with Roger and Steve, then see what happens when the two groups of summer cubs come face-to-face.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麥克斯來到盧安達的森林追蹤黑猩猩,他試圖說服這些強壯的猴子相信他是朋友而非敵人.一起學習在叢林覓食的關鍵技巧,並見證黑猩猩複雜的家庭動態,包括梳理毛髮和社交活動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track chimpanzees through the Rwandan forest with Max, who tries to convince these powerful monkeys that hes a friend, not a foe. Pick up some key tips on jungle dining and witness complex family dynamics, including grooming and socializing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新西蘭西南部,深邃的峽灣和潮汐形成的潟湖被綠色的雨林覆蓋.生活在黑暗峽灣港的生物通常棲息在深海.隨著冬季將至,寬吻海豚必須逃離牠們冰冷的峽灣,而在山河中,新西蘭長鰭鰻細聽大海的呼喚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how winters arrival triggers animal survival instincts in southwestern New Zealand. Track dolphins as they move to warmer waters to give their calves a fighting chance, and join longfin eels on an epic migration to their spawning grounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然的清潔專家學習環境衛生課.了解甲蟲如何利用尖牙與毒液等生物武器,巧妙維持生態平衡,並認識超過六千種的糞金龜──這些無名英雄才是維護地球健康的關鍵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get a sanitation lesson from natures original cleanup crew. Learn how beetles keep ecosystems in balance with clever biological weapons like tusks and toxic sprays, then see why the 6,000-plus species of dung beetles are the worlds unsung heroes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人類擁有敏銳的感官,亦是我們能探索環境的關鍵.不同感官向我們提供生存所需的重要訊息.然而,部份物種也能掌握這些感官,並透過演化轉化成生物工程的奇蹟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Humans have sharp senses, which we use to explore our environment. They give us the information we need to survive. But some animals have taken those senses and, through evolution, turned them into marvels of biological engineering.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喀爾巴阡山脈橫跨七個歐洲國家;它有著廣闊的原始森林,陡峭的峽谷和孤立的山峰,為這片大陸最具魅力的生物提供了寶貴的避難所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join a mother brown bear as she struggles to find food for her two young cubs while teaching them essential skills for the harsh winter ahead. Then visit a pair of tiny lynx kittens as they begin to venture away from the safety of their den.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麥可斯探索斯里蘭卡,窺探懶熊常被誤解的神秘世界.見證這種看似人畜無害,毛髮蓬亂的動物,如何無畏地擊退豹子,並觀察牠們如何努力獲取所需的營養.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peek inside the secret world of the fearless, often misunderstood sloth bear. Travel to Sri Lanka with Max and discover how this fierce, shaggy animal fights off leopards and other deadly rivals, all while trying to secure enough protein to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭東南岸是世上最富饒的漁場之一,也是海洋動物嬰孩從新丁長大成人之地.年輕的鯨魚,海豚和海豹學習捕獵;學習社會規則,甚至開始自己的冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world – the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of s...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨溫斯頓和姐妹花搬進新建的居所,並努力學習野外生存技能.目睹雅思敏和雅拉在幼兒園中的權力鬥爭,然後關注不安分的幼熊維克多;因為牠突然跛腳,野放的日子要一再延後.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bone up on outdoor skills as Winston and the X girls move into their new fresh-air enclosure, and witness Yasmine and Yaras kindergarten power struggle. Then look over restless yearling Victor, whose sudden limp pushes back his release date.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與雅思敏和雅拉一起在雨中嬉戲和享受攀爬的樂趣,並跟隨溫斯頓在新水池中的暢泳.與羅傑和史蒂夫一起尋找掉落的無線電項圈,並見證兩群夏季幼熊的首次相遇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the joys of rain and climbing with Yasmine and Yara, and watch Winston take a dip in his new pool. Go hunting for dropped radio collars with Roger and Steve, then see what happens when the two groups of summer cubs come face-to-face.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蜂巢內,成千上萬的小動物朝著一個共同目標努力:群體的生存.但是個別蜜蜂的生活又如何?秘「蜜」日記講述這個故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bees Diary tells that story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喀爾巴阡山脈橫跨七個歐洲國家;它有著廣闊的原始森林,陡峭的峽谷和孤立的山峰,為這片大陸最具魅力的生物提供了寶貴的避難所.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 您曾否想過為何山魈的臉如此七彩,禿鷹為何禿頭,甚至雙髻鯊為何有雙髻?發掘動物如何通過脖子以上的進化來生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Have you ever wondered why mandrills have such colorful faces, why vultures are bald, or even why hammerheads have, well, hammer-shaped heads? Discover how animals managed to survive by evolving from the neck up.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塔特南角的11月,冬天將至哈德遜灣的下西部海岸線,但原本應該在哈德遜灣出現的冰卻不見蹤影.2016年是有紀錄以來最溫暖的一年,11月下旬時,仍然比平均溫度高出10度.氣候變化肆虐北方,大海不能在接近冰點結冰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its November at Cape Tatnam. Winter is coming to the lower Western shore of Hudson Bay. But the ice - which should be forming on Hudson Bay by now - is nowhere to be seen. 2016 has been the warmest year on record. In late November, the temperatur...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亞拉國家公園中陰暗的森林,對行縱隱密的豹來說是完美的藏身之所;而年輕的䧳豹阿莎亦準備好獨自闖蕩.一起見證她爭奪自己的領地,尋找伴侶,到成為母親的歷程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The shadowy forests of Yala National Park are the perfect hideout for secretive leopards. Its time for one young female, Asha, to strike out alone. Join her as she fights for her own territory, finds a mate, and becomes a mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亞洲最大的象群每年都會齊集於米內瑞亞國家公園舉行盛會;而在本年的周年大會上,於這片神聖的地方,小象洛卡誕生了!一起見證他在大象的混戰中學習進食,游泳和使用他的象鼻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every year, the biggest elephant congregation in Asia occurs in Minneriya National Park. Here in this sacred place, baby Loka is born. Watch as he learns to suckle, swim and handle his trunk among the mêlée of giants that make up his family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 斯里蘭卡的低地遍布著數千個看似平靜的湖泊,但「湖」不可貌相,湖水中盡是沼澤鱷的天下.沼澤鱷生來就是獵人,一起來看看這些頂尖獵食者在炙熱的環境中如何互相競爭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sri Lankas lowlands are dotted with thousands of seemingly peaceful lakes, but dont be fooled, this is the realm of the mugger crocodile. Muggers are hunters from day one. Watch as these supreme predators compete with each other in the fierce heat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於明尼亞瑞亞國家公園的一座人造湖,養育了亞洲最大的象群.跟隨一頭年輕公象,他正在經歷成長的轉折點.走訪熱帶雨林,探索棲居於叢林中各種奇異的昆蟲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A manmade lake in Minneriya National Park supports the largest concentration of elephants in Asia. Follow a young male who has reached a turning point toward adulthood. In the rainforest, jungles teem with a variety of bizarre species of insects.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 季候風暴席捲斯里蘭卡的熱帶島嶼,帶著旋風的薄霧和水流襲擊了山區的心臟地帶,開展島上森林許多不斷變化的面貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Monsoon storms sweep over the tropical island of Sri Lanka, and water carried in with swirling mists hits the mountainous heartland, beginning a journey through the many changing faces of the islands forests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雅拉國家公園是一個鳥類伊甸園,是215種鳥類的家.這個天堂為能度過不斷變化氣候的父母提供了許多可能性. 在旱季結束和季侯風風暴開始前,每個物種都必須在這裡飼養後代或找到新家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yala National Park is an avian Eden, home to 215 species of bird. This paradise offers many possibilities for parents who can weather the ever-changing climate. Every species must either raise their offspring here or find a new home before the dry...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與非洲森林象一同穿越納米比亞沙漠,窺探牠們如何在缺乏食物與遮蔽的環境中保持涼爽.了解這頭巨獸如何挑選特定植物充飢,挖掘水井,並翻越無盡的沙丘尋找珍貴水源.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across the Namibian desert with the bush elephant and learn how it keeps its cool in a place with little food or shade. Discover how this giant consumes specific plants, digs wells, and hikes endless dunes in a quest to find precious water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪婆羅洲的紅樹林,與灣鱷一同航行,並見證牠們在盤根錯節的水生植物之間穿梭自如.了解牠們如何利用環境調節體溫,以及如何憑藉驚人的耐性一躍成為頂尖獵手.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate a mangrove forest in Borneo with the saltwater crocodile, which is perfectly suited to life among the watery roots. Discover how this reptile uses the environment to regulate its temperature and why its epic patience makes it a super hunter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅毛猩猩是叢林中的建築大師.跟隨麥克斯來到婆羅洲的雨林,一起探索這種獨居靈長類動物的築巢藝術.然後見證麥克斯如何嘗試逃離滿佈昆蟲的地面,並從紅毛猩猩身上學習自然界工程技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungles master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primates natural engineering prowess.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麥克斯來到盧安達的森林追蹤黑猩猩,他試圖說服這些強壯的猴子相信他是朋友而非敵人.一起學習在叢林覓食的關鍵技巧,並見證黑猩猩複雜的家庭動態,包括梳理毛髮和社交活動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track chimpanzees through the Rwandan forest with Max, who tries to convince these powerful monkeys that hes a friend, not a foe. Pick up some key tips on jungle dining and witness complex family dynamics, including grooming and socializing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麥可斯探索斯里蘭卡,窺探懶熊常被誤解的神秘世界.見證這種看似人畜無害,毛髮蓬亂的動物,如何無畏地擊退豹子,並觀察牠們如何努力獲取所需的營養.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peek inside the secret world of the fearless, often misunderstood sloth bear. Travel to Sri Lanka with Max and discover how this fierce, shaggy animal fights off leopards and other deadly rivals, all while trying to secure enough protein to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然中最古老,最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界.和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與地球上最快的動物運動員一起加速.觀看死亡加德蛇在瞬間出擊,與遊隼一起進行空中暗殺,與變色龍一起捕捉快速的食物,並面對在海雀俯衝獵物時的驚人G力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爬行動物,兩棲動物,昆蟲和魚類遍佈我們世界的每個角落--而對於這一特殊的動物群體而言,牠們的生活是由太陽所主宰的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 僅僅是有一點點不同,就可能帶來巨大的優勢,但同時也會帶來極大的挑戰.這些動物逆勢而行,找到了獨特的生存之道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being just that little bit different, can bring huge advantages, but it also presents almighty challenges. By going against the grain, these animals have found unique ways to stay alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵訪世上最大的城市之一上海,他在當地發現一個現代化,國際化,全球化的城市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the largest cities in the world Shanghai where he discovers a modern, cosmopolitan and global facing city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明在透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程中,來到山東-孔子的故鄉,也是中國最古老和最有影響力的烹飪傳統源地之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On his journey discovering Chinas history through its food, Adam arrives in Shandong - birthplace of Confucius and one of the oldest and most influential culinary traditions in China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達中國最迷人的省份之一-雲南. 充滿了來自東南亞和中亞的香料和芬芳,各地的中國人都愛上這裡的美食和文化.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the most fascinating Chinese provinces - Yunnan. Infused with spice and fragrance from Southeast and Central Asia, people from all around China have fallen in love with this cuisine and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達炎熱的四川省和湖南省,而這次著名廚師兼作家,同時也是當地的專家導遊鄧扶霞也一併同行.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives to the fiery provinces of Sichuan and Hunan and this time hes joined by celebrated chef and author Fuchsia Dunlop who is an expert on the region.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明身在福建,當地是一個有著悠久移民歷史的地方,他們遷移所留下的持久痕跡,體現在其飲食和文化上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw is in Fujian - a place with a long history of migration where the movement of people left an enduring mark that manifested in its food and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往粵菜之鄉-香港和廣東,探索傳到世界各地的地區美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw heads to the home of Cantonese cuisine - Hong Kong and Guangdong to discover the regional cuisine that spread to all corners of the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明的最後一站是非常特別的海南島-一個氣候宜人的熱帶島嶼,也是崇明祖先的家鄉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaws last stop is the very special Hainan Island - a balmy, tropical island and Adams ancestral home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿與朋友莉莉星和蘿拉馬拉諾一起串餐廳,沉浸在植物性飲食中,法式糕點,五香牛肉炸角,泰式雞翼和燒牛扒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena restaurant-hops with friends Lilly Singh and Laura Marano, indulging in plant-based French pastries, pastrami sammies, Thai chicken wings and carne asada.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往繁忙的湍溪市場,穿梭在熟食檔,農夫和每週採購的當地人之間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy heads to the bustling Rapid Creek markets, mingling amongst the food stalls, produce growers, and locals out for their weekly shop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美拜訪一些正為希臘文化節準備食物的希臘社區;他到訪色彩繽紛的馬拉克夜市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy meets some of the Greek community preparing food for the Greek cultural festival; he visits the colourful Malak Night Market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美解釋為何北領地頂端地帶擁有全國最好,最新鮮的海鮮;他在達爾文碼頭遇到自學成才的廚師瑞秋西索卡,並學習如何烹製她的招牌菜- 檸檬柚子泥蟹.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy explains why the Top End has some of the countrys best and freshest seafood; Jimmy meets self-taught chef Rachael Ciesolka at a Darwin wharf, and learns how to cook her signature lemon citrus mud crab dish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往偏遠的曼寧立達的阿納姆地沿海社區,在叢林中品嚐美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy travels to the remote Arnhem Land coastal community of Maningrida to get a taste of food out in the bush.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美在帕華普週末市集的檔攤品嚐達爾文的流行街頭小食;並討論達爾文對叻沙的迷戀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy gets a taste of Darwins popular street food from the stalls of the Parap Saturday market; Jimmy discusses Darwins laksa obsession.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美跟卡卡杜的風景打卡;他與原住民梅曼迪聊天,他帶著佔美沿著黃水河遊船河飽覽她的國家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy checks out the landscapes of Kakadu; he chats with traditional owner Mandy Muir who takes Jimmy to see her country on a boat trip along the Yellow Waters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多元化的大廚們製作垂涎欲滴的素餃子,炸雞三文治和越南鯰魚;文拿尋找龍蝦蘑菇並參觀美國最古老的豆腐廠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, fried `chikn sandwiches and Vietnamese `catfish; Mena forages for lobster mushrooms and visits the oldest tofu factory in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿探索他加拿大的後院,發現美味的素壽司,開心果奶油甜餡煎餅捲和薄餅;他與喜劇演員巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士廠試工.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena explores his Canadian backyard, discovering delicious plant-based sushi, pistachio cannolis, and pizza; he gets hands-on at a vegan cheese factory with comedian Bassem Youssef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿在梅斯卡酒和香料的狂熱中,品嚐了許多當地美食:素海鮮,檸檬汁海鮮冷盤和經典的素食辣醬粟米餅.之後,文拿跟一位當地的奶奶製作傳統的混醬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a frenzy of mezcal and spice, Mena devours a host of local delicacies: plant-based seafood, agua chile and classic enfrijoladas. Later, Mena joins a local abuela to make traditional moles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往繁忙的湍溪市場,穿梭在熟食檔,農夫和每週採購的當地人之間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy heads to the bustling Rapid Creek markets, mingling amongst the food stalls, produce growers, and locals out for their weekly shop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美拜訪一些正為希臘文化節準備食物的希臘社區;他到訪色彩繽紛的馬拉克夜市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy meets some of the Greek community preparing food for the Greek cultural festival; he visits the colourful Malak Night Market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美解釋為何北領地頂端地帶擁有全國最好,最新鮮的海鮮;他在達爾文碼頭遇到自學成才的廚師瑞秋西索卡,並學習如何烹製她的招牌菜- 檸檬柚子泥蟹.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy explains why the Top End has some of the countrys best and freshest seafood; Jimmy meets self-taught chef Rachael Ciesolka at a Darwin wharf, and learns how to cook her signature lemon citrus mud crab dish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往偏遠的曼寧立達的阿納姆地沿海社區,在叢林中品嚐美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy travels to the remote Arnhem Land coastal community of Maningrida to get a taste of food out in the bush.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美在帕華普週末市集的檔攤品嚐達爾文的流行街頭小食;並討論達爾文對叻沙的迷戀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy gets a taste of Darwins popular street food from the stalls of the Parap Saturday market; Jimmy discusses Darwins laksa obsession.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美跟卡卡杜的風景打卡;他與原住民梅曼迪聊天,他帶著佔美沿著黃水河遊船河飽覽她的國家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy checks out the landscapes of Kakadu; he chats with traditional owner Mandy Muir who takes Jimmy to see her country on a boat trip along the Yellow Waters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們.四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.programme_title_en: Secrets Of The Great White Shark
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鯊魚是怪物嗎?還是已經被妖魔化?這部紀錄片探討大白鯊本性背後的真相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哥斯大黎加 : 大自然的面紗 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯大黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called 「bubble feeding」 to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋生物學家伊芙・朱爾丹與理察・考利奧森,已在挪威研究虎鯨兩年之久,觀察牠們如何將旋轉圍捕技巧適應於當地環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人.在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習遊泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fat

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物--沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友:海豚的協助.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸.雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽.然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibias Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊--海鷗.牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: VA 的策展人挖掘物品背後的未知故事,包括非洲時尚,一塊肯特布料,一張詹姆斯・巴納攝影作品,以及一隻令人困惑的古波斯餐盤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: VA curators uncover untold stories in objects, featuring African fashion, a kente cloth, a James Barnor photograph, and a puzzling Ancient Persian dish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本週《博物館的秘密》聚焦產業與設計.策展人馬丁準備展出莫裡斯・布魯姆菲爾德的攝影展,珍妮收到稀有的 Biba 生產檔案,另展出一條佳姆丹尼紗巾與喬賽亞・韋奇伍德的陶瓷試作品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This week, Secrets of the Museum spotlights industry and design. Curator Martin preps a Maurice Broomfield photo exhibit, while Jenny receives a rare Biba production file. Also featured: a jamdani stole and Josiah Wedgwoods pottery trials.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Chiles Torres del Paine melt from snow-covered mountains feeds finger-like fjords as they reach out to the sea to join the current lowering its salinity. Rivers estuaries and wetlands are home to many wading birds and the countless inlets and bay

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往繁忙的湍溪市場,穿梭在熟食檔,農夫和每週採購的當地人之間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy heads to the bustling Rapid Creek markets, mingling amongst the food stalls, produce growers, and locals out for their weekly shop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美拜訪一些正為希臘文化節準備食物的希臘社區;他到訪色彩繽紛的馬拉克夜市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy meets some of the Greek community preparing food for the Greek cultural festival; he visits the colourful Malak Night Market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美解釋為何北領地頂端地帶擁有全國最好,最新鮮的海鮮;他在達爾文碼頭遇到自學成才的廚師瑞秋西索卡,並學習如何烹製她的招牌菜- 檸檬柚子泥蟹.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy explains why the Top End has some of the countrys best and freshest seafood; Jimmy meets self-taught chef Rachael Ciesolka at a Darwin wharf, and learns how to cook her signature lemon citrus mud crab dish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《阿姆斯壯》戲劇性,感人且富有洞察力地講述尼爾巖士唐最完整的人生故事-從他在俄亥俄州鄉村的童年到他首次登月-以及伴隨而來非他所願的名人地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dramatic, moving and insightful, Armstrong tells the definitive life story of Neil Armstrong - from his childhood in rural Ohio, through aerial combat in Korea, to his first steps on the Moon - and the unwanted celebrity status that ensued.

epg.programme_title_tc: 前進宇宙:太空,競賽,火星與更遠之處
epg.programme_title_en: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 科學家史蒂夫託馬斯必須賭上名聲,事業和生命,從一顆直奔地球的巨大小行星中拯救人類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scientist Steve Thomas must risk his reputation, career, and life in order to save mankind from a huge asteroid headed straight for Earth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們.四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: An unmatched meteor shower alerts a scientist, his assistant, and a conspiracy theorist to a massive cover-up and an even massive threat: a meteor aiming to destroy Earth. They race to expose the truth and save the planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸.雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽.然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibias Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著日照越短,天氣越寒冷,加拿大的野生動物正與時間競賽,任何無法好好利用秋天作準備的動物都將滅亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With days growing shorter and colder, Canadian wildlife is in a race against time, and any animal that fails to make the most of what autumn has to offer will perish.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Canada is both cruel and beautiful; in the grip of snow and ice, and animals are struggling; however, while some animals hunker down, others have babies to raise who need to adjust to their environment swiftly.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring is late this year, and when it finally arrives, the race is on to find a mate and start a family; black bears and beavers in the west, wood frogs in the south and 20,000 gannets in the east all have one thing on their minds.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore a 400 square mile region of the Pantanal where jaguars rule and life follows the seasonal rhythm of the water.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #1

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s food story journey starts in the deep south where he learns why lamb tastes so good. He meets the earliest pioneers producing truffles and travels by helicopter into Fiordland in search of Wapiti.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben travels to Northland and learns about wine in the region. He discovers a peanut farm, meets tropical papaya fruit growers and catches up with a team of scientists cultivating kingfish like never before.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘆筍當造 - 班挑選3個品種.他遇到一位農民,瞭解到穀飼牛的好處.班追隨注重自耕蔬果的土壤姐妹運動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s asparagus season - Ben picks the 3 varieties. He meets a farmer and understands the benefits of grass-fed beef. Ben catches up with the 『Soil Sisters』 a movement focussed on growing your own fruit and vegetables.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #4

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben checks out a sustainably farmed Green Shell Mussel Farm and visits a peanut butter factory. He travels to Canterbury to meet an ostrich farmer and cooks ostrich for the first time ever!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開.他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程.Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s food journey starts in the West Coast of the South Island. He meets the only NZ cranberry producer at a farm in Hokitika and travels to Blackball to learn how chorizo is made. He cooks a range of dishes at the beach incorporating these local de

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 來到坎特伯裡的高峰牧場,了解這座高地農場從產地到餐桌的體驗,以及家族世代守護土地的故事.接著,他前往多拉荒野海岸,拜訪一對以永續方式採集海鮮的夫婦--他們以推土機將漁船推進大海,展開一天的捕撈旅程.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊急和特種部隊人員的安全車自有其存在目的.警隊的特種服務車輛是為衝破路障和其他障礙物而設的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The protected transport of emergency and special forces personnel is its raison d』être. The police forces』 special service vehicles are designed for breaking barricades and other obstacles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自2017年以來,風力發電已成為德國第二大能源.全國有近 30,000臺風力渦輪機在運作,覆蓋約19%的能源消耗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Electricity harnessed from wind has become the second largest source of energy in Germany since 2017. Nearly 30,000 wind turbines are operating throughout the country, covering approx. 19 percent of energy consumption.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: From heiress of a giant media empire to wanted felon, witness the strange saga of the Patty Hearst kidnapping of 1974.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy checks out the landscapes of Kakadu; he chats with traditional owner Mandy Muir who takes Jimmy to see her country on a boat trip along the Yellow Waters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索好萊塢最受喜愛的女星 Julia Roberts 的非凡人生.從《麻雀變鳳凰》的突破性演出,到奧斯卡獲獎角色,本片呈現她的成長歷程,持久魅力與對影壇的深遠影響,刻畫一位令人難忘的巨星.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the extraordinary life of Julia Roberts, Hollywood’s beloved icon. From her breakout role in Pretty Woman to her Oscar-winning performances, this documentary explores her journey, enduring charm, and impact on cinema, capturing the heart of

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當我們想到好萊塢芸芸眾多藝人時......有一個名字脫穎而出.從他的辛酸到令人難以置信的果報......這就是小勞勃道尼
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When we think of a prolific, yet tumultuous career in Hollywood... A name stands out amongst the crowd. From his hardships to his incredible retribution... This is Robert Downey Jr.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剛登六的湯姆克魯斯仍然是好萊塢頂流之一.作為一位多產的演員,他的職業生涯橫跨40年,不斷在電影界創造巨大的遺產.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Having just turned 60, Tom Cruise is still one of the leading names in Hollywood. A prolific actor with a career spanning over 40 years, he is continually building a giant legacy within the film industry.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey from the fashion capital to Milan, across the great canals of Venice to the otherworldly peaks of the Dolomites and the colorful coast of Cinque Terre to discover Northern Italy like never before - from the air.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著日照越短,天氣越寒冷,加拿大的野生動物正與時間競賽,任何無法好好利用秋天作準備的動物都將滅亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With days growing shorter and colder, Canadian wildlife is in a race against time, and any animal that fails to make the most of what autumn has to offer will perish.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Canada is both cruel and beautiful; in the grip of snow and ice, and animals are struggling; however, while some animals hunker down, others have babies to raise who need to adjust to their environment swiftly.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今年有一個遲來的春天,但當它終於來到,尋覓配偶和組織家庭的競賽就正式開展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的樹蛙,東部的兩萬隻塘鵝,不分地域都想著同一件事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring is late this year, and when it finally arrives, the race is on to find a mate and start a family; black bears and beavers in the west, wood frogs in the south and 20,000 gannets in the east all have one thing on their minds.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s stone fruit season! Ben visits a family run orchard in Central Otago known for its long season of stone fruit and a strong connection to the land and community. He discovers an all-electric cherry farm where premium export cherries are sold dire

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班的美食故事之旅從南方深處開展,他在當地瞭解到為何羊肉如此美味.他認識到最早出產松露的先驅,又乘坐直升機在菲奧德蘭國家公園尋找馬鹿.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s food story journey starts in the deep south where he learns why lamb tastes so good. He meets the earliest pioneers producing truffles and travels by helicopter into Fiordland in search of Wapiti.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導山姆之子的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過罕見的檔案錄像審視民權社運人士麥爾坎X的迅速崛起和悲劇下場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See the meteoric rise and tragic end of civil rights activist Malcolm X, captured by rarely seen archival footage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本週於 VA 展出:一套為男裝展打造的粉紅亮片西裝,搬遷至東倫敦分館的羅賓漢花園十噸建築切片,青年館展示的仿生手臂,以及艾瑞克・拉維利斯的《旅行》茶具組.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This week at the VA, a pink lamé suit for a menswear exhibit, a 10-tonne slice of Robin Hood Gardens for VA East, a bionic arm for Young VA, and Eric Raviliouss Travel tea set are featured.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: VA 的策展人挖掘物品背後的未知故事,包括非洲時尚,一塊肯特布料,一張詹姆斯・巴納攝影作品,以及一隻令人困惑的古波斯餐盤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: VA curators uncover untold stories in objects, featuring African fashion, a kente cloth, a James Barnor photograph, and a puzzling Ancient Persian dish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本週《博物館的秘密》聚焦產業與設計.策展人馬丁準備展出莫裡斯・布魯姆菲爾德的攝影展,珍妮收到稀有的 Biba 生產檔案,另展出一條佳姆丹尼紗巾與喬賽亞・韋奇伍德的陶瓷試作品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This week, Secrets of the Museum spotlights industry and design. Curator Martin preps a Maurice Broomfield photo exhibit, while Jenny receives a rare Biba production file. Also featured: a jamdani stole and Josiah Wedgwoods pottery trials.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本週,修復師 Adriana 清潔一座唐納泰羅雕像,西蒙收到海倫・米倫在《女王登場》中穿過的戲服,克裡斯多福會見設計師肯尼斯・格蘭奇爵士,而 VA 鄧迪館邀請藝術家 Yinka Ilori 設計一座色彩繽紛的迷宮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This week, conservator Adriana cleans a Donatello sculpture, Simon receives Helen Mirrens costume from The Audience, Christopher meets designer Sir Kenneth Grange, and VA Dundee recruits artist Yinka Ilori for a colorful maze.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《恐龍效應》是一部關於現今加拿大古生物學復興的紀錄片,恐龍能怎樣教導我們有關氣候變化的知識.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Dinosaur Echo is a documentary about the renaissance of paleontology in Canada today and what dinosaurs can teach us about climate change.

epg.programme_title_tc: 前進宇宙:太空,競賽,火星與更遠之處
epg.programme_title_en: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《阿姆斯壯》戲劇性,感人且富有洞察力地講述尼爾巖士唐最完整的人生故事-從他在俄亥俄州鄉村的童年到他首次登月-以及伴隨而來非他所願的名人地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dramatic, moving and insightful, Armstrong tells the definitive life story of Neil Armstrong - from his childhood in rural Ohio, through aerial combat in Korea, to his first steps on the Moon - and the unwanted celebrity status that ensued.

epg.programme_title_tc: 傳奇拳王: 曼尼帕奎奧
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是拳擊界最勢不可擋的力量之一的非凡旅程.曼尼柏基奧的傳奇將因其在拳擊場內外所實現的變革而被永遠銘記......
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is the remarkable journey of one of boxing’s most unstoppable forces. Manny Pacquiao’s legacy will forever be remembered for the change accomplished inside and outside the ring...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從時尚之都米蘭出發,渡過威尼斯大運河,到達脫俗的多羅米提山脈和色彩繽紛的五漁村海岸,以前所未有的方式從空中探索義大利北部.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey from the fashion capital to Milan, across the great canals of Venice to the otherworldly peaks of the Dolomites and the colorful coast of Cinque Terre to discover Northern Italy like never before - from the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 它們的形狀和大小各適其適,是可怕的火山,偉大的古代文明,還有地球上最清澈水域的家.它們就是迷人的義大利島國.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: They come in all shapes and sizes, are home to terrifying volcanoes, magnificent ancient civilizations, and some of the bluest waters on Earth. These are the fascinating worlds of Italys Islands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本週於 VA 展出:一套為男裝展打造的粉紅亮片西裝,搬遷至東倫敦分館的羅賓漢花園十噸建築切片,青年館展示的仿生手臂,以及艾瑞克・拉維利斯的《旅行》茶具組.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This week at the VA, a pink lamé suit for a menswear exhibit, a 10-tonne slice of Robin Hood Gardens for VA East, a bionic arm for Young VA, and Eric Raviliouss Travel tea set are featured.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洪堡洋流雖比多數洋流緩慢,卻是世界上最具活力的洋流之一,因其行經距離極長.深海海溝的湧升流將養分帶至海面,使浮遊植物大量繁盛,奠定複雜海洋食物鏈的基礎.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Humboldt Current is slower than most ocean currents but it’s the most dynamic in the world because it travels for such a long distance. Upwelling from the deepest trenches brings nutrients to the surface allowing phytoplankton to bloom laying the

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿回鄉與饒舌歌手海特什夏爾馬一起製作素雪糕,然後繞回家品嚐媽媽做的埃及菜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena returns to his home town and makes vegan ice cream with musician Tesher, then swings home to get a taste of his mums Egyptian cooking.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班的美食故事之旅從南方深處開展,他在當地瞭解到為何羊肉如此美味.他認識到最早出產松露的先驅,又乘坐直升機在菲奧德蘭國家公園尋找馬鹿.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s food story journey starts in the deep south where he learns why lamb tastes so good. He meets the earliest pioneers producing truffles and travels by helicopter into Fiordland in search of Wapiti.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班到北地大區旅行並瞭解當地的紅酒.他發現一個花生農場,遇到種熱帶木瓜的人,又結識一班以前所未有方式培育紐西蘭黃尾鰤的科學家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben travels to Northland and learns about wine in the region. He discovers a peanut farm, meets tropical papaya fruit growers and catches up with a team of scientists cultivating kingfish like never before.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘆筍當造 - 班挑選3個品種.他遇到一位農民,瞭解到穀飼牛的好處.班追隨注重自耕蔬果的土壤姐妹運動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s asparagus season - Ben picks the 3 varieties. He meets a farmer and understands the benefits of grass-fed beef. Ben catches up with the 『Soil Sisters』 a movement focussed on growing your own fruit and vegetables.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班參觀可持續養殖的綠殼青口養殖場,又參觀花生醬工廠.他到坎特伯雷見一個鴕鳥農夫,並第一次烹煮鴕鳥!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben checks out a sustainably farmed Green Shell Mussel Farm and visits a peanut butter factory. He travels to Canterbury to meet an ostrich farmer and cooks ostrich for the first time ever!

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班遇見一位琴酒釀造者和一位義大利肉店商,並讚揚一位致力於永續農產原則的釀酒師.班擠羊奶,並瞭解下一代農夫如何打造多元化業務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben meets a Gin maker, an Italian chacutier and celebrates a wine maker committed to the principles of sustainable farming. Ben milks sheep and learns how next generation farmers are diversifying their business.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班體驗製作芝士的藝術.他遇到一位甜椒生產商並瞭解洋蔥的起源.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben experiences the art of cheese making. He meets a capsicum producer and learns about the provenance of the onion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 達爾文唯一的朱古力師裡奧健弗斯帶佔美參觀自己的精品朱古力咖啡室- 蜜蜂豆豆朱古力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Darwins only chocolatier Leo Cleanthous shows Jimmy around his boutique chocolate cafe, Bumble Bean Chocolates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美參觀達爾文市中心,給自己的餐廳哈紐文一些建議,並烹製他兒時最喜歡的菜式之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy visits the Darwin CBD to offer an insight into his own restaurant, Hanuman, and cooks one of his favourite childhood dishes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往繁忙的湍溪市場,穿梭在熟食檔,農夫和每週採購的當地人之間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy heads to the bustling Rapid Creek markets, mingling amongst the food stalls, produce growers, and locals out for their weekly shop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美拜訪一些正為希臘文化節準備食物的希臘社區;他到訪色彩繽紛的馬拉克夜市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy meets some of the Greek community preparing food for the Greek cultural festival; he visits the colourful Malak Night Market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美解釋為何北領地頂端地帶擁有全國最好,最新鮮的海鮮;他在達爾文碼頭遇到自學成才的廚師瑞秋西索卡,並學習如何烹製她的招牌菜- 檸檬柚子泥蟹.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy explains why the Top End has some of the countrys best and freshest seafood; Jimmy meets self-taught chef Rachael Ciesolka at a Darwin wharf, and learns how to cook her signature lemon citrus mud crab dish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往偏遠的曼寧立達的阿納姆地沿海社區,在叢林中品嚐美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy travels to the remote Arnhem Land coastal community of Maningrida to get a taste of food out in the bush.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開.他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程.Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s food journey starts in the West Coast of the South Island. He meets the only NZ cranberry producer at a farm in Hokitika and travels to Blackball to learn how chorizo is made. He cooks a range of dishes at the beach incorporating these local de

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 來到坎特伯裡的高峰牧場,了解這座高地農場從產地到餐桌的體驗,以及家族世代守護土地的故事.接著,他前往多拉荒野海岸,拜訪一對以永續方式採集海鮮的夫婦--他們以推土機將漁船推進大海,展開一天的捕撈旅程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben visits High Peak Station in Canterbury and learns of their high -country farm to fork experience and tales of multigenerational stewardship. On the wild Tora Coast he meets a couple who harvest kaimoana sustainably - launching their fishing boat

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 來到黑斯廷斯,發現當地以整合式的全方位方法生產草飼安格斯牛肉.他造訪在地農夫市集,認識了許多優秀的本地食品生產者,展現出這個地區豐饒的農產品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s travels to Hastings and discovers a holistic fully vertically integrated approach to creating grass fed Angus beef. He ventures to the local farmers market and meets amazing local food producers, reinforcing the abundance of produce grown in th

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 拜訪了一位果園經營者與食品創新專家.他們共同的願景是製作天然,以品種為主導的蘋果汁,並採用世界最先進的技術.他也參觀了位於霍克斯灣地中海型氣候下所培育的超過三十種無花果.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s meets an Orchardist and Food Innovation specialist. They have a shared vision to make all natural varietal - led apple juice, using the best technology in the world. He also checks out over 30 varieties of figs grown in the Mediterranean type c

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 搭船前往阿卡羅瓦的一座鮭魚養殖場,了解紐西蘭帝王鮭與大西洋鮭的不同之處.他親自捕撈鮭魚,並在俯瞰港灣的海岸邊烹調.他也介紹了一款高品質的本地食用油,兼具健康與多功能性,體現對本地農業與永續的承諾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben takes a boat to visit a salmon farm in Akaroa and learns the difference between NZ King and Atlantic salmon. He catches salmon and cooks it on the shoreline overlooking the harbour. He checks out a high-quality homegrown culinary oil that’s both

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正值核果盛產季節!Ben 造訪中奧塔哥一個由家族經營的果園,該果園以核果產季長,與土地及社區的緊密連結而聞名.他發現了一座全電力運作的櫻桃農場,將優質外銷櫻桃直接販售給紐西蘭民眾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s stone fruit season! Ben visits a family run orchard in Central Otago known for its long season of stone fruit and a strong connection to the land and community. He discovers an all-electric cherry farm where premium export cherries are sold dire

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 體驗魯阿佩胡地區正崛起的飲食文化,以及悠久的市集園藝歷史.他拜訪了一位第六代農夫,該農夫將一片偏遠荒野打造成繁榮的生態旅遊與高級餐飲目的地,並與一位屢獲殊榮的主廚合作.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scientist Steve Thomas must risk his reputation, career, and life in order to save mankind from a huge asteroid headed straight for Earth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場前所未見的流星雨,讓一名科學家,他的助手以及一名陰謀論者察覺到一個巨大的掩蓋行動,以及一場更龐大的威脅--一顆正朝地球逼近,足以毀滅世界的隕石.他們必須爭分奪秒揭露真相,拯救地球.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An unmatched meteor shower alerts a scientist, his assistant, and a conspiracy theorist to a massive cover-up and an even massive threat: a meteor aiming to destroy Earth. They race to expose the truth and save the planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場前所未見的流星雨,讓一名科學家,他的助手以及一名陰謀論者察覺到一個巨大的掩蓋行動,以及一場更龐大的威脅--一顆正朝地球逼近,足以毀滅世界的隕石.他們必須爭分奪秒揭露真相,拯救地球.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春,夏,冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This stunning series uncovers The Secret Life Of Owls as never seen before, using a special camera rig to follow families of owls in a wild corner of rural Essex, through winter, spring and summer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索潘塔納爾濕地400平方英裡的地區,這裡由美洲豹統治,生命都遵循著水的季節節奏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore a 400 square mile region of the Pantanal where jaguars rule and life follows the seasonal rhythm of the water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The resort of Somabay, on Egypt’s Red Sea coast, may have only been around for a few years, but it’s already making a big impression. With a choice of top-class hotel, a championship golf course, and one of the biggest spa facilities in the whole of Africa, this is the ultimate getaway destination. There is also a vast private kite-surfing beach, diving and snorkelling facilities, and seemingly endless sandy beaches lapped by the warm waters of the Red Sea. No wonder presenter Trevor Claringbold describes it as one of his favourite destinations!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
The whole world loves a good curry, and living in New York, Samira loves to make curries, Indian, South East Asian and the Western stew, but she heads back to India where she learns how to make some of India’s finest curries. 

Here is the story of ultimate deliciousness -- the tale of the curry. The desire to perfect her skills, sets her off on a curry trail, seeking out the best chefs in Delhi and getting them to spill their secrets. 

This episode travels through the kitchens of master chefs, who created the king of all curries, The Butter Chicken, reintroduces the authentic korma, a recipe that has been tweaked across the globe and tells the story of the Raja Mirch, the hottest pepper in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Sapphire Coast is located approximately halfway between Melbourne and Sydney and just three hours from Canberra, located on the far south coast of New South Wales. The roll call of magnificence is almost endless in this gem-like stretch of coast, the most southerly in the state. Discover some of the world’s best whale watching, oysters plucked straight from pristine waters, beaches where yours will be the only footprints, immense tracts of national parks and serene ocean pools. Has a coastline ever been better named?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Clare Valley is located in South Australia about 100 kilometres north of Adelaide. This region is for those who seek substance and authenticity, taking the road less travelled and enjoy taking a moment to appreciate what life has to offer. With rolling countryside, world-class wines and spectacular views, the Clare Valley is a quintessentially Australian getaway. We asked our All Stars to “find the magic”, and in this episode they certainly did!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Margaret River is a small town south of Perth in western Australia, known for its wineries, beaches migratory whales and coastal adventures. Stretching between 2 lighthouses north and south of the town, the region fringes the limestone caves and sea cliffs of Leeuwin-Naturaliste National Park. For over 50,000 years the Margaret River Region has supported one of the world’s longest, unbroken human occupations, resulting in an immensely deep connection to the land. Natural beauty, abundance of space, fine wine and fresh coastal air make this episode a must-watch.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Margaret River is a small town south of Perth in western Australia, known for its wineries, beaches migratory whales and coastal adventures. Stretching between 2 lighthouses north and south of the town, the region fringes the limestone caves and sea cliffs of Leeuwin-Naturaliste National Park. For over 50,000 years the Margaret River Region has supported one of the world’s longest, unbroken human occupations, resulting in an immensely deep connection to the land. Natural beauty, abundance of space, fine wine and fresh coastal air make this episode a must-watch.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Marlborough is a region of New Zealand, at the northeastern tip of the South Island. It’s well known for Marlborough Sounds, an extensive network of coastal waterways, peninsulas and islands. This area also boasts some of the world’s best walking tracks, taking in coastal forest, coves, inlets, and spectacular skyline ridges. Marlborough’s diverse landscapes – from valleys of vines to sheltered waterways – offers the perfect destination for a week of unrivalled fun and adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Marlborough is a region of New Zealand, at the northeastern tip of the South Island. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Brisbane, capital of Queensland, is a large city on the Brisbane River. This stunning sunshine capital has no shortage of bucket list items, and our All Stars certainly ticked off a few. During this trip we also got to experience Brisbane’s backyard, with Moreton Bay’s tropical islands on the city’s doorstep, including beautiful North Stradbroke. Add to this a dynamic cultural precinct, abundant wildlife and easy access adventure destinations like the Gold Coast and Great Barrier Reef, and you’ve got a destination you can’t say no to.

The roll call of magnificence is almost endless in this gem-like stretch of coast, the most southerly in the state. Discover some of the world’s best whale watching, oysters plucked straight from pristine waters, beaches where yours will be the only footprints, immense tracts of national parks and serene ocean pools. Has a coastline ever been better named?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dr. Matt gets to play nanny to a very tiny but very vocal abandoned baby badger, and meets Vicky, the lovesick cockatoo who's fallen in love with her owner, in the seventh of the series.  Up at the zoo Matt fills in the cracks in a tortoise's shell and then meets the latest additions to the aquarium 20 baby seahorses, much to the delight of keeper Jackie.  High on the North York Moors an unruly alpaca faces castration, while back at the surgery Matt renews an old acquaintance - Archie the iguana is back, this time to have part of his tail removed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!
They are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive. They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

But they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!
They are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive. They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dr. Matt gets to play matchmaker when three fallow deer trade their bachelor days for life with a 120-strong female deer herd. But first Matt must dart the deer and remove their antlers -V so the pressure's really on.  The abandoned baby badger has trebled in size, but back in the surgery, a tiny water dragon is in for a tricky operation.  There's good news for two rescued stray cats when they find a luxury new home - and at Flamingoland, Matt lets the ring-tailed lemurs out into their brand new enclosure after a winter spent indoors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Families call on some big-hearted but practical ‘Aunties’ to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life, from money woes to health problems and love life troubles.Real people, real problems – there are times when families need nothing short of their own fairy godmother to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life.
From money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Police brutality against marginalised communities is not isolated to American shores. In 2015, David Dungay Jr., an Aboriginal Australian, died in police custody. The coroner later found a “lack of oxygen while he was restrained as a contributing factor to his death”, drawing disturbing parallels with the death of George Floyd in May this year. Stan Grant, himself of Aboriginal heritage, feels a kinship across the continents. “When I see black America, I see part of myself. When I was growing up black America spoke to me when white Australia did not.” For those who believe race is no longer an issue that needs discussion, he has a simple message. “Why do we still talk about racism? Because it still exists. Because it is there. Because it can touch my life at any time.”

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Families call on some big-hearted but practical ‘Aunties’ to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life, from money woes to health problems and love life troubles.Real people, real problems – there are times when families need nothing short of their own fairy godmother to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life.
From money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 5 hardened criminals, 1 unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary series, that will show you for the first time what prison is really like.  Changi Prison is a concret purgatory, spartan to the extreme.  There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells.  A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole.  Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security.  Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners. So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally.  Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release.  For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold. Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: For years, allegations of war crimes have swirled around Australia’s special forces in Afghanistan. Australian prosecutors have been investigating a small group of elite special forces who stand accused of committing and covering up the murder of civilians in Afghanistan. With exclusive footage and testimony from a former special forces operative, this documentary reveals a shocking culture of murder and impunity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Tigris River, which was the site of the ancient civilization of Mesopotamia, still flows majestically through Baghdad, Iraq's capital. In March2003, the area around this river underwent intense airstrikes by U.S. and British forces. The U.S. armed forces gained control of Baghdad. Journalist Watai Takeharu witnessed the moment when the bronze statue of then-president Saddam Hussein was pulled down. The next day he saw many victims of the airstrikes at a city hospital. There he met 31-year-old Ali Saqban, whose home had been destroyed in the bombing. In his arms he was carrying his 5-year-old daughter Shahad, whose body was covered with blood.

Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security.  Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners. So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally.  Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release.  For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold. Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Hundreds of feet beneath Ghana's jungles, sweat-soaked miners squeeze through tiny crevices. Considered outlaws by the government, these 'galamsey' are digging raw gold, feeding an insatiable global industry. As the gold rush draws both local prospectors and eager foreign corporations to the impoverished nation, struggling families must decide whether to put their kids in school or take a gamble by sending them into the dangerous pits.

From money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Police brutality against marginalised communities is not isolated to American shores. In 2015, David Dungay Jr., an Aboriginal Australian, died in police custody. The coroner later found a “lack of oxygen while he was restrained as a contributing factor to his death”, drawing disturbing parallels with the death of George Floyd in May this year. Stan Grant, himself of Aboriginal heritage, feels a kinship across the continents. “When I see black America, I see part of myself. When I was growing up black America spoke to me when white Australia did not.” For those who believe race is no longer an issue that needs discussion, he has a simple message. “Why do we still talk about racism? Because it still exists. Because it is there. Because it can touch my life at any time.”

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Each year, hundreds of critically endangered manatees are killed in U.S. waters by boats, disease and cold weather. 2006 was the worst year on record for manatee deaths – 416 animals perished. With only a few thousand remaining in the wild, mostly in heavily developed Florida wetlands, the clock is ticking in efforts to save this amazing mammal from extinction.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Renowned herpetologist Nirut Chomngam takes viewers on a wild journey across the country in an unforgettable adventure filled with deadly encounters, as he joins conservation teams tasked with protecting these astonishing creatures and their jungle home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Believe it or not, many scuba divers want to see great whites up close, and photographers want dramatic shots. But how do you get the sharks to where you want them? For decades, it's been done by baiting, or “chumming” – attracting sharks with food. This practice is being questioned and banned in many countries because of a dramatic increase in shark attacks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Believe it or not, many scuba divers want to see great whites up close, and photographers want dramatic shots. But how do you get the sharks to where you want them? epg.episode_synopsis_en: Andrea finds himself in trouble for the accuses of falsifying data from a pharmaceutical trial: unable to defend himself due to his amnesia, he seeks confirmation from people close to him. Agnese has a sudden illness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當一名成功的棕櫚泉藝術品商人失蹤時,搜查工作引導偵探們穿過了一個由充滿魅力的騙子所組成的複雜網絡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a successful Palm Springs art dealer goes missing, the search leads detectives through a complex web of charismatic conmen.
